chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 405: Behemoth Set, Return to the Witch Race Territory
paragraphs: Shen Yun nodded, a more smug smile appearing on his face.
"Once we find another Divine Artifact-level Big Hammer, then find one or two pieces of Divine Artifact-level jewelry."
"After that, I’ll break through to Demigod and show you how I withstand a Divine Spirit’s attack!"
Shen Yun spoke with great confidence.
Everyone believed he could indeed do it.
Of course, the prerequisite was his breakthrough to Demigod.
Han Xing smiled and said: "No worries, once we return to the Witch Race Territory, we’ll prepare to go to the Abyssal Rift."
"Perfect, everyone can change their equipment."
Han Xing’s backpack already contained two pieces of Sacred Artifact Equipment, which can be equipped at level 60.
So, he only needed to change some powerful single pieces.
Later, when he finds all other Holy Artifact Components, he will replace them.
By then, the quality of Han Xing’s equipment will be even more astonishing than Shen Yun’s!
Everyone, upon hearing this, also became incredibly eager.
After taking four pieces of Divine Beast Equipment.
Han Xing suddenly said, "Grandmaster Balrog..."
Before he could finish.
Grandmaster Balrog, like a prophet with foresight, dashed away and disappeared from sight.
Han Xing was stunned for a moment, then shook his head with a smile.
This guy definitely knew I wanted him to help forge several pieces of Divine Artifact Equipment.
So he was scared and quickly ran away.
Apparently, during this time, forging these pieces of equipment had indeed exhausted Grandmaster Balrog.
"Let’s go."
Han Xing shook his head and said.
Then, he led everyone and left the Dwarf Territory together.
A week later.
The Sky Island of Ten Thousand Stars City passed directly through the space turbulence, reaching the Witch Race Border.
The system prompt appeared.
[You have successfully arrived at the Witch Race Territory.]
"We’re back."
Everyone said with a smile.
This time, they had been away for nearly a year.
Compared to a year ago.
The border hadn’t changed much.
Currently, the chaos from the Void Beasts had been curbed.
The Shadow Legion was nowhere to be found.
Moreover, hundreds of High-tier Legendary Level Thunder Beasts sent by Han Xing had also fortified the Witch Race Territory.
As long as there wasn’t an invasion by Divine Spirits, the Holy Spirit Realm was basically powerless to harm them.
At this moment.
A Legendary Level officer guarding the Witch Race Border first saw the Sky Island drifting in the void.
Upon sensing Han Xing’s presence.
His eyes immediately filled with joy!
"Saint Master!" This officer exclaimed.
As he finished speaking, he rushed into the air.
After confirming it was Han Xing on the Sky Island, he excitedly said, "Welcome Saint Master!"
His voice was loud, making the Witch Race soldiers below hear it too.
Then, a look of excitement appeared on all the faces of the Witch Race soldiers.
They knelt on one knee together.
"Welcome Saint Master!"
Millions of soldiers shouted in unison, their voices soaring to the sky.
Beside them, the team members watching this scene had expressions of relief on their faces.
Now, Han Xing’s prestige had reached its peak.
These Witch Race people worshipped Han Xing immensely.
And they knew this was all built by Han Xing, saving the day time and again.
At this moment, Han Xing nodded and said, "Rise."
After hearing this, the Witch Race soldiers stood up one by one.
Then they looked at each other, seeing joy in each other’s eyes.
In their hearts.
No matter what they faced, as long as this man returned.
They felt as if they had found their backbone.
Under the gaze of those Witch Race soldiers.
Han Xing continued to steer the Sky Island towards the direction of the Witch Race Continent.
Hours later.
From afar, everyone saw the vast Witch Race Continent.
However, compared to the past.
The Witch Race Continent had undergone a significant transformation.
Next to it was another vast mass, completely constructed like amethyst crystal—the Crystal Continent!
It was what Han Xing delivered back from the ’Broken Land.’
On it, there were near-limitless resources such as ’Thunder Stone’ and ’Thunder Divine Stone.’
Han Xing saw the Amethyst Continent teeming with people.
The Witch Race’s mining army was already extracting resources there.
Cheng Jianyong said, "The Witch Race’s efficiency is quite high; they’ve already got so many people mining."
Han Xing nodded.
Because he had specifically instructed, Wu Ling’Er placed special emphasis on this matter.
At this time, upon receiving the news of Han Xing’s return,
She had long been waiting there.
Today, Wu Ling’Er was still dressed in a light gauze.
Barefooted, her long hair draped over her shoulders, giving her a faintly ethereal beauty.
Seeing Han Xing, Wu Ling’Er smiled gently.
Then, she led everyone back to the Witch Race Royal Capital.
At this moment, the Witch Race Royal Capital was festively decorated and bustling.
All the Witch Race people had learned of Han Xing’s return.
They were holding a grand welcoming ceremony.
The Witch Race Continent was as lively as the New Year.
Songs and dances echoed from thousands of cities.
All Secret Elixir shops were offering a 20% discount.
Various events and banquets were open for free participation.
Upon hearing this news, the survivors.
Stopped exploring Sky Island, ceased battling monsters.
Rushed back to the Witch Race Continent to partake in the grand celebration.
Today is August 17, 7724, in the Witch Race calendar.
In the future, the Witch Race designated this day as a holiday.
Called: Saint Master’s Return Day.
After a long-awaited banquet.
Everyone happily dispersed.
In a girl’s boudoir.
Han Xing and Wu Ling’Er spent a long-lost night together.
The next day...
Han Xing gently sat up from the bed.
The beauty beside him was still sleeping soundly.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 405: Behemoth Set, Return to the Witch Race Territory (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing didn’t disturb her but directly walked out of the sleeping palace.
Then, he arrived at the Wuzuo warehouse.
In the huge underground warehouse, various ores recently mined by the Witch Race were stored.
Shimmering Terra Stone, Philosopher’s Stone, Shadow Divine Stone, and so on...
These ores were categorized and packed in large boxes.
Han Xing could take them anytime.
They were considered his personal property.
Of course, these ores were only a small part of Han Xing’s wealth.
The massive amount of Insect Emperor Stones he brought back from the ancient ruins.
Were stored in the underground warehouse of Ten Thousand Stars City.
That was the safest place.
Even if faced with Divine Spirit level creatures, they couldn’t be taken away.
"Zzz... Zzzz..."
At this moment, bursts of electric sounds rang.
Han Xing fixed his eyes and found a pile of purple stones in a large warehouse in the corner.
[Thunder Stone]: Ores containing active Thunder Element.
Yes, this large warehouse was full of Thunder Stones.
In the past half month, after mining by the Witch Race.
A total of 12.17 million Thunder Stones were mined from the Amethyst Sky Island.
"This quantity is quite large."
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction, "I just don’t know how many Thunder Divine Stones there are."
Han Xing walked to a small warehouse next to it and saw four specially made large boxes.
These boxes contained Thunder Divine Stones.
Han Xing roughly glanced at them.
The number of Thunder Divine Stones was less than 30,000.
"Is it only this much?" Han Xing frowned.
What he didn’t know was.
This was still the result of Wu Ling’Er sending out nearly five million Witch Race soldiers to mine with all their might.
The Amethyst Continent, even without monsters guarding it.
The lightning aura on it remained incredibly strong.
Ordinary people approaching would be paralyzed by various electric currents and then have their bodily functions destroyed, falling instantly.
And without being able to use ordinary labor, the manpower they could utilize was significantly reduced.
Han Xing quickly understood the problem and frowned.
"At this efficiency, five million soldiers take five days."
"To mine only ten thousand Thunder Divine Stones."
"Barely enough to build one Tower of Annihilation Lightning."
"It’s not enough..."
This efficiency was far from Han Xing’s expectations.
But he also knew this was already the limit of what the Witch Race could mobilize.
After all, there weren’t many Tier Three and Tier Four Witch Race soldiers.
Most had to guard the borders and perform other tasks.
Being able to spare five million for mining was already the limit.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"After such a long time, the survivors from Blue Star should have reached level 30 to 40 by now, right?"
Han Xing opened the chat channel and glanced at it, his expression immediately brightening.
At this stage, the first tier of survivors had already risen above level 45.
The second tier of survivors was also above level 40.
The further they leveled up, the harder it got, as Han Xing and the others had experienced deeply.
But this level was just right.
The elemental attacks on Thunder Continent could be withstood by them.
"Just right, these survivors recently have nothing to do and are bored to death."
"I can assign this task to them."
So.
Han Xing entered the chat channel and posted a message.
"Everyone, I’m Han Xing."
At this moment, the originally lively chat channel suddenly paused briefly.
Then, a group of people, after confirming Han Xing’s ID, started shouting frantically.
"Holy cow! It’s the Star God!"
"Oh my god, the Star God hasn’t appeared for a long time!"
"Idol, notice me, notice me!"
Just like those Witch Race people.
The Human Race was equally fervent about Han Xing.
After all, he was the one who created Xingyu City single-handedly.
It was also the Human Race’s first and only main city in the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
Outside the Land of the Abandoned Gods, this man’s legend was spread everywhere.
These survivors also gained many benefits from the Witch Race thanks to Han Xing.
Some even established families here.
By now, their children had already been born.
Even though the Human Race no longer had Blue Star, they had begun to reproduce in another world.
Watching the chat channel flood with messages.
Han Xing, helplessly, temporarily enabled the mute function.
The chat channel finally quieted down.
At this time, Han Xing spoke again: "Everyone, I have something that needs your help this time."
"Recently, I transported a continent of ores back from outside the Witch Race Territory."
"We are short on manpower, and there aren’t enough people for mining."
"I’m looking to recruit a group of survivors to help mine."
Upon hearing about mining, the survivors below had puzzled expressions.
But no one responded.
After all, in the eyes of survivors, such tasks were only done by goblins and some lower life forms.
Plus, mining didn’t give experience.
So, not many survivors had really mined before.
But Han Xing’s next sentence left these survivors stunned.
"For this commission, I’ve set some rewards on my side."
"Those who reach the mining target share can receive Destruction Runes (Gold), Dragon Ancestor Runes (Orange), Apocalypse Runes (Red) as rewards."
"Additionally, there’s a large amount of Gale Wings Secret Elixir, Spiritual Absorption Secret Elixir, and more..."
After Han Xing finished speaking, he posted all the attributes of these runes and elixirs.
When they saw the powerful attributes of these runes and elixirs.
In the next moment, all those survivors went crazy.
"Damn! Orange Runes, and Divine Artifact level runes, such insane attributes!"
"Oh my god, there’s also elixirs that increase experience value!"
"It’s terrifying, if I had this elixir as a supplement, I might have already reached level 46 by now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 406: Massive Experience, Speedrun Through the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: The survivors were amazed at the rewards Han Xing offered.
However, some people also noticed the price set by Han Xing.
Mining must reach the target quota to exchange.
"To exchange for an Orange Rune, you actually need to dig a hundred thousand Thunder Stones, the Red Rune is even more outrageous, you need a million!"
Yet, some survivors said indifferently, "What is a hundred thousand?"
"My ancestors have been miners for three generations, I’ll mine like crazy!"
"Exactly, what’s mining, I love mining!"
"Right, right! Compared to the mighty attributes of the Orange Rune, this effort is hardly worth mentioning."
"Brothers, what are we waiting for, I’m going to find Star God to sign up."
"Me too, I’m going!"
Looking at their excited reactions.
Han Xing slowly said, "Those interested in helping with mining can come to the Witch Race Royal Capital and find the army officer for registration."
"Then, they will record your daily contributions."
"You can exchange these Runes or Secret Elixirs based on the accumulated mining quantity."
Hearing these words.
The survivors started to take action.
Either directly taking the Teleportation Array or controlling the Sky Island toward the Witch Race Royal Capital.
At the moment, at least several billion survivors began mobilizing.
Han Xing revealed a smile at the corner of his mouth.
Survivors from Blue Star don’t have much, but they are incredibly energetic.
Give them a little reward, and they’ll put in twelve times the effort.
Previously, because the Human Race was directly under Han Xing’s jurisdiction.
So Wu Ling’Er was not good at directly commanding them.
But Han Xing had no such concerns.
When it’s time to use them, use them.
Besides, Han Xing isn’t just giving them rewards?
It can be imagined, the mining efficiency of Thunder Stone will significantly increase next.
Then, Han Xing instructed those Witch Race officers on related matters and continued to set exchange amounts for some rewards.
After doing these, half an hour had roughly passed.
Han Xing came above Ten Thousand Stars City.
First, he took out all thirty thousand Thunder Divine Stones and built three Calamity Defense Towers: Silent Annihilation Lightning.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you wish to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*30,000, Thunder Divine Stone*30,000, Shadow Divine Stone*30,000, Calamity Divine Gold*150, to build Tower of Annihilation Lightning*3?]
"Yes."
[Building, remaining time 29 hours 54 minutes...]
After doing these.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, among others, also came out.
Han Xing asked, "How is it, are you all ready?"
Cheng Jianyong smiled, "Don’t worry, Brother Xing."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, a black item appeared directly in his hand.
This thing is the Stronger’s Mark.
Also, the ticket to enter the Abyssal Rift.
Han Xing directly crushed it.
[Abyssal Rift Teleportation Gate has been opened, teleporting...]
The scene flashed.
The five suddenly went from the sunny Witch Race Territory,
In a blink of an eye arrived at the Abyssal Rift resembling a fiery hell!
The system prompt appeared.
[Teleportation successful, you have arrived at Abyssal Rift...]
This is the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift.
Sky-high flames, and the land covered in magma.
Also, the terrifying temperature comparable to the Flame Plateau.
All indicate that this place is not suitable for biological habitation.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong somehow conjured up a bucket of ice cubes.
Chewing them "Crunch Crunch".
While chewing, he said, "This damn place is still so hot."
"I wonder if it’s the same in the deeper areas of the Abyssal Rift."
No one was sure about this question.
Because none of them had been to the Abyss Realm.
Among all humanity, they were the team that had explored the highest number of Abyssal Rift layers.
If even they didn’t know, others would be even less clear.
Shen Yun then said, "Brother Xing, the Great Demon Monarch last time seems not to be here, looks like it’s already left.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, it’s been more than a year after all."
"If this guy had such patience, squatting here for us for so long, that would be impressive."
Everyone laughed following these words.
Compared to last time when they were chased away directly by the Great Demon Monarch.
Now, the strengths of the five had vastly improved.
Even if that Great Demon Monarch were here, Han Xing wouldn’t fear him.
[Abyssal Rift 70th-layer challenge will commence in 30 seconds, please survivors prepare for battle...]
"Prepare for battle, everyone be attentive."
Hearing this, everyone simultaneously drew their weapons.
Han Xing also released Coal Ball from the Pet Space.
All five people and a wolf were ready for battle.
The countdown slowly passed.
The surrounding black fog, the magma on the ground, seemed to start agitating.
Three...
Two...
One...
"Roar!!"
A deep, terrifying roar resounded throughout the 70th-layer space.
The ground’s magma suddenly erupted, instantly soaring kilometers high.
Then a dragon over kilometers in size, entirely like a magma-infused winged fire dragon, flew up from the magma.
"It’s this dragon again?" Cheng Jianyong said with some surprise.
Yes, Han Xing and others had killed this dragon once before.
And took its Legendary Dragon Soul, creating the first Sun Crown Stele.
That time, Han Xing and others expended quite some effort to take it down.
But now.
Among the five people and a wolf present, any of them could single-handedly crush this dragon.
"Hoo—hoo—"
The giant dragon flew into the sky.
The wings flapping, stirring a strong wind sound, causing the entire space to tremble again.
When the Molten Giant Dragon opened its eyes, with a gaze like looking at bugs, towards Han Xing and them.
The few from the Human Race stood calmly in place.

After doing these, half an hour had roughly passed.
Han Xing came above Ten Thousand Stars City.
First, he took out all thirty thousand Thunder Divine Stones and built three Calamity Defense Towers: Silent Annihilation Lightning.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you wish to consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*30,000, Thunder Divine Stone*30,000, Shadow Divine Stone*30,000, Calamity Divine Gold*150, to build Tower of Annihilation Lightning*3?]
"Yes."
[Building, remaining time 29 hours 54 minutes...]
After doing these.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, among others, also came out.
Han Xing asked, "How is it, are you all ready?"
Cheng Jianyong smiled, "Don’t worry, Brother Xing."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, a black item appeared directly in his hand.
This thing is the Stronger’s Mark.
Also, the ticket to enter the Abyssal Rift.
Han Xing directly crushed it.
[Abyssal Rift Teleportation Gate has been opened, teleporting...]
The scene flashed.
The five suddenly went from the sunny Witch Race Territory,
In a blink of an eye arrived at the Abyssal Rift resembling a fiery hell!
The system prompt appeared.
[Teleportation successful, you have arrived at Abyssal Rift...]
This is the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift.
Sky-high flames, and the land covered in magma.
Also, the terrifying temperature comparable to the Flame Plateau.
All indicate that this place is not suitable for biological habitation.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong somehow conjured up a bucket of ice cubes.
Chewing them "Crunch Crunch".
While chewing, he said, "This damn place is still so hot."
"I wonder if it’s the same in the deeper areas of the Abyssal Rift."
No one was sure about this question.
Because none of them had been to the Abyss Realm.
Among all humanity, they were the team that had explored the highest number of Abyssal Rift layers.
If even they didn’t know, others would be even less clear.
Shen Yun then said, "Brother Xing, the Great Demon Monarch last time seems not to be here, looks like it’s already left.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, it’s been more than a year after all."
"If this guy had such patience, squatting here for us for so long, that would be impressive."
Everyone laughed following these words.
Compared to last time when they were chased away directly by the Great Demon Monarch.
Now, the strengths of the five had vastly improved.
Even if that Great Demon Monarch were here, Han Xing wouldn’t fear him.
[Abyssal Rift 70th-layer challenge will commence in 30 seconds, please survivors prepare for battle...]
"Prepare for battle, everyone be attentive."
Hearing this, everyone simultaneously drew their weapons.
Han Xing also released Coal Ball from the Pet Space.
All five people and a wolf were ready for battle.
The countdown slowly passed.
The surrounding black fog, the magma on the ground, seemed to start agitating.
Three...
Two...
One...
"Roar!!"
A deep, terrifying roar resounded throughout the 70th-layer space.
The ground’s magma suddenly erupted, instantly soaring kilometers high.
Then a dragon over kilometers in size, entirely like a magma-infused winged fire dragon, flew up from the magma.
"It’s this dragon again?" Cheng Jianyong said with some surprise.
Yes, Han Xing and others had killed this dragon once before.
And took its Legendary Dragon Soul, creating the first Sun Crown Stele.
That time, Han Xing and others expended quite some effort to take it down.
But now.
Among the five people and a wolf present, any of them could single-handedly crush this dragon.
"Hoo—hoo—"
The giant dragon flew into the sky.
The wings flapping, stirring a strong wind sound, causing the entire space to tremble again.
When the Molten Giant Dragon opened its eyes, with a gaze like looking at bugs, towards Han Xing and them.
The few from the Human Race stood calmly in place.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 406: Massive Experience, Speedrun Through the Abyssal Rift_2
paragraphs: When the Molten Giant Dragon sensed Han Xing and their power, its pupils contracted instantly.
High-tier Legend... so many?
Where did so many powerful figures come from?
Monsters reborn in the Abyssal Rift won’t have any previous memories.
Therefore, this Molten Giant Dragon has no impression of Han Xing and the others.
Faced with five high-tier Legends.
The proud Molten Giant Dragon restrained its arrogance and did not attack first.
Then, it spoke in a deep draconic language, saying, "Human Race, why have you come to my Abyssal Rift?"
Han Xing replied speechlessly, "What else? Of course, we’re here to hunt monsters."
"We’re going to take you down, then continue to open the next challenge layer of the Abyssal Rift."
"Impudent!" the Molten Giant Dragon roared.
"Even the humble Human Race dares to disdain the proud Dragon Race!"
Han Xing didn’t want to waste any more words with this creature.
The golden divine power erupted from his body in an instant.
The next moment.
The Molten Giant Dragon seemed to lose its support, plummeting from the air.
During the fall, the Molten Giant Dragon’s eyes showed a terrified expression.
"What technique is this?"
"How can it directly cause my divine power to lose control?"
This, of course, is Han Xing’s All Things in the Forest effect.
For any existence with divine power lower than his own, he could instantly invalidate their divine power.
Thus, the Molten Giant Dragon suddenly fell from the sky.
"Boom!"
The magma-filled ground shook as if hit by a cannonball.
Magma erupted!
The body of the Molten Giant Dragon sank into the magma.
Before it could get up from the ground.
The attack from the five descended instantly.
"Boom boom boom!"
Under the horrified gaze of the Molten Giant Dragon.
Its huge body was directly blown apart.
System alerts appeared.
[Successfully killed a Legendary Level creature: Molten Giant Dragon, gained 3.874 billion Experience Value.]
[Since you’ve already slain a Molten Giant Dragon before, you cannot extract divine power again.]
Regarding this alert, Han Xing wasn’t surprised.
After all, the Abyssal Rift is a checkpoint that can be repeatedly challenged. If divine power could be extracted repeatedly from monsters.
Han Xing could just keep entering the 70th layer of the Abyssal Rift, then kill the Molten Fire Dragon.
In just a few days, he’d become invincible.
After defeating the 70th layer’s Molten Giant Dragon.
Since they’ve already claimed the first-clear reward, there’s no experience for this layer.
Meanwhile, a system alert appeared.
[Successfully conquered the Abyssal Rift’s 70th layer in 32 seconds, setting the fastest record for this layer.]
[The 71st layer challenge will soon open, please decide if the Brave Squad will enter.]
A mist passage appeared before their eyes.
However, Han Xing didn’t enter immediately.
Instead, he stood silently and waited.
Cheng Jianyong asked with some doubt, "Brother Xing, aren’t we going in?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "We will, but I want to wait here first."
"To see if it will appear again."
Hearing this, everyone understood immediately.
Han Xing was waiting for that Great Demon Monarch, of course.
Speaking of it, Han Xing had encountered and offended this creature in the early days of entering Sky Island Paradise.
It can be imagined that the Great Demon Monarch must hate Han Xing enough to tear him apart on the spot.
Having such a creature keeping an eye on you is certainly not good.
If possible, Han Xing wanted to take this chance to kill that demon directly.
After waiting for two or three minutes,
the Great Demon Monarch, Julius, still didn’t show up.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and calmly said, "Let’s go, it seems that creature won’t come."
Everyone shook their heads in regret.
With their current strength, the five of them could already handle high-tier demigods.
And Julius’s strength, Han Xing had already experienced.
Middle-tier Demigod.
So if it had come here,
Han Xing could confidently defeat that demon directly.
But for some unknown reason, the demon ultimately didn’t come, avoiding this disaster.
Han Xing shook his head.
Then he led his team directly into the mist passage...
Meanwhile.
In the depths of the mist, in some unknown area.
A demon with a single horn on its head, holding a blood-colored greatsword on its shoulder, was staring ahead.
And in front of it, tens of billions of Abyssal Monsters were arrayed.
Ghouls, Vengeful Spirits, Skeleton Generals, and more...
So many monsters, seemingly endless and overwhelming.
Beside it, a Legendary Level middle-tier demon said, "Master, the number of Abyssal Monsters has been gathered sufficiently."
"Now, we can prepare to attack the Elf Realm again at any time, please instruct."
Julius nodded, "Deliver my orders, activate the teleportation array in three minutes."
"Continue the assault, persist in attacking the Elf Realm."
At this time, a cruel smile appeared at the corner of its mouth.
"Those Elves think killing off so many of our monsters will weaken the power of the Abyss Realm."
"But in reality, for low-level Vengeful Spirits and Skeleton Soldiers, we have as many as we need."
"The Abyss Realm is birthing new monsters every moment!"
"As long as we can weaken the strength of those Elves, no matter how many small fry and cannon fodder die, it won’t impact us at all."
Beside him, the middle-tier Legendary demon listened and laughed as well.
However, at this time, Julius’s tone shifted.
"But, consistently sending only weaklings is of no use."
It looked at the Legendary demon and asked.
"This time, I want you to lead the army directly, is there a problem?"

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 406: Massive Experience, Speedrun Through the Abyssal Rift_3
paragraphs: This middle-tier demon showed no fear; instead, a streak of madness appeared on its face.
"I am willing to offer everything for the Abyss Race!"
Julius nodded, "Very good!"
"Then go, prepare to invade the Elf Realm again."
"For the Emperor, sacrifice your life!"
The Legendary Demon solemnly nodded and said, "For the Emperor!"
After that demon left.
Julius looked at its back, its deeply wrinkled eyelids furrowed.
With a strange expression, it said, "Why does it feel like someone is scheming against me from behind?"
"I even feel a slight sense of crisis?"
Julius’s eyes were full of doubt.
In the Abyss Realm, in its own territory, it shouldn’t have such a feeling.
"Could it be that the passage has opened again?"
"Should I go and check it out?"
Julius shook his head.
"Forget it, it’s more important to organize the legion and invade the Holy Spirit Realm."
"Don’t mess up the task the Emperor entrusted to me."
Ultimately, Julius didn’t go there.
Little did it know that by suppressing its curiosity, it avoided a murderous catastrophe.
[Abyssal Rift Level 71 challenge will commence in 30 seconds, Brave Squad, please prepare for battle.]
In front of Han Xing, a system prompt appeared once again.
By reaching Level 71, it was just as everyone predicted.
The temperature here increased, and the environment became harsher.
From the magma, worms thousands of meters long continuously drilled out.
Galloping and rolling in the flames.
Overhead, the presence of numerous hidden monsters could be sensed within the mist.
Pairs of crimson eyes locked onto the group through the fog.
They seemed ready to rush out at any moment and tear this group of humans apart.
However, there was no fear in the hearts of Han Xing and the others.
On the contrary, there was a sense of anticipation.
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Finally, we’re going to make a mad dash; I wonder how many levels we can rush through this time."
"Level 80? Level 90?"
"Or to the end of the Abyssal Rift, Level 100!"
Everyone was also quite excited about this point.
Compared to more than a year ago, their strength has increased tremendously.
With Han Xing’s hidden cards, perhaps they could directly clear the Abyssal Rift’s Level 100.
Just then, the countdown ended.
The mist dispersed instantly.
"Crash!"
Then, a vast army of abyssal monsters charged in simultaneously.
From above, from the front, from the magma pools beneath them...
Countless inferior demons, demon eyes, magma worms continuously emerged!
"Boom boom boom!"
The entire space trembled violently.
Then.
The five people and one wolf simultaneously entered battle mode.
Cheng Jianyong was the first to unleash a sword qi strike.
"Swish!"
This was just his regular strike.
Yet the sword qi slashed a full thousand meters long.
All monsters along the way turned to dust the moment they came into contact with Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi.
"Puff puff puff!"
Monsters fell one by one under his sword.
[Successfully killed Inferior Demon lv51, ordinary abyssal creature, gained 176,000 experience value...]
[Successfully killed Demon Winged Dragon lv52, ordinary abyssal creature, gained 214,000 experience value...]
[Successfully killed Magma Worm...]
Seeing the system notifications flood the screen, Cheng Jianyong’s face lit up.
"Wuhu! I’m so damn powerful!"
"Abyssal monsters, behold my sword!"
In an instant, he slashed over a dozen more times!
"Swish! Swish swish!"
The sword qi crisscrossed, and monsters fell in hordes.
Simultaneously.
Han Xing’s Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill continuously bombarded.
While Zhang Lianmeng’s Large Fireball reached the level of a hand-rolled missile.
With its terrifying spiritual power, a large fireball would generate a massive mushroom cloud upon impact.
"Boom!"
The terrifying flames soared.
A large fireball could take down at least tens of thousands of abyssal monsters.
And even scarier.
With Zhang Lianmeng’s ultrapowerful spiritual power.
Coupled with various top-grade equipment.
Even the basic skill of a large fireball achieved near no CD status.
"Boom! Boom boom boom!
The monsters couldn’t even get close to them before they were blown to pieces.
With the accumulation of a massive number of monsters.
The long-stagnant experience bar finally began to rise slowly.
Strong joy appeared in the eyes of everyone.
In five minutes.
They almost killed at least over eight million abyssal monsters.
At this moment, the level boss finally appeared.
It was a monster that could walk upright, resembling a lizard.
[Abyssal Loner: Five-star Dominator Level creature]
[Level]: 53
[Attributes]: Power 23144, Agility 25221, Spirit 26212, Constitution 20313
[Skills]: Flame Spray, Flame Burst, Devour, Abyssal Resonance...
As soon as this thing appeared, it spewed a flame tongue a kilometer long from its mouth.
The momentum was astonishing.
However, upon sensing the humans’ power.
The lizard-like monster choked in its throat, and the flame tongue stopped abruptly.
In the next moment, the lizard-like monster turned and fled without hesitation.
The people on the side were dumbfounded.
It was their first time knowing that an abyssal monster would flee.
"What the heck, is this some timid war lizard?" Cheng Jianyong shouted angrily.
Watching the monster disappear into the depths of the mist.
Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, should we chase it?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No worries, it can’t escape."
Before Han Xing’s words fell, it wasn’t even two seconds.
The rapidly fleeing lizard monster.
Suddenly saw several red lines appear on its body.
Upon realization, terror filled its eyes.
"Puff!"
Several large corpse fragments fell to the ground.
That lizard monster never saw what kind of creature killed it.
But Han Xing and the others knew very well.
The one responsible was the Void Ghost Wolf, Coal Ball.
Coal Ball’s Escape into the Void skill couldn’t be detected by even a demigod.
Let alone a merely Legendary-level lizard monster.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 407: Gate of White Bones, Gate of Flesh, Gate of the Soul
paragraphs: After taking down the lizard monster, a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared Abyssal Rift Layer 71. This battle took 5 minutes and 42 seconds, setting a new record for the fastest challenge.]
[The Mist Passage has appeared. Brave Squad, please decide whether to continue the challenge...]
At the same time.
The battleground on the 71st layer was already filled with various sizes of spirits.
Especially beneath the corpse of the lizard monster, Han Xing also saw several stones emitting a void aura.
These were the main materials for constructing a High-Level Teleportation Array: Void Soul Stones.
Han Xing directly covered them with divine power value and picked up all the loot on the ground.
[Acquired Strong Spirit * 4.32 million, Elite Spirit * 170,000, Legendary Spirit * 1, Void Soul Stone * 6...]
These spirits are one of the materials for constructing Abyss Technology.
Han Xing naturally wouldn’t let them go.
After finishing these tasks, they proceeded directly into the Mist Passage.
Before long.
A system prompt appeared.
[Abyssal Rift Layer 72 challenge is about to commence. Brave Squad, please prepare...]
Just like Layer 71.
Layer 72 was still a massive number of abyssal monsters, with a five-star Dominator-level BOSS at the end.
It still took over five minutes to settle the battle.
Then came Layer 73, Layer 74, Layer 75...
The team moved through without any obstacles.
All monsters were crushed by them along the way.
Half an hour later, they charged directly to Layer 76.
Han Xing glanced at his experience bar.
Level 57, 45%.
The five layers added up to about a 1% increase in experience value.
This speed can’t be considered slow.
On the contrary, it’s already very fast.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, it would take them several days to gain even a 1% increase in experience value.
Everyone’s face lit up with joy.
Because, according to this progress calculation.
At most, in ten days to half a month.
They could all reach Level 60!
By then, they could start preparing to break through to a demigod!
All at once, the team members became even more excited.
The abyssal monsters on these layers were crushed by Han Xing and the others.
Along the way, Han Xing also obtained several pieces of the Abyssal Set.
But since the set’s level wasn’t high, Han Xing didn’t plan on farming them repeatedly.
Until Layer 80.
The scenery here changed again.
Unlike before, which was all magma terrain.
Here suddenly appeared three gigantic stone bridges.
These three stone bridges were separated by tens of thousands of meters and stretched countless kilometers.
From where Han Xing and the others stood, they extended to the farthest ends of sight.
And beneath the stone bridges was scalding magma.

After hearing the system prompt.

"This Layer 80 challenge mechanism is indeed different from the previous ones."
Shen Yun replied, "Whatever, after all, now, all five of us have demigod-level combat power."
"Even if divided into three groups, it’s not a big problem."

Even if this Layer 80 challenge is difficult, the jump shouldn’t be that large.

"Does this mean that once we clear Layer 80, we’ll officially reach the Abyss Realm?"

"If we clear the 80th layer, count it as entering the Abyss Realm, then what about the last 20 layers?"
The team members were puzzled too.
At this time, Han Xing furrowed his brows.
"What I worry about isn’t the last 20 layers."
"I worry more about whether, upon opening this so-called Gate of the Abyss and entering the Abyss Realm, we’ll be detected by the powerful beings inside."
"By then, if a bunch of demigod Great Demon Monarchs were to hunt us down, it would be hard to escape."
After hearing that, a trace of worry rose in the team’s hearts.
After all, they had some understanding of the strength within the Abyss Realm.
There were many demigod-level strong beings.
No matter how powerful Han Xing and the others were, being besieged by demigods would be insurmountable.

The others also sighed in relief.
At this time, Han Xing said, "Alright, since we don’t need to worry about being besieged, let’s start preparing for the 80th layer challenge."

paragraphs: "Now, it’s time to divide into teams."
Everyone looked at Han Xing.
After contemplating for a moment and weighing the team members’ strengths, Han Xing slowly said.
"Cheng Jianyong will be in one group with Xiaoyunzi."
"Lian Meng will be in a group with Xiaoyang and Coal Ball, and I’ll be in a group by myself."
After hearing Han Xing’s distribution.
Everyone expressed no objections,
Even though Han Xing was in a group by himself, everyone knew,
Han Xing’s strength was far more formidable than theirs.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun could complement each other as healer and tank.
As for Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, with Coal Ball’s assistance, there was no problem.
This was also the most balanced distribution of combat power.
After the teams were formed, Han Xing directly said: "Now, let’s begin."
At the same time.
When the three teams stepped onto the three stone bridges.
A system prompt appeared.
[Abyssal Rift floor 80 challenge has begun, please reach the end of the stone bridge within 600 seconds.]
[On the stone bridge, you will encounter various monster attacks, please respond cautiously.]
The prompt ended.
Han Xing noticed the fog descended instantly above his head.
Covering all scenes except for the stone bridge in front of them.
Thus, only one path lay before everyone.
And that was, to fight through the stone bridge.
Han Xing was the first to step in.
Then, a dense mass of Vengeful Spirits emerged from the surrounding fog.
They extended half of their bodies from the fog, each with hollow eyes,
waving pale arms as if trying to drag Han Xing into the mist.
There were countless enchanting or charming voices at Han Xing’s ears.
"Come over~ let us love you dearly."
"This world is too painful..."
"Come into sister’s arms, let me let you feel the ultimate pleasure in the world!"
"Hehe, we have countless sisters to satisfy your every need..."
These ghosts were continuously releasing mental attacks.
Han Xing listened, with a slight cold smile appearing on his lips.
A flaming arrow suddenly appeared in front of the group of ghosts.
"Boom!
With a violent explosion.
Countless Vengeful Spirits were blasted into oblivion on the spot.
"Ah!"
"So painful, so painful!"
Screams of agony erupted.
A path instantly cleared before Han Xing.
Then, he started sprinting forward!
Along the way, Han Xing continuously drew his bowstring, shooting arrows ahead.
"Boom boom boom!"
The Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill continuously triggered astonishing explosions.
Clearing the way as he advanced.
All the monsters were affected by the arrow attacks, instantly turning into dust.
Han Xing’s forward speed was astonishing.
In less than a minute.
Han Xing had reached one-third of the stone bridge.
"The system gave ten minutes, which is more than enough for us," Han Xing thought.
And at this moment.
A giant pale hand appeared on the stone bridge ahead.
The giant hand extended from the fog, blocking the entire stone bridge.
Also obstructing Han Xing’s path.
Meanwhile, a monster’s attributes appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Giant Female Vengeful Spirit: Five-star Legendary Level]
[Level]: 55
[Attributes]: Power 42331, Agility 36342, Spirit 52312, Constitution 41233
[Skills]: Wail, Weeping, Endless Hatred, Vengeful Spirit Domain
A middle-tier Legendary Level monster.
Han Xing was about to draw an arrow to blast that giant hand.
Unexpectedly, the giant pale hand suddenly retracted.
Then, an enormous head slowly appeared from the fog above.
From that head, Han Xing saw a woman’s face.
Bright red lips, long narrow eyebrows.
From the features, you could tell she was a beauty.
But now, this beauty’s face was rotten, no longer as beautiful as before.
Empty eye sockets with various maggots wriggling inside, looking nauseating.
"Darling~ you’re here...
The voice was very intimate, like a familiar person whispering in your ear.
Han Xing did not speak.
That giant face continued to speak.
"Darling, let us hold you in our hands like before."
Then, a slender giant hand descended from above.
Seemingly wanting to grasp Han Xing firmly in its hand.
Han Xing frowned.
Then, a golden divine power emanated from his body.
"Buzz!"
The Divine Power Domain instantly spread.
Enveloping an area of tens of thousands of meters completely.
And the huge vengeful spirit, the smile on her face instantly vanished.
Like that giant dragon, as if losing support.
She fell directly from the fog.
Under the suppression of All Things in the Forest, these legendary creatures cannot utilize divine power.
Equivalent to directly losing the ability to fly.
At this moment, Han Xing saw her complete form.
The upper body was scantily clad, with a fiery figure.
However, the lower body grew a lizard’s body.
The long tail was still swaying in the fog.
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but shiver.
"Whoa, I’m not the Third Brother, I don’t have such heavy tastes!"
With that, Han Xing pulled the bowstring.
In an instant, a dozen arrows shot out!
"Bang! Bang bang!"
Explosive sounds kept ringing.
"Ah! So painful! So painful!"
The giant vengeful spirit kept rolling on the stone bridge.
Her massive body crushed the skeleton soldiers and inferior demons on the stone bridge into bone fragments.
The giant vengeful spirit continually begged for mercy.
"Darling, please stop, I know I was wrong..."
"Wuwuwu..."
Han Xing remained unmoved.
Continuing to draw arrows, exploding the spirit body of this vengeful spirit.
After a final scream.
This bizarre ghost shattered directly into pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 407: Gate of White Bones, Gate of Flesh, Gate of the Soul
paragraphs: System prompt appears.
[Successfully killed Giant Female Vengeful Spirit: Five-star Legendary Level, gained 3.724 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed divine power from the opponent, Divine Power Value +5.]
After taking down this monster.
Han Xing opened the team channel.
"How are you guys doing?"
Since they were acting separately, Han Xing wasn’t aware of the situation on the other two sides.
But presumably, they also encountered monster attacks like he did.
A moment later, Shen Yun replied first: "Nothing much, Brother Xing, we just encountered a Legendary Level skeleton monster, which we’ve taken care of."
Zhang Lianmeng also replied, "Same here, the monster has already been dealt with."
Hearing this, Han Xing also breathed a sigh of relief.
"Good to hear that’s all fine; let’s keep moving forward."
Han Xing was taking the middle stone bridge.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were on the left, while Zhang Lianmeng and her group took the right.
Along the way, they cleared out a lot of Vengeful Spirits, Demon Eyes, Inferior Demons, and other creatures.
Upon reaching about 70% progress on the stone bridge.
Han Xing encountered another Legendary Level monster blocking the way.
This time, it was a Middle-tier Legendary Level demon.
After Han Xing delivered a burst of attacks and took it down directly.
There were no longer any substantial monsters left on the bridge.
He continued to move forward.
Unimpeded all the way.
In five minutes, he successfully reached the end of the stone bridge.
There.
Han Xing saw an extremely massive black gate.
It was countless miles high, looking like a wall separating worlds.
Moreover, wisps of black smoke were emanating from it.
Han Xing tried to touch it slightly, a wave of stabbing pain surged in his mind.
It was as if this black gate would harm his spirit.
"A gate with mental attacks attached? Strange."
Shaking his head, Han Xing didn’t dwell on it much.
After waiting for a minute, Han Xing asked, "How about you guys?
"Almost there, Brother Xing, we’re about to reach the end of the passage." Shen Yun replied first.
"Same here." Zhang Lianmeng’s voice came through.
A minute later.
Cheng Jianyong suddenly exclaimed in the team, "Brother Xing, we’re here!"
"Wow, there’s a huge gate here! Seems to be made out of white bones, so exaggerated!"
"White bone gate?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment then asked, "Lian Meng, what about your side?"
Zhang Lianmeng replied softly, "There’s a gate here too, but it’s red, seems like it’s made out of chunks of flesh..."
Her tone had a slight tremble.
After hearing this, Han Xing nodded knowingly.
It seems that all three gates are different.
One of bones, one of flesh.
As for Han Xing, he wasn’t sure what his gate was made of, but it attacked his spirit.
"Hey, Brother Xing, we’ve all reached the end of the stone bridge, can’t we meet up yet?" Shen Yun inquired confusedly.
Han Xin thought for a moment then replied, "Hold on, the previous system prompt said we need to defeat the final boss."
"Right now, the final boss hasn’t appeared, we probably haven’t cleared the 80th floor yet, so we can’t meet up."
After hearing this, everyone started waiting silently.
In less than half a minute.
System prompt appears.
[Brave Squad, congratulations on passing the Stone Bridge Trial, the final challenge of the 80th floor has been opened.]
[Please defeat the guardian bosses of the Gate of White Bones, Gate of Flesh, and Gate of the Soul, only then can you open the Gate of the Abyss.]
After hearing this, Han Xing quickly said, "Here it comes, be ready for battle."
As he said this,
The entire black door in front of Han Xing suddenly shook once.
Then, a gigantic black hand appeared from the top of the gate.
Next, a second one.
Then, a massive head emerged from the top of the gate.
The head had horns, skin blood-red all over, eyes glowed with a black eerie light, staring at Han Xing.
Bear in mind, the black gate before Han Xing was at least several tens of thousands of meters high.
And this monster appeared in such a form.
This evidenced just how massive its size was.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "My goodness, this monster is huge!
Hearing his teammates’ voices, Han Xing realized.
They must have encountered this same massive monster.
Before Han Xing, appeared the monster’s attributes.
[Gate of the Soul Guardian: Emenio, High-tier Legendary Creature]
[Level]: Level 58.
[Attributes]: Power 53237, Agility 49892, Spirit 62313, Constitution 55001
[Skills]: Soul Shelter, Abyssal Gaze, Void Fire, Soul Burning (Legendary Skills)
A high-tier legendary monster.
Moreover, three at once.
If it had been a year earlier, they wouldn’t have had the strength for this.
Even if Han Xing could take down the opponent.
Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng would not be able to defeat such an enemy.
So, this 80th floor challenge indeed tested the squad’s overall strength.
But now, the five of them had greatly increased their power.
A mere high-tier legendary monster.
Apart from the large size, there was nothing special about it.
At the same time, the battle started.
Before Han Xing, this Guardian of the Gate of the Soul seemed to know Han Xing’s strength.
It immediately activated its ultimate move.
Legendary Skill - Soul Burning!
At the same time, without any warning, black flames ignited on Han Xing’s body.
The flames were shadowless, formless, and couldn’t be extinguished.
Han Xing felt waves of stabbing pain all over his body.
This surge of pain came in waves, potentially destroying an ordinary person’s mental defenses.
However, Han Xing remained unfazed.
Although the pain was intense.
Compared to the agony when using Giant Beast’s Spike, it was nothing worth mentioning.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.

[You’ve been affected by the Soul Burning of the Guardian of the Gate of the Soul, you will continually endure soul-burning pain from deep within, permanently reducing Spirit Attribute by 1000 points every 5 seconds, and permanently reducing Divine Power Value by 100 points.]

The entire black door in front of Han Xing suddenly shook once.
Then, a gigantic black hand appeared from the top of the gate.
Next, a second one.
Then, a massive head emerged from the top of the gate.
The head had horns, skin blood-red all over, eyes glowed with a black eerie light, staring at Han Xing.
Bear in mind, the black gate before Han Xing was at least several tens of thousands of meters high.
And this monster appeared in such a form.
This evidenced just how massive its size was.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "My goodness, this monster is huge!
Hearing his teammates’ voices, Han Xing realized.
They must have encountered this same massive monster.
Before Han Xing, appeared the monster’s attributes.
[Gate of the Soul Guardian: Emenio, High-tier Legendary Creature]
[Level]: Level 58.
[Attributes]: Power 53237, Agility 49892, Spirit 62313, Constitution 55001
[Skills]: Soul Shelter, Abyssal Gaze, Void Fire, Soul Burning (Legendary Skills)
A high-tier legendary monster.
Moreover, three at once.
If it had been a year earlier, they wouldn’t have had the strength for this.
Even if Han Xing could take down the opponent.
Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng would not be able to defeat such an enemy.
So, this 80th floor challenge indeed tested the squad’s overall strength.
But now, the five of them had greatly increased their power.
A mere high-tier legendary monster.
Apart from the large size, there was nothing special about it.
At the same time, the battle started.
Before Han Xing, this Guardian of the Gate of the Soul seemed to know Han Xing’s strength.
It immediately activated its ultimate move.
Legendary Skill - Soul Burning!
At the same time, without any warning, black flames ignited on Han Xing’s body.
The flames were shadowless, formless, and couldn’t be extinguished.
Han Xing felt waves of stabbing pain all over his body.
This surge of pain came in waves, potentially destroying an ordinary person’s mental defenses.
However, Han Xing remained unfazed.
Although the pain was intense.
Compared to the agony when using Giant Beast’s Spike, it was nothing worth mentioning.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.

[You’ve been affected by the Soul Burning of the Guardian of the Gate of the Soul, you will continually endure soul-burning pain from deep within, permanently reducing Spirit Attribute by 1000 points every 5 seconds, and permanently reducing Divine Power Value by 100 points.]

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 408: Defeating the Guardian, First Clear Rewards!
paragraphs: [You have been affected by the Soul Burning of the Soul Gate Guardian, and you will constantly endure the pain burning from deep within your soul.]
[Determining both parties’ attributes...]
[Determination successful, your attributes are higher than the Soul Gate Guardian, this Soul Burning effect is nullified...]
Seeing the system prompt, Han Xing suddenly raised his eyes.
Then, looking at the massive monster, a faint smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
In mid-air, the large Guardian saw the human in front of it affected by its Soul Burning.
Not only did the human not show any extreme pain, but he even smiled at it.
A vague sense of foreboding suddenly arose in its heart.
In its slightly confused gaze.
It saw the man slowly drawing out an arrow.
As one arrow after another containing terrifying attack power shot towards it.
A minute later, the battle was over.
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully killed Abyssal Guardian: Emenio, gained 12.174 billion experience points, successfully absorbed divine power from the opponent, divine power value +20]
At this moment, Han Xing walked over and picked up a magic robe from the ground.
[Abyssal Guardian: Soul Robe lv58, Quality: Epic, Armor: 3213~3432, Spirit +5000, Magic Damage +10%.]
[Attached Effect]: Advanced Magic Resistance, Soul Shelter, Advanced Spell Enhancement...
Note: Can be combined with Soul Lower Armor, Soul Necklace, Soul Cloth Boots, Soul Staff to form the Soul Guardian Set effect.
"A level 58 Mage Set, the attributes are not bad."
Han Xing praised, "Let’s see if we can drop something better later."
"If not, we can grind the 80th floor more to try to get a set for Lian Meng."
After picking up the soul and spoils dropped by the Soul Gate Guardian.
Han Xing stood in place, waiting for the battles on the other sides to end.
As for whether the team members’ battles would have any accidents.
Han Xing was not worried.
With their strength, dealing with this kind of High-tier Legendary Creatures is more than enough.
Sure enough, in less than three minutes.
The system prompt appeared.
[The Bone Gate, Gate of Flesh, Soul Gate, all three guardians have been defeated.]
[The gate to the Abyss Realm is about to open...]
At the same time.
Han Xing felt intense tremors under his feet.
This massive door slowly opened a crack.
"Rumble!"
It was as if the Gate of the World was slowly opening.
Through the crack of the gate, Han Xing felt a vast, ancient atmosphere.
Then, the second system prompt appeared.
[The battle on the 80th floor of the Abyssal Rift has ended, this battle took a total of 11 minutes and 12 seconds...]
[Since you are the first team to clear the 80th floor, you have received the first clearance reward: Void Soul Stone*1000, Abyss Technology: Dark Energy Tower Blueprint*1.]
Here comes the first clearance reward!
Han Xing couldn’t help but get excited.
Since he was the leader, this first clearance reward appeared directly in his backpack.
Han Xing looked at the blueprint in his backpack and immediately checked its attributes.

[Abyss Technology: Dark Energy Tower]: Absorbs dark energy, dealing large scale annihilation damage to enemies. Creatures contaminated by dark energy will suffer continuous erosion damage of 50,000 attack power per second.
[Attack Power]: 400,000.
[Defense Value]: 100,000
[Maximum Attack Range]: 100,000 kilometers.
[Construction Materials]: Abyssal Magic Stone 500,000, Philosopher’s Stone*10,000, Shadow Divine Stone*10,000, Calamity Divine Gold*20.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing said, "This Dark Energy Tower, its attributes are similar to the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, it should belong to the same level of weapon."
"Although its attack power is a bit less, it has a dark energy erosion effect. If you count the damage caused by the erosion, it already completely surpasses the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon."
"This is very impressive."
Thinking of this, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
He also became even more expectant of the rewards for the 90th floor, or even the 100th floor!
Because, on the 80th floor, there was already a blueprint comparable to a high-tier ancient weapon.
By then, he might get a blueprint for a weapon comparable to a catastrophe-level weapon, or even a godslayer-level weapon!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly said in the team channel, "Holy crap, Brother Xing, a set piece dropped!"
"It’s a level 59 light armor, looks like it’s for me to use.
Han Xing glanced at it, it was called [Abyssal Guardian: Bone Shin Guards].
Just like the above-mentioned Soul Set.
Zhang Lianmeng also sent information about an orange equipment in the chat channel.
It’s a knight’s heavy armor.
Han Xing nodded.
The three bosses on the 80th floor could all drop set pieces.
The rewards are indeed good.
We can farm this a few more times to try to get everyone’s set together.
Meanwhile.
The three Abyssal Gates have already opened more than halfway.
The system prompt has appeared.
[The Gate of the Abyss is open now...]
[Please decide, Brave Squad, whether to continue the challenge.]
[If you choose to continue, you can pass through the Abyss Gate to enter the Abyss Realm.]
This question naturally requires no consideration.
With their strength, they can continue to push forward.
So, Han Xing simply said, "Let’s go in."
Then, everyone passed through the gate, officially reaching the Abyss Realm.
Howling winds and wailing vengeful spirits.
On the dark land, broken weapons and armor were everywhere.
As well as the remains of various huge creatures.
Compared to the heat and magma of the 80th floor.
The temperature here is very low.
At this moment, Han Xing only felt as if he had arrived in another world.
[Successfully entered the Abyss Realm, world influence +1032, Legendary Points +50.]
"So many Legendary Points?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but be shocked.
One must know, previously when they went to a new place, the system would give a maximum of 5 Legendary Points.
This time, it directly added ten times more, which indeed surprised him a bit.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 408: Defeating the Guardian, First Clear Rewards!
paragraphs: Thinking about it, it’s reasonable.
After all, the Abyss Realm is not like the small maps of the Holy Spirit Realm.
This is a grand realm.
It is filled with countless strong beings.
There are an unknown number of demons at Demigod and Legendary Levels.
There is even a rumored Demon Emperor.
Although it’s unknown whether this Demon Emperor is still alive.
It still demonstrates the power of the Abyss Realm.
At this moment, Han Xing saw two groups of figures emerging from the mist.
One group was Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
The other group was Zhang Lianmeng and the others, along with Coal Ball.
Seeing Han Xing, everyone showed happy expressions.
"Brother Xing," Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.
Han Xing nodded.
Shen Yun looked around the surroundings and said with some confusion, "Is this the Abyss Realm?"
"Why does it feel different from what we imagined?"
Han Xing replied, "Indeed it’s different. I thought it would be like the Flame Plateau or the Broken Land, with extreme survival conditions."
"It seems that apart from being a bit eerie, the Abyss Realm isn’t too bad."
Everyone nodded.
Shen Yun gazed at the gray mist above and said, "The system wasn’t wrong. Even though we are within the Abyss Realm, we are still protected by the mist."
[Abyssal Rift, the challenge of the 81st level is about to begin. Brave Squad, please prepare...]
"It’s about to start," Han Xing said.
Upon hearing this, everyone turned serious.
At the same time.
From the abyss ahead came the sound of synchronized footsteps.
Looking closely.
There was a group of demons clad in armor and wielding longswords.
Compared to the wandering spirits from the previous 80 levels.
The demons before them resembled a formal army.
At this moment, at the forefront was a demon general with horns on its head and blood-red skin, who angrily roared, "Humans!"
"How dare you invade our Abyss Realm!
"Capture them!"
At the same time, a large demon army began to mobilize.
They split into squads, attacking from all directions.
The five exchanged glances and immediately began their attack.
Even Coal Ball vanished from the spot.
And then, the battle commenced.
The demon general commanded his demon subordinates, shouting, "Human souls are extremely tenacious!"
"Capture them. I want to throw this group of human souls into the Demon Furnace to refine them into..."
However.
Before it could finish the sentence.
Several claw marks suddenly appeared on its face.
Before it could react.
A meteorite, almost the size of a small asteroid, directly crashed onto its head.
"Boom!"
A terrifying noise rose, like a comet striking the earth.
The demons within tens of thousands of meters were obliterated.
It was precisely Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique.
Under his terrifying spiritual power augmentation, the Meteor Technique transformed into a Planetary Explosion Technique.
And that demon general was smashed into a pulp.
The remaining demons, upon seeing this scene, were so frightened as if their souls had left.
At this moment, they seemed to realize.
The humans before them were not to be trifled with!
A few minutes later.
The battle concluded.
The army composed of hundreds of thousands of demons was completely wiped out by them.
On the ground, Han Xing and his group collected a large amount of Demon Blood, Void Soul Stones, and other materials...
Then, in the deep pit created by Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique.
Han Xing picked up a level 59 epic leather armor, albeit just a separate piece.
[Successfully cleared the 81st level of the Abyssal Rift. This battle took 7 minutes and 47 seconds, setting a new fastest challenge record.]
After collecting the loot from the ground.
They once again stepped into deeper regions.
Reaching the 82nd level.
The temperature became hot again.
They seemed to have arrived at an ancient battlefield.
All around were the remnants and skeletons of various creatures.
Han Xing even saw an Elf’s crown, a Dwarf’s hammer...
It was evident that a great battle once took place here.
"It seems this was the place where the strong of the Holy Spirit Realm battled," Han Xing said.
Shen Yun also agreed, "Yeah, I didn’t expect that the Holy Spirit Realm even brought troops here; it’s already quite impressive."
Everyone nodded.
From this battlefield and some system prompts, they roughly deduced the events that transpired.
Abyss Demons continuously invaded the Holy Spirit Realm through the rift, causing catastrophic damage.
The strong of the Holy Spirit Realm, unable to tolerate it and being forced into passive defense, harbored resentment.
Under the organization of a certain strong individual, the strong of the Holy Spirit Realm united and decided to counterattack the Abyss Realm.
And they actually succeeded.
This group of strong individuals reached the Abyss Realm and engaged in battle with the Abyssal Monsters.
Even knowing their final action was certainly a failure.
The sheer courage to counterattack was commendable.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[Challenge for the 82nd level of the Abyssal Rift is about to begin. Brave Squad, please prepare.]
Once the system prompt ended.
A dense swarm of monsters reappeared.
This time, in addition to the demon legion, there was also a Wraith Demon Legion, Inferior Demon Army, and more...
Han Xing and others continued their crushing battle.
minutes later, the battle ended.
Then came the 83rd level, the 84th level...
At the 85th level, Han Xing and the team’s progress slightly stalled.
This was still an ancient battlefield.
The ground was covered with pits and massive corpses akin to mountains.
Even though these corpses had been dead for thousands of years.
The lingering aura still made one feel their terrifying strength when they were alive.
