chapters.title: Chapter 711 - 408: Defeating the Guardian, First Clear Rewards!
paragraphs: System notification appeared.
[The challenge of the 85th layer of the Abyssal Rift is about to begin. Note, this layer will have Demigod-level creatures. Brave Squad, proceed with caution...]
Upon hearing this notification, Han Xing and his team stiffened.
"Finally, Demigod-level creatures are going to appear?"
They weren’t really afraid; on the contrary, they were somewhat excited.
Because this was their first time challenging a Demigod-level Boss in the Abyssal Rift.
And the stronger the Boss, the more generous the rewards.
At this moment.
A sky-covering abyssal army appeared on the battlefield ahead.
Abyss Knight Order, Demon Army, Demon Winged Dragon Army...
Each army was led by a Legendary creature.
Ranging from Initial Tier to Middle Tier Legend.
In the perception of Han Xing and his team.
At least twelve Legendary auras emerged.
This was the most Legendary-level creatures they had encountered since entering the Abyssal Rift.
And this wasn’t the end.
"Whosh—whosh—"
Suddenly, burning fireballs appeared in the sky, whistling past overhead.
Then, these fireballs crashed to the ground, producing a dull thud.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
Han Xing saw that at each fireball impact site, appeared a demon with crimson skin.
Carrying a Great Sword on its back.
At least Tier Five in strength, ranging from Lord to Legend.
Meanwhile, an even larger fireball crashed down.
After the dull impact sound.
A towering demon over a hundred meters tall, with knotted muscles and explosive power emerged.
On this demon, Han Xing felt the aura of Demigod level.
[Great Demon Monarch: Abdullah]: Initial-tier Demigod-level creature
[Level]: Level 62.
[Attributes]: Power 123135, agility 113253, Spirit 105231, Constitution 132748
[Divine Power Value]: 5723
[Skills]: High-Level Demon Blood, High-Level Demon Body, Power of Hell, Ultimate Skill - Heaven and Earth Destruction!
Note: This is a powerful demon with high-level demon lineage, capable of harnessing Abyssal Power!
"Great Demon Monarch..." Han Xing murmured.
Compared to Julius, this Great Demon Monarch’s strength was clearly weaker.
But still extremely terrifying.
Demigod-level strength, with power reaching 120,000.
Enough to crush all enemies in front.
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch carried a huge stone pillar, a hundred meters long and over two meters in diameter, on its shoulder.
Molten lava was still flowing on the pillar.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
This lava fell on the demon’s foot, producing a hissing sound.
However, it seemed unaware, glaring with crimson eyes at Han Xing and the others.
"Humans..."
"How many years has it been since humans appeared in the Abyss Realm."
This Great Demon Monarch showed a hint of surprise in its eyes.
You see, even during the last Holy Spirit Realm’s invasion of the Abyss Realm.
There was no sign of Human Race champions.
And now, it saw humans in the Abyss Realm.
How could it not be surprised?
"How did you get here?"
The Great Demon Monarch couldn’t help but ask.
No one answered.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were still arguing over something.
"Xiaoyunzi, let me try it." Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "I want to see if my current strength can single-handedly take on a Demigod."
However, Shen Yun rejected, "No way, there are too many Abyssal Monsters around."
"Brother Xing said to finish quickly."
Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing for help.
This Demigod-level Great Demon Monarch, Initial-stage Legendary Level strength, was indeed their challenge limit.
So, Cheng Jianyong wanted to know if his strength, at full burst, could face a Demigod.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then shook his head, "Next time, this Great Demon Monarch’s strength is still quite strong."
"There’s also so many Legendary-level demons beside us, not a good time."
"Let’s take this guy down first, and we’ll let you try later."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s decision, Cheng Jianyong nodded.
Giving up the thought of dueling the Great Demon Monarch.
However, seeing everyone ignore its question, and discussing among themselves.
A wave of anger surged in the Great Demon Monarch’s heart.
"Ha... a few ants dare to ignore me."
"The three guarding Hell’s gate are also useless, allowing you to intrude into the Abyss."
"But this is the end!"
As soon as the words fell.
The Demigod-level Great Demon Monarch suddenly sprang up.
With tremendous power, it stomped the ground into a hundred-meter-deep crater!
"Boom!"
A strong explosion sounded.
Then, in an instant.
The terrifying creature appeared overhead.
Gripping the massive Molten Rock Pillar, it suddenly smashed down on the five.
Imagining the impact, if hit.
Han Xing and the five would indeed be smashed to pulp in an instant!
And just at this moment.
A silhouette wielding a giant shield stepped forward.
Shen Yun donned black heavy armor, holding a gray Shield, instantly appeared in front of the team.
During the descent, the Great Demon Monarch showed a surprised expression.
Not expecting this human with only High-tier Legendary power, dared to outright resist its attack.
Though in its view, such behavior was nothing but courting death.
Yet it chose to honor the courage of this ant facing it.
"Die!" voiced the Great Demon Monarch.
Then, the massive Molten Rock Pillar clashed with Shen Yun’s Shield.
"Thump!"
The dull sound resonated.
At that moment, within hundreds of kilometers.
All creatures, whether Legendary or Dominator level, expressed shock followed by a dozen steps back.
The ground revealed countless crisscrossing cracks spanning tens of thousands of meters, resembling a spider web...

sentences.text: System notification appeared.
[The challenge of the 85th layer of the Abyssal Rift is about to begin.
Note, this layer will have Demigod-level creatures.
Brave Squad, proceed with caution...]
Upon hearing this notification, Han Xing and his team stiffened.
"Finally, Demigod-level creatures are going to appear?"
They weren’t really afraid; on the contrary, they were somewhat excited.
Because this was their first time challenging a Demigod-level Boss in the Abyssal Rift.
And the stronger the Boss, the more generous the rewards.
At this moment.
A sky-covering abyssal army appeared on the battlefield ahead.
Abyss Knight Order, Demon Army, Demon Winged Dragon Army...
Each army was led by a Legendary creature.
Ranging from Initial Tier to Middle Tier Legend.
In the perception of Han Xing and his team.
At least twelve Legendary auras emerged.
This was the most Legendary-level creatures they had encountered since entering the Abyssal Rift.
And this wasn’t the end.
"Whosh—whosh—"
Suddenly, burning fireballs appeared in the sky, whistling past overhead.
Then, these fireballs crashed to the ground, producing a dull thud.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
Han Xing saw that at each fireball impact site, appeared a demon with crimson skin.
Carrying a Great Sword on its back.
At least Tier Five in strength, ranging from Lord to Legend.
Meanwhile, an even larger fireball crashed down.
After the dull impact sound.
A towering demon over a hundred meters tall, with knotted muscles and explosive power emerged.
On this demon, Han Xing felt the aura of Demigod level.
[Great Demon Monarch: Abdullah]: Initial-tier Demigod-level creature
[Level]: Level 62.
[Attributes]: Power 123135, agility 113253, Spirit 105231, Constitution 132748
[Divine Power Value]: 5723
[Skills]: High-Level Demon Blood, High-Level Demon Body, Power of Hell, Ultimate Skill - Heaven and Earth Destruction!
Note: This is a powerful demon with high-level demon lineage, capable of harnessing Abyssal Power!
"Great Demon Monarch..." Han Xing murmured.
Compared to Julius, this Great Demon Monarch’s strength was clearly weaker.
But still extremely terrifying.
Demigod-level strength, with power reaching 120,000.
Enough to crush all enemies in front.
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch carried a huge stone pillar, a hundred meters long and over two meters in diameter, on its shoulder.
Molten lava was still flowing on the pillar.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
This lava fell on the demon’s foot, producing a hissing sound.
However, it seemed unaware, glaring with crimson eyes at Han Xing and the others.
"Humans..."
"How many years has it been since humans appeared in the Abyss Realm."
This Great Demon Monarch showed a hint of surprise in its eyes.
You see, even during the last Holy Spirit Realm’s invasion of the Abyss Realm.
There was no sign of Human Race champions.
And now, it saw humans in the Abyss Realm.
How could it not be surprised?
"How did you get here?"
The Great Demon Monarch couldn’t help but ask.
No one answered.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were still arguing over something.
"Xiaoyunzi, let me try it." Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "I want to see if my current strength can single-handedly take on a Demigod."
However, Shen Yun rejected, "No way, there are too many Abyssal Monsters around."
"Brother Xing said to finish quickly."
Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing for help.
This Demigod-level Great Demon Monarch, Initial-stage Legendary Level strength, was indeed their challenge limit.
So, Cheng Jianyong wanted to know if his strength, at full burst, could face a Demigod.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then shook his head, "Next time, this Great Demon Monarch’s strength is still quite strong."
"There’s also so many Legendary-level demons beside us, not a good time."
"Let’s take this guy down first, and we’ll let you try later."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s decision, Cheng Jianyong nodded.
Giving up the thought of dueling the Great Demon Monarch.
However, seeing everyone ignore its question, and discussing among themselves.
A wave of anger surged in the Great Demon Monarch’s heart.
"Ha... a few ants dare to ignore me."
"The three guarding Hell’s gate are also useless, allowing you to intrude into the Abyss."
"But this is the end!"
As soon as the words fell.
The Demigod-level Great Demon Monarch suddenly sprang up.
With tremendous power, it stomped the ground into a hundred-meter-deep crater!
"Boom!"
A strong explosion sounded.
Then, in an instant.
The terrifying creature appeared overhead.
Gripping the massive Molten Rock Pillar, it suddenly smashed down on the five.
Imagining the impact, if hit.
Han Xing and the five would indeed be smashed to pulp in an instant!
And just at this moment.
A silhouette wielding a giant shield stepped forward.
Shen Yun donned black heavy armor, holding a gray Shield, instantly appeared in front of the team.
During the descent, the Great Demon Monarch showed a surprised expression.
Not expecting this human with only High-tier Legendary power, dared to outright resist its attack.
Though in its view, such behavior was nothing but courting death.
Yet it chose to honor the courage of this ant facing it.
"Die!" voiced the Great Demon Monarch.
Then, the massive Molten Rock Pillar clashed with Shen Yun’s Shield.
"Thump!"
The dull sound resonated.
At that moment, within hundreds of kilometers.
All creatures, whether Legendary or Dominator level, expressed shock followed by a dozen steps back.
The ground revealed countless crisscrossing cracks spanning tens of thousands of meters, resembling a spider web...

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 409: Slaying the Great Demon Monarch, Ascending Directly to the 90th Floor of the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: So it can be seen.
That previous clash, the power exerted by that Great Demon Monarch was terrifying!
Even an ordinary demigod, if they received that strike, would suffer severe injuries if not die.
However, when the terrifying impact noise faded away.
That demigod-level demon had a hint of confusion in its eyes.
It slowly moved aside the pillar in front of it, looking down with confusion at the tiny human like an ant.
In front of it, that human still held up the shield.
But instead of being blasted into bloody mist.
He had firmly withstood that strike from it.
Moreover, he seemed to have not suffered any injuries himself.
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch was bewildered.
"Human..."
"How did you do it?"
At this moment, Shen Yun poked his head from behind the shield and slowly revealed a smile, saying.
"Want to learn? I can teach you!"
Looking at Shen Yun with that cheeky grin.
The Great Demon Monarch seemed to feel a sense of humiliation.
"Hmph! Again!"
It snorted coldly, then raised the molten rock pillar high and once more smashed it towards Shen Yun.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
A series of dull collision sounds rang out.
This collision sound was accompanied by a strong sense of vibration.
In the surrounding battlefield.
Some Tier Four Abyssal Monsters couldn’t withstand this terrifying pressure, their bodies instantly exploded.
"Pop! Pop pop pop pop!"
A dense explosion sound came.
In less than three seconds.
At least hundreds of thousands of Abyssal Monsters exploded and perished due to this impact sound.
However, when the Great Demon Monarch stopped.
It saw the human in front of it still standing there intact.
This time, the Great Demon Monarch’s eyes were not confused but utterly shocked!
Because, even it wasn’t confident in withstanding that wave of attacks just now.
But this human, not only fully endured its damage.
But also, appeared unharmed!
"Human... how did you do it?"
The Great Demon Monarch asked in terror.
However, at this point, Shen Yun no longer seemed interested in continuing the game.
Suddenly, a terrifying fierce beast aura emanated from his shield.
This aura was a hundred, or even ten thousand times more ferocious than that of the Great Demon Monarch!
Near the battlefield, those Abyssal Monsters only felt their own insignificance and helplessness.
The moment the Great Demon Monarch felt this ferocious aura, its huge body seemed to be struck by lightning.
"Demon God’s aura... how could it be?"
As the words fell, the Great Demon Monarch flew backward several hundred meters!
It was exactly the effect on Shen Yun’s shield: Fierce Beast’s Might!
Although terrified, this Great Demon Monarch possessed rich combat experience.
It reacted instantly.
The human’s means, although terrifying, didn’t have attack power.
It couldn’t harm it.
So, the Great Demon Monarch forcibly twisted its body in the air!
Then charged fiercely towards the crowd again!
"Boom!"
The ground revealed a giant pit a hundred meters wide!
Before it could rush again.
Han Xing’s calm voice rang out: "Finish it off."
"Just right, those Abyssal Monsters were driven back by it, giving us a chance to focus fire on it."
Upon hearing this, everyone understood and smiled.
After all, in the battlefield of the 85th floor, there were at least a dozen legendary creatures.
If they attacked together, it might cause some trouble for Han Xing and the others.
However, because of this demigod-level demon’s terrifying attacks, those monsters could not approach.
Here, it instead became their private battlefield.
The Great Demon Monarch said very aggrieved: "Finish me off?"
"Boastful! Today, let you witness the true power of the Great Demon Monarch!"
As the words fell, the Great Demon Monarch’s figure disappeared from the spot.
Charged abruptly into the air.
It hugged the pillar with both hands, with terrifying flames rising all over its body.
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch actually burned together with the pillar in its hands.
In the high sky, everyone heard the scream of the Great Demon Monarch.
"Ultimate Skill——Heaven and Earth Destruction!"
"Boom rumble rumble!"
The earth trembled incessantly.
It was like a burning planet, rushing from the sky.
Before this strike had even landed, everyone could feel the heatwave coming head-on.
Far more terrifying than Zhang Lianmeng’s Meteor Technique by dozens of times!
However, Han Xing did not make any move.
Didn’t even need to release a control skill.
Because he already felt that, within this move of the Great Demon Monarch, there was a terrifying divine power fluctuation.
It should be an ultimate skill it created by combining its own power.
But, what needs to be known is.
Ever since Han Xing was struck by lightning and learned the All Things in the Forest skill.
General divine power attacks cannot harm him at all.
Might even be suppressed by his golden divine power.
Thus, Han Xing stood right there.
Then a light golden divine power domain instantly enveloped this Great Demon Monarch.
At the same time.
The descending Great Demon Monarch suddenly felt the flames on itself and the pillar extinguish instantly.
Like being doused from head to toe with a bucket of cold water, feeling icy inside!
And even more terrifying, it found that no matter how hard it tried.
The divine power on its body seemed to be suppressed, unable to be used again!
Without divine power, not only did its combat power drop significantly.
It also equated to losing the ability to fly.
"How can this be..."
During the fall, the Great Demon Monarch murmured with disbelief.
Then, crashed directly in front of Han Xing.
"Boom rumble rumble!"
The ground trembled.
The Great Demon Monarch’s massive body created a deep pit hundreds of meters deep in the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 409: Slaying the Great Demon Monarch, Ascending Directly to the 90th Floor of the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: And that man, leading the other humans, arrived at the edge of the pit.
The Great Demon Monarch felt the aura emanating from that human, akin to that of an Emperor.
While his heart was shocked, there was more terror.
The Great Demon Monarch knew that the cause of this phenomenon was that human.
"Emperor... why do you have the aura of an Emperor?"
However, Han Xing didn’t have the time to answer it.
He directly pulled open the arrow.
At the same time, everyone’s attacks entered a charging state.
The Great Demon Monarch felt a lethal sense of crisis from their attacks!
Instinctively, it wanted to flee.
The Great Demon Monarch suddenly leaped out of the pit.
However, a round moon had already appeared behind it.
It was precisely Han Xing’s control skill—Broken Moon.
Now, with Han Xing’s powerful attribute enhancement, this skill restored its terrifying power of imprisonment.
Once shrouded by the moon, even a demigod-level creature cannot instantly break free.
In an instant, the Great Demon Monarch was sealed within the moon.
Those abyssal monsters in the distance realized something was amiss when the Great Demon Monarch fell from the sky.
Especially now, when they saw the Great Demon Monarch directly sealed,
they were even more horrified.
These demons said in terror, "Quickly, go save the Monarch!"
As soon as they spoke, the legendary-level creatures rushed over.
However, Han Xing and the others had already launched their attack.
Heaven-Sundering Sword!
Gale·Break!
Meteor Technique!
Elf Archery!
"Boom!"
When all the attacks landed on that moon, its surface instantly filled with dense cracks.
"Crack! Crick!"
After the shattering sound, the moon directly shattered.
At this moment, the entire ancient battlefield fell into a tremor.
It was as if a blood moon fell from above.
This is the sign of a demigod-level demon’s death.
The group of abyssal monsters stood dumbfounded, seemingly feeling incredibly unbelievable.
The invincible Great Demon Monarch was actually dead...
And it died on their own territory, within the Abyss Realm.
At this moment, a chill rose from behind the abyssal monsters!
Han Xing and the others didn’t feel this.
On the contrary, they were a bit excited inside.
Because they heard the system notification of the kill.

[Successfully killed Demon Monarch·Abdullah: Initial-tier demigod-level creature, gained 15.233 billion experience points, automatically absorbed divine power from the opponent, Divine Power Value +50.]
[Due to your outstanding performance, receive an extra reward of 20 Legendary Points.]
Looking at the system notification, Han Xing asked, "How about it, are the current Legendary Points enough to draw the third skill?"
Everyone took a look, then simultaneously nodded.
"Enough!"
Each legendary skill greatly enhances their power.
Once drawn, the group would have more trump cards.
They can already draw the third legendary skill.
According to estimates, the fourth one should be an ultimate skill.
And Han Xing, now, can even draw the 5th skill.
And this fifth skill is likely to be an ultimate skill as well.
Therefore.
The five of them will experience a significant boost.
Of course, now is not the time to draw skills.
There is still a horde of abyssal monsters in front of them awaiting their slaughter.
At this moment.
After witnessing with their own eyes Han Xing and the others slaying the Great Demon Monarch with terrifying power.
They no longer had any war intent in their hearts.
Seeing Han Xing and the others charging forward, they began to flee for their lives.
And this saved Han Xing and the others a lot of effort.
After nearly ten minutes of monster hunting.
The abyssal monsters of the 85th floor were all slaughtered.
Leaving behind a field full of corpses.
The system notification appeared.
[Successfully cleared the 85th floor of the Abyssal Rift, this battle took 13 minutes and 24 seconds, setting a new fastest challenge record.]
The battle ended.
Then it was time to clean up the battlefield.
This time, the five of them killed over a dozen legendary-level creatures, plus one demigod-level Great Demon Monarch.
And at least tens of millions of abyssal armies.
Gains were quite remarkable.
The whole battlefield was filled with floating ghost fire.
These were the souls dropped after those abyssal monsters died.
Han Xing directly covered with divine power.
Collected up all these souls.
It is worth mentioning that among the legendary creatures’ bodies, they also found quite a few epic equipment over level fifty.
But none were part of a set.
Han Xing glanced and threw them into his backpack.
These epic pieces have rather good attributes.
Later, when players level up, they can be put in the trading channel.
Or given as mission rewards.
Surely, they will be welcomed by the group of survivors.
At this moment, everyone, filled with anticipation, came to the place where the Great Demon Monarch died.
There, a large ghost fire hovered.
Also, a drop of blood emitting an evil aura, and a pair of boots with magma flowing over the surface.
It was the loot from the Great Demon Monarch.
Han Xing collected them all.
[Obtained High-Level Demon Blood*1, Soul of the Demon Monarch*1, Purgatory Demon Boots (Red)*1...]
These three items were all related to this high-level demon.
Han Xing began to check the attributes one by one.

[High-Level Demon Blood]: The heart blood of a high-level demon, greatly enhances attributes upon consumption, and changes to demon bloodline, converting to a hidden profession: Demon Hunter/Swordsman/Mage, etc... (Only effective on creatures below Tier Five, after conversion, will be suppressed by the demon bloodline, automatically joining the Abyss Faction.)
"Damn, isn’t this what Julius said he was going to give me, the Demon Essence Blood?"

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 409: Slaying the Great Demon Monarch, Ascending Directly to the 90th Floor of the Abyssal Rift
paragraphs: Han Xing was stunned for a moment when he saw the system notes that followed, suddenly realizing: "Sure enough, that guy Julius didn’t have any good intentions at the time."
"Once you consume this drop of Essence Blood, you might possess tremendous power in a short period."
"But the cost is joining the Abyss Faction."
"And in the Holy Spirit Realm, there’s no place for the Abyss Faction to survive. At that point, they’ll truly be like rats crossing the street, with everyone shouting to beat them."
Han Xing said hatefully.
He also decided in his heart that the next time he encountered Julius, he would give him a good beating.
With that thought, Han Xing continued to check the attributes of the second item.

[Soul of the Demon Monarch]: A soul formed after the death of a Demigod-level demon, can be used to craft some special items or can be directly thrown into the Demon Furnace to refine 100 Soul Crystals directly.
"Good heavens! Directly 100 Soul Crystals, equivalent to ten billion souls!"
Han Xing exclaimed with admiration: "The soul strength of these Demon Monarchs is really high, able to increase 100 points of Divine Power Value at once."
Then, he began to check the final piece of equipment.
[Purgatory Demon Boots (Red) lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor: 2013~2210, Power+1500, Agility+1000]

[Attached Effect]: Blood Boiling (50% chance to increase 20% Power during attack), Demon Frenzy (100% chance to increase 30% Power during a full strike), King’s Step (Legendary Effect, increases Agility by 2000 when moving and puts enemies into a paralyzed state), Heaven and Earth Destruction (Divine-level Effect, gathers all Divine Power to leap high, delivering a destructive blow with Divine Power Value * 500% to the enemy.)
"So powerful!"
Han Xing exclaimed again.
Although it was just a lv60 Divine Artifact Fragment, without set attributes.
But its formidable attributes were much stronger than lv60 Orange Armor.
Obviously, this equipment was very suitable for Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, the team members also saw the attributes of this Divine Artifact Boots.
They immediately gasped in amazement.
Cheng Jianyong was even more eager.
"Brother Xing! These boots seem to suit me well!"
Han Xing glanced at him, then chuckled lightly.
In his expectant gaze, Han Xing directly threw the Divine Artifact-level boots to him.
Cheng Jianyong immediately treated them like a treasure.
Holding them in his hands, he carefully examined them.
Then, everyone continued to advance to deeper levels.
Crossing the vast 85th-floor battlefield, through the Mist Passage.
In front of them, a different scene appeared once again.
A system prompt appeared.
[The challenge for the 86th floor of the Abyssal Rift is about to begin. Brave Squad, please prepare for battle...]
Reaching the 86th floor, the number of monsters was still overwhelmingly exaggerated.
Millions or even tens of millions of Abyssal Monsters charged at them simultaneously.
That scene, just imagining it was thrilling.
If it were an ordinary Legendary Level team, they might even feel despair directly.
However, Han Xing and they didn’t feel anything.
Moreover, the 86th-floor challenge did not feature Demigod-level demons.
Compared to the difficulty of the 85th floor, it was much easier.
Everyone started to continue the sweep.
Slaughtering monsters crazily all the way.
"Puff puff puff!"
The bodies of Abyssal Monsters were blasted apart one by one, turning into experience and falling down.
When the last Abyssal Monster fell under Han Xing’s arrow.
A system prompt appeared.
[Successfully cleared the 86th-floor challenge of the Abyssal Rift. This battle took 21 minutes and 17 seconds, setting a new fastest challenge record.]
The massive number of monsters extended their battle time.
Now, almost every layer required more than 20 minutes.
But likewise, their speed of gaining experience became faster.
87th floor...
88th floor...
89th floor...
All the way to the 90th floor.
Han Xing looked at his experience bar.
Level 57, 53%.
From 70 to 90 floors.
It increased his Experience Value by 8%.
This speed was really fast.
Because according to Han Xing’s estimate.
If they started from 80 floors directly from behind.
It would approximately take three hours to reach the 90th floor.
A single run would yield 5% Experience Value.
They could fight about five times a day, which would be as much as 25% Experience Value.
In just a few days, he could level up to 58.
Then maintaining this rhythm, it would take at most a month for everyone to reach level 60.
[You have reached the Abyssal Rift: 90th floor.]
At that moment, Cheng Jianyong suddenly said: "Is this the 90th floor of the Abyssal Rift?"
"It’s strange, why is there a city here?"
Yes, ever since walking out of the Mist Passage.
A vast Royal City appeared ahead of them.
However, it seemed this Royal City had also undergone the baptism of war.
Weathered walls and damaged gates.
With no signs of biological activity on them.
The team members were also curiously observing the appearance of this Royal City.
A system prompt appeared,
[Brave Squad, please note, you have reached the 90th floor of the Abyssal Rift. This is Yuanju City and also the endpoint reached by the Holy Spirit Realm’s counteroffensive army...]
[Here, you will reenact the battle from 1247 years ago.]
[Your task is to help the Holy Spirit Realm United Army, to take down Yuanju City.]
"Huh? We’re supposed to siege the city?" Cheng Jianyong said in surprise.
Han Xing’s expression was also a bit puzzled.
"Reenacting a battle from over 1200 years ago, does that mean we’re going to fight alongside those powerful beings?"
Before Han Xing could finish his thought.
Around him, countless figures appeared.
Those figures varied in height, with different builds.
There were Giants, Elves, Dwarves, and Griffin Knights...
At that moment, they were chanting slogans.
"Attack! Keep attacking!"
"Make those Abyss Realm scum see the might of our Holy Spirit Realm!"
"Kill!"
A dwarf with a bushy beard raised a black hammer high, leading the charge.
Behind him, a large number of United Army troops followed.
And Han Xing and his team were among them.
"Wow, are we starting right away?"
Shen Yun wondered: "Where are the enemies?"
Right after he spoke.
A mysterious force emanated from the vast Yuanju City in front of them.

sentences.text: Han Xing was stunned for a moment when he saw the system notes that followed, suddenly realizing: "Sure enough, that guy Julius didn’t have any good intentions at the time."
"Once you consume this drop of Essence Blood, you might possess tremendous power in a short period."
"But the cost is joining the Abyss Faction."
"And in the Holy Spirit Realm, there’s no place for the Abyss Faction to survive.
At that point, they’ll truly be like rats crossing the street, with everyone shouting to beat them."
Han Xing said hatefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 410: The Ultimate Battle
paragraphs: In front of them, the massive Yuanju City erupted with a mysterious power.
The mottled walls vanished, instantly becoming brand new.
The damaged iron gates were restored, covered with black secret patterns, appearing indestructible.
And on the city wall, there were also numerous Demon Army troops.
They were manipulating various Abyss Technology on the wall to attack.
"Boom! Boom boom boom!"
Shells, trailing thick smoke, streaked across everyone’s heads.
Then, triggering violent explosions.
However, those who fought their way from Holy Spirit Realm here were not ordinary warriors.
The United Army had the majority possessing Tier Five strength, with quite a few Legends among them.
Occasional Tier Four individuals also had Four-star Dominator Level strength.
These shells had no effect on them.
Even before they fell, they were crushed directly by these strong warriors.
The United Army charged forward fearlessly towards the battlefield below Yuanju City, beginning to battle with the vast Demon Army.
Just when Han Xing and the others were still unclear about the situation.
Beside them, a five-meter tall giant patted their shoulders and said, "Newcomers, stop daydreaming!"
"Hurry up and charge with us to remove the teleportation station set up by the Abyss Race."
"As long as Yuanju City is destroyed, they can no longer cross the Sea of Lava at will and come to the Abyssal Rift!"
The giant’s words were brief.
Yet, everyone gleaned a lot of information from them.
This city is a transit station for the Abyss Race.
From the Abyss Realm to here, lies a vast Sea of Lava.
Many demons are teleported from the Abyss Realm to Yuanju City, then invade the Holy Spirit Realm via the Abyssal Rift.
And as long as Yuanju City is destroyed.
Those demons cannot cross the Sea of Lava to enter the Abyssal Rift.
Understanding this, realization dawned in everyone’s eyes.
Then, the team members looked at Han Xing, seemingly waiting for his next command.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Let’s go, charge up together."
Once he spoke.
The five of them followed the United Army, charging into the Demon Legion.
A large number of demons poured out of Yuanju City.
"Splash!
Sounding like the gushing of blood.
On the city walls, on the gates.
Abyssal creatures densely resembling crawling monsters descended along the walls and entered the battlefield below.
"Bang! Bang bang!"
"Crack!"
Fireballs exploded, giant axes swung!
The warriors of the United Army fought bravely.
A giant possessing Legendary Level strength leaped high.
Holding a massive axe, it chopped down fiercely.
"Puff!"
A Legendary Level skeletal mammoth was shattered on the spot!
Elsewhere, several Elf Race mages floated in mid-air.
Magic staff waving in hand.
Elemental magic attacks raining down.
Massive ice cones, burning fireballs, and flickering lightning.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
Abyssal Monster being killed in droves.
Yet, no matter how many Abyssal Monsters these warriors killed.
More, even stronger monsters joined the battlefield.
Yuanju City had an enormous area.
Every moment, the number of Abyssal Monsters teleported over reached terrifying figures.
The United Army, though powerful, faced with such a massive amount of Abyssal Monsters.
Could only struggle to maintain.
Among them, more and more Legendary Level demons appeared.
At this time, a giant over ten meters tall swung an axe at the enemy.
Using too much force, it even chopped towards the ground.
"Bang!"
Instantly, a thousand-meter-long trench appeared on the ground.
At this moment, the giant shook his straw-like hair, smiling lightly at the front.
"Little Dwarfs, are you guys capable or not?"
"If not, come cooperate with me, I’ll take you to charge into Yuanju City."
The questioned group of Dwarf Race warriors blushed in frustration.
They swung their hammers loudly, angrily saying, "Big guy, don’t underestimate the Dwarf Race!"
"Watch me tear open a hole in the Abyssal Army’s defense."
Having said that.
He led three mighty warriors from his race.
Directly jumped into the Abyssal Army.
"Boom!"
Like four meteors falling to the ground.
Four Dwarf Race warriors swung their weapons.
Started frantically harvesting within the Abyssal Army, clearing the surrounding Abyssal Monsters.
The leading Dwarf Race warrior showed joy in his eyes.
Just as he wanted to turn around to flaunt to those giants.
At this moment, several Legendary Level demons suddenly appeared.
Grinning sinisterly.
"Little Dwarfs, die for me!"
Legendary demons wield their weapons.
"Bang! Bang bang bang!"
Four Dwarf warriors suffered heavy blows, being slapped flying out directly.
"Strait!"
"Damn it!"
The United Army’s warriors exclaimed terribly.
The defense line the Dwarf Race had painstakingly torn open crumbled in an instant!
Seeing, the two armies about to fall back into a stalemate again.
Five figures, like a rising tide, powerfully charged into the Abyssal Army.
Seeing this.
The various breed warriors of the United Army showed intense disbelief in their eyes.
"Human Race, come back fast!"
"The Dwarf Race’s warriors have already failed!"
"Don’t be impulsive, act with us!"
Those warriors warned repeatedly.
Fearing Han Xing and the others would fall inside.
However, Han Xing and the others did not stop, rather continuing charging deeper into the Abyssal Army.
At this time.
Several Legendary Level demons also noticed Han Xing and his team.
They simultaneously flew into the air, charging forward like several cannonballs.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 410: The Ultimate Battle - Part 2
paragraphs: The intense power threatened to tear Han Xing and the others apart.
However, just as the demons were charging forward.
Cheng Jianyong took the lead.
He leaped high, then shouted loudly in mid-air.
"Heaven did not give birth to me, Cheng Jianyong! The Sword Dao is as eternal as the long night!"
"Slash!"
A terrifying blue Sword Qi, filled with infinite Divine Power, burst out from the Divine Artifact Longsword in his hand.
"Swish!"
This sword pierced through heaven and earth.
Endless Sword Qi began to spread.
On the entire battlefield, in the eyes of countless strong warriors, there was only this dreadful sword!
At the same time.
The demons flying towards them, upon seeing this human slash out this sword, had already felt the threat of death.
However, at this time they wanted to dodge, it was already too late!
In an instant!
The Sword Qi had already struck!
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
The few Legendary Level demons were immediately cut into two pieces in mid-air!
But it wasn’t over yet.
The endless Sword Qi fell upon the Great Sword of the Abyssal Monsters.
Countless monsters were turned into blood mist the moment they came into contact with the intense Sword Qi.
The sound of bodies bursting was unceasing.
When everyone came back to their senses, their eyes were filled with intense astonishment.
Because they saw.
From the distance where that human slashed out the Sword Qi, to beneath the walls of Yuanju City.
A massive gully spanning tens of thousands of meters appeared!
One sword, like the Creation of Heaven and Earth!
"Hiss!!"
All the strong warriors on the field gasped collectively.
They simultaneously looked towards Cheng Jianyong, who had executed that sword.
Murmuring: "Is this... done by that Human?"
"What terrifying power!"
"This sword is almost capable of slaying a Demigod!"
Praised the strong warriors of the United Army.
The army of Abyssal Monsters suffered a severe blow.
At the same time, the morale of the United Army was greatly enhanced.
"Roar!"
"Charge! Kill these Abyss scum!"
"Kill!"
The United Army began to charge bravely!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, who had made a huge impression, stood with hands on his hips in mid-air.
His eyes were full of pride.
"Hahaha! From now on, call me Cheng Jianxian!"
Everyone rolled their eyes at him.
Han Xing saw that the gully Cheng Jianyong slashed had been filled again by a mass of Abyssal Monsters.
Thus.
He drew his bowstring.
Then, directly shot an Arrow into the sky.
The next moment.
A loud noise was heard.
"Booming!"
The sky and earth trembled simultaneously.
As if something terrifying was about to descend.
This Arrow, was precisely Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain.
Capable of calling upon meteors according to his own Agility Attribute to obliterate enemies.
Han Xing’s agility was now as high as 130,000.
With the state bonus from Shen Yun and the Gale Power Secret Elixir he had taken earlier, he reached 200,000 agility!
That is to say.
Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain could summon 200,000 meteors at once.
When 200,000 meteors descended simultaneously.
In an instant, the dark sky was illuminated.
The powerful warriors of all races engaged in battle, even forgot to continue fighting.
They all looked up, gazing at the sky.
"Meteors... how can there be meteors in the Abyss Realm?"
"What terrifying power, it feels like every meteor is potent enough to severely injure or even annihilate me."
The dazzling meteors, accompanied by the aura of Destruction, crashed down.
Not only the battlefield in front of Yuanju City.
The entirety of Yuanju City was affected.
Then, on the field, tens of millions of the United Army, and countless Abyssal Monsters.
Suddenly their eyes were filled with a blinding white.
"Boom!
After a violent explosion, everything became calm.
However, this strike comparable to a Forbidden Curse.
Directly took away at least over two million Abyssal Monsters’ lives!
The battlefield fell into a momentary pause.
The United Army, shocked, watched this scene, unable to recover for a long time.
Until a male Elf Mage, clad in a white robe with pointed ears, at the front said: "It was those humans! So strong!"
"Don’t just stand there, the strong humans have given us an opportunity, keep attacking."
The United Army snapped back to reality.
"Charge!!"
"Follow me, brothers!"
The powerful warriors of all races began to crazily attack Yuanju City.
The frontline advanced rapidly.
Even the demons realized.
Seeing the situation was about to collapse.
Han Xing saw, at the top of Yuanju City, several pitch-black cannons appeared.
The demons finally used their trump card.
At this moment, seeing the appearance of those cannons.
Han Xing felt a sense of familiarity.
Then he suddenly remembered.
He was rewarded with an Abyssal Technology Blueprint after clearing the 80th level of the Abyssal Rift.
The cannon design recorded on the blueprint was similar to that on top of Yuanju City.
"Damn, it’s the Dark Energy Cannon!"
Han Xing immediately exclaimed.
The team members quickly reacted as well.
From the previously obtained blueprint, they already knew the terror of the Dark Energy Cannon,
it rivaled the power of High-tier Ancient Weapons.
If they were hit by one shot, it would be no joke!
In no time, the five began to retreat rapidly.
However, the demons weren’t fools either.
They knew that the ones who had just summoned thousands of meteors, causing them heavy losses, were those five humans.
One of the Dark Energy Cannons was persistently targeting them.
Wherever Han Xing and his team ran, that cannon’s muzzle pointed.
"Damn, these demons have targeted us!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Shen Yun said: "I’ll block this shot!"
"Can you do it? Xiaoyunzi, don’t push yourself if you can’t!"

Praised the strong warriors of the United Army.
The army of Abyssal Monsters suffered a severe blow.
At the same time, the morale of the United Army was greatly enhanced.
"Roar!"
"Charge!
Kill these Abyss scum!"
"Kill!"
The United Army began to charge bravely!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong, who had made a huge impression, stood with hands on his hips in mid-air.
His eyes were full of pride.
"Hahaha!
From now on, call me Cheng Jianxian!"
Everyone rolled their eyes at him.
Han Xing saw that the gully Cheng Jianyong slashed had been filled again by a mass of Abyssal Monsters.
Thus.
He drew his bowstring.
Then, directly shot an Arrow into the sky.
The next moment.
A loud noise was heard.
"Booming!"
The sky and earth trembled simultaneously.
As if something terrifying was about to descend.
This Arrow, was precisely Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain.
Capable of calling upon meteors according to his own Agility Attribute to obliterate enemies.
Han Xing’s agility was now as high as 130,000.
With the state bonus from Shen Yun and the Gale Power Secret Elixir he had taken earlier, he reached 200,000 agility!
That is to say.
Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain could summon 200,000 meteors at once.
When 200,000 meteors descended simultaneously.
In an instant, the dark sky was illuminated.
The powerful warriors of all races engaged in battle, even forgot to continue fighting.
They all looked up, gazing at the sky.
"Meteors... how can there be meteors in the Abyss Realm?"
"What terrifying power, it feels like every meteor is potent enough to severely injure or even annihilate me."
The dazzling meteors, accompanied by the aura of Destruction, crashed down.
Not only the battlefield in front of Yuanju City.
The entirety of Yuanju City was affected.
Then, on the field, tens of millions of the United Army, and countless Abyssal Monsters.
Suddenly their eyes were filled with a blinding white.
"Boom!
After a violent explosion, everything became calm.
However, this strike comparable to a Forbidden Curse.
Directly took away at least over two million Abyssal Monsters’ lives!
The battlefield fell into a momentary pause.
The United Army, shocked, watched this scene, unable to recover for a long time.
Until a male Elf Mage, clad in a white robe with pointed ears, at the front said: "It was those humans!
So strong!"
"Don’t just stand there, the strong humans have given us an opportunity, keep attacking."
The United Army snapped back to reality.
"Charge!!"
"Follow me, brothers!"
The powerful warriors of all races began to crazily attack Yuanju City.
The frontline advanced rapidly.
Even the demons realized.
Seeing the situation was about to collapse.
Han Xing saw, at the top of Yuanju City, several pitch-black cannons appeared.
The demons finally used their trump card.
At this moment, seeing the appearance of those cannons.
Han Xing felt a sense of familiarity.
Then he suddenly remembered.
He was rewarded with an Abyssal Technology Blueprint after clearing the 80th level of the Abyssal Rift.
The cannon design recorded on the blueprint was similar to that on top of Yuanju City.
"Damn, it’s the Dark Energy Cannon!"
Han Xing immediately exclaimed.
The team members quickly reacted as well.
From the previously obtained blueprint, they already knew the terror of the Dark Energy Cannon,
it rivaled the power of High-tier Ancient Weapons.
If they were hit by one shot, it would be no joke!
In no time, the five began to retreat rapidly.
However, the demons weren’t fools either.
They knew that the ones who had just summoned thousands of meteors, causing them heavy losses, were those five humans.
One of the Dark Energy Cannons was persistently targeting them.
Wherever Han Xing and his team ran, that cannon’s muzzle pointed.
"Damn, these demons have targeted us!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Shen Yun said: "I’ll block this shot!"
"Can you do it?
Xiaoyunzi, don’t push yourself if you can’t!"

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 410: The Ultimate Battle - Part 3
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong said worriedly.
"Don’t worry, without Brother Xing’s monument bonus, the Dark Energy Cannon can at most harm an ordinary demigod."
"This little attack can’t hurt me!"
As soon as the words fell, a purple shell, carrying a heart-stopping dark energy.
Came swiftly towards the crowd.
Shen Yun instantly stood in front of everyone.
"Buzz!"
The moment the Dark Energy Cannon made contact with Shen Yun’s shield.
The emitted dark energy wave enveloped all five of them.
They clearly saw everything around them rapidly disintegrating and disappearing in mid-air.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have been eroded by dark energy, each second, you will suffer erosion effect with 50,000 attack power, the effect lasts for 100 seconds...]
After the purple glow faded.
They saw that a smooth pit appeared on the ground at least several kilometers around.
The surface of this pit appeared as if it had been polished, incredibly smooth.
Shen Yun still stood holding the shield, unharmed.
But Han Xing saw that a mass of purple energy was clinging to Shen Yun’s body, eroding his body.
Not just on Shen Yun, but everyone had dark energy clinging to them.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
The sound like acid erosion kept coming.
Everyone looked at their skin, turning black and purple, eyes full of surprise.
"It’s a bit troublesome, this dark energy’s sustained damage is so terrifying, and it lasts for 100 seconds..."
"Without some tricks, even high-tier demigods would burn alive."
This is the horror of the Dark Energy Cannon.
Its initial explosion is strong enough, but that is not its scariest part.
The most terrifying aspect of the Dark Energy Cannon is its continuous damage.
seconds of sustained damage, if fully endured, equals a solid 5 million damage!
Almost equivalent to the attack of 10 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
At this point, Shen Yun said somewhat shaken, "Brother Xing, it’s a bit troublesome."
"My Purification Technique cannot remove the dark energy from my body."
The crowd was surprised when they heard this.
Han Xing frowned, "Even with your spiritual power, you can’t remove it?"
Cheng Jianyong also asked at this time, "Xiaoyunzi, is your spiritual power insuficient?"
Shen Yun shook his head, "Probably not."
"I think it’s because dark energy is a peculiar form of energy and not a negative state, so it can’t be cleared."
"Otherwise, I should be able to purify it.
Han Xing pondered for a moment and nodded.
He also thought Shen Yun made sense.
"Release divine power and see if it can suppress the dark energy."
Upon hearing this, everyone began to do the same.
Soon, looks of surprise appeared on their faces.
"It really works!"
Cheng Jianyong excitedly said, "Although it hasn’t been completely removed, it has significantly suppressed the damage caused by the dark energy!"
Han Xing nodded upon hearing this.
If dark energy is a form of energy and not a negative state.
Then divine power is also a form of energy.
Thus, the two can counterbalance each other.
When Han Xing also tried releasing divine power.
As golden divine power appeared.
The dark energy attached to the surface of the body disappeared instantly, like ice water on a flame.
At the same time.
Han Xing also saw that the [Dark Energy Erosion] status on his status bar disappeared.
"Oh? It’s actually gone?"
Thinking it over, Han Xing roughly understood the reason.
His divine power quality was too high.
Against the dark energy, it wasn’t suppression, but complete annihilation.
This made things simpler.
At least, the attacks from the Dark Energy Cannon won’t pose much of a threat to them now.
However, at this moment the United Army battlefield was not looking too optimistic.
Above Yuanju City.
The attack just fired by five Dark Energy Cannons.
Affected at least hundreds of thousands of strong soldiers in the United Army.
While Han Xing and his team could withstand the dark energy’s damage.
It doesn’t mean that strong warriors of other races could.
Just one cannon shot took away the lives of tens of thousands of strong warriors.
More of the United Army were still suffering dark energy erosion.
Screams kept ringing.
Seeing this scene.
Han Xing frowned.
"It’s a bit of trouble, the power of these ten dark energy cannons is frightening.
"At this rate, the United Army may be stopped here."
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly realized.
The feeling of other warriors facing the defense towers in his territory.
Cheng Jianyong suggested, "Brother Xing, let’s charge directly forward and destroy those Dark Energy Towers first."
Before he finished speaking.
Around them.
At least a dozen legendary level Abyss Demons and a mass of Abyssal Monsters surged towards them.
This was nearly a third of the strength of the whole Yuanju City battlefield.
Yet they all came to deal with them.
Seeing this scene, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse, "Dammit! They’re all coming at us!"
Obviously.
The Abyssal Monsters of Yuanju City knew the threat posed by Han Xing and his team.
So they dispatched a massive force to hold them up.
Foiling their plans to get to Yuanju City.
Cheng Jianyong swung his sword.
"Swish!"
A kilometer-long Sword Qi appeared.
Knowing Cheng Jianyong’s formidable attack power.
The group of demons frantically dodged.
Then swarmed them on all sides, surrounding them tightly.
"Bang!"
Shen Yun delivered a powerful shield strike, sending a legendary level demon flying.
But immediately, two more legendary demons charged forward.
Vowing to hold Han Xing and his team back.
At the same time.
The Dark Energy Cannons on the city walls had already initiated a second barrage.
"Boom! Boom-boom-boom-boom!"
Purple shells whizzed past.
But their target wasn’t Han Xing and his group, but the strong warriors of other races.
The demons seem to know that the Dark Energy Cannon’s attack was ineffective against these humans.
The explosion of the Dark Energy Cannon brought heavy casualties to the Holy Spirit Realm United Army once again.
The concern appeared in the eyes of everyone...

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 411: Clearing Abyssal Rift Floor 90
paragraphs: Worry appeared in everyone’s eyes.
If this continues, it won’t be long before the Holy Spirit Realm United Army is completely slaughtered.
By then, Han Xing and his team might very likely fail the challenge.
After all, the challenge on the 90th floor is to:
Destroy Yuanju City with the Holy Spirit Realm United Army...
Shen Yun held a shield, single-handedly enduring a group of demon attacks.
And he was still able to spare a glance to check the situation with his teammates.
Shen Yun turned his head, looking at Han Xing who was pulling back the bowstring, and asked, "Brother Xing, what should we do now?"
"If this goes on, the Holy Spirit Realm United Army won’t hold out for long."
Han Xing was also observing the battle.
He knew.
The biggest pressure on the United Army currently comes from the dozen or so dark energy cannons on the city wall.
Only by destroying those dark energy cannons first can the stalemate be broken.
But who should do it?
Although, Han Xing still has cards up his sleeve.
For example, the ultimate skill—Endless Arrow Prison, Sun-Destroying Arrow.
For example, the Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea, and so on...
However, these cards all share a common characteristic, which is a very long cooldown time.
Han Xing wants to be able to repeatedly clear the Abyssal Rift.
Even if they use a trump card to solve the immediate crisis this time.
What about next time?
So, Han Xing decided to find a way to pass the 90th floor of the Abyssal Rift without using any trump cards.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing suddenly brightened up.
He directly said, "Let Coal Ball go."
"Although we are being held up."
"But Little Coal Ball won’t be restrained by this group of monsters."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes brightened again.
Now that you mention it, ever since entering the Abyssal Rift.
No one had seen Coal Ball.
It seemed to have completely disappeared.
But it always inflicted terrifying damage on those legendary level monsters at unexpected moments.
This is naturally because of the passive skill effect awakened by Coal Ball.
It can stay in a state of escaping into the void at all times.
Although invisible, the team members will not overlook Coal Ball’s presence.
Just like now.
Among the legendary level demons attacking them.
A demon’s heart suddenly developed a blood hole that penetrated through front and back.
Its body immediately froze.
Before they could react, another demon’s body was torn apart.
It seemed like it was shredded by the claws of some giant creature!
The Abyss Demons fell into sheer terror.
This invisible enemy is the most terrifying!
At this time, Han Xing used divine power to send commands to Coal Ball.
After receiving Han Xing’s command.
No new demons suddenly died in that area.
The Abyssal Monsters breathed a sigh of relief.
But Han Xing knew that Coal Ball should have gone to execute his command.
Next, once Coal Ball reaches Yuanju City and destroys those dark energy cannons.
The team can launch another attack.
But for now, they could take care of these approaching legendary level demons first.
"Whoosh!"
The arrow shot out.
The battle between the two sides resumed.
Meanwhile.
On the walls of Yuanju City.
A standard demon legion stood beside those dark energy cannons.
Led by a high-tier legendary demon, with two initial-stage legendary demons, and other tier five creatures, forming a defense army.
The demon race left these forces in Yuanju City to protect the dark energy cannons.
They watched the intense battle below.
Tier five dominators, and even legendary level powers, continued to fall!
The vast battlefield was like a meat grinder, devouring more and more powerful beings.
Even legends had limited influence in it.
Such fierce combat made the demon blood within this defense army agitated.
They were inherently destructive creatures.
Now, they could hardly resist the urge to enter the battlefield.
However, due to their mission.
The demons could only stay obediently in place.
Just then.
The demon with high-tier legendary strength seemed to sense something amiss.
It raised its magma battleaxe, scanning around with a puzzled look.
After confirming nothing abnormal, it relaxed.
But in the next moment.
The demons were shocked to find that they were suddenly in a dark space.
This place was rich with the power of the void.
"The void? How did we suddenly end up in the void!"
The demons were filled with disbelief.
"Is it some teleportation skill from a legendary mage of the Holy Spirit Realm?"
"But that’s impossible!"
There are three legendary level creatures among these demons.
To suddenly transport them from the Abyss Realm to the void undetected.
This method is almost unimaginable!
Even a legendary mage proficient in the power of space couldn’t achieve this.
What they didn’t know was.
This was precisely the skill effect of Coal Ball when it evolved to SS-level and gained the talent skill: Void Eternal Night.
In the Void Eternal Night state, Coal Ball could forcefully transform the surrounding space into a void region centered on itself.
Hence, the demons thought they were suddenly teleported into the void.
In fact, they were still in their original location.
Only the space had become void.
Before they could regain their senses.
Suddenly, the entire void filled with dense black threads.
These black threads surged like waves.
The demons instinctively swung their weapons to block.
However, they found these threads seemed to exist in another dimension, penetrating directly into their bodies.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 411: Clearing Abyssal Rift Floor 90 (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Damn it! What are these things?"
As those filaments entered their bodies.
The demons felt their power rapidly draining away.
"My power..."
"Quick, cut off these filaments!"
The demons cried out in panic, urgently unleashing their inner Power of the Demon.
However, no matter how many black filaments they broke.
In the void, more would instantly emerge.
These filaments penetrated everywhere.
Nose, mouth, ears, pores...
"Gulp..."
"Stop... stop stuffing, my body is almost full..."
The demons’ voices sounded pleading.
From this, it was clear they were undergoing some sort of inhuman torment.
And this was naturally the effect of the skill [Void Frenzy].
Not only could it restrain the enemy, it could also absorb their life, potential...
It was extremely terrifying.
Moreover, in the state of Void Eternal Night, Void Frenzy had no cooldown.
This meant that Coal Ball could unleash this powerful skill endlessly.
The demons could only watch helplessly as their power kept depleting.
A few seconds later.
When their power was drained dry.
Suddenly, several gusts of wind came from behind.
As if some terrifying fierce beast was swinging its claws behind them.
"Swish! Swish, swish, swish!"
In the next moment.
Several blood marks appeared on the demons’ bodies at the same time.
Then, they were directly reduced to chunks of meat.
From beginning to end, they didn’t even see who the enemy was, what they looked like.
Just died in the void suffocated.
After these demons died.
Coal Ball appeared near a Dark Energy Cannon.
Then "swish! swish!" slashed with claws.
The Defense Value of the Dark Energy Cannon poured like water,
Han Xing saw the system notifications.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ is absorbing the potential of a Legendary Creature, Potential Value +7123...]
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ is absorbing the potential of a Legendary Creature, Potential Value +6216...]
[Your...]
A series of over a dozen system notifications.
Han Xing then knew that Coal Ball had already taken action.
"From this wave, Coal Ball actually directly increased by 60,000 points of Potential Value..."
"Although, it’s still a long way from reaching ten million Potential Value to rise to SSS-level."
"But this speed is already very fast," Han Xing praised.
Just then.
Han Xing saw a Dark Energy Cannon on the city wall explode with a loud bang.
All the powerful figures on the field looked up, their gaze focused.
When they saw it was a Dark Energy Cannon that exploded.
The shock and panic in the Abyss Demon’s eyes were inversely proportional.
The eyes of the United Army of the Holy Spirit Realm were filled with delight!
"Bless the Clan Leader! The Demon Race’s Dark Energy Cannon was destroyed, who did it?"
"That’s fantastic!"
But Han Xing and others knew clearly that all this was done by Coal Ball.
It not only independently took down three Legendary Level demons.
Also conveniently destroyed the Dark Energy Cannon above.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Little Coal Ball, well done!"
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang also softly exclaimed, "Coal Ball, amazing..."
At the same time.
Not long after the first Dark Energy Cannon was destroyed.
In less than twenty seconds, the second Dark Energy Cannon met the same fate.
Coal Ball’s Void Eternal Night skill could last for 60 seconds.
This meant that within those 60 seconds of duration, Coal Ball could destroy at least three Dark Energy Cannons.
That group of demons also realized that some unknown force was attacking the Dark Energy Cannons.
They immediately ordered, "Deploy troops to protect the other Dark Energy Cannons!"
However, the United Army of the Holy Spirit Realm wasn’t foolish either.
They began unleashing their full power, putting tremendous pressure on the Abyss Legion.
Making the Abyssal Monsters unable to dispatch forces to support the Demon Guard Army on the city walls.
A few minutes later.
All eleven Dark Energy Cannons were declared scrapped.
The eyes of the Holy Spirit Realm United Army lit up.
Because they knew the moment for counterattack had finally arrived.
"Boom!"
The giant directly transformed into berserk form, its body soaring to nearly ten thousand meters!
"Boom!"
With one axe swing, countless Abyssal Monsters were smashed away!
"Brothers, follow me to kill!"
With that, he stepped forward with mountain-like sturdy legs, charging towards Yuanju City.
The other strong figures of the Holy Spirit Realm also began their charge.
"Charge!"
"Roar!"
The Abyssal Monster Legion, after initial chaos, quickly stabilized their formation.
They were doing their utmost to resist the impact of the United Army of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Seeing the situation about to stalemate again.
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng suddenly appeared in mid-air.
Han Xing and others guarded her side.
She swung the Magic Staff in her hand.
An extremely terrifying wave of Fire Element appeared.
In the next moment.
The dark sky of the Holy Spirit Realm was illuminated once more.
Endless fire rain fell down.
It was precisely Zhang Lianmeng’s Forbidden Curse—Heaven-Burning Fire Rain.
The effect of this strike was even comparable to Han Xing’s Fallen Star Arrow Rain.
The terrifying flames fell, crashing into the Abyssal Monster Army.
Countless monsters wailed.
The ground seemed to have been plowed over and over by a meteor fire rain.
Everywhere were huge flaming craters.
After the fire rain dissipated.
The United Army eagerly watched the scene before them.
Over ten million Abyssal Monsters, under this strike, directly turned to dust.
On the battlefield, the number of monsters visibly decreased.
Eagerly they rushed forward again.
With the repeated aid of Han Xing and them.
The charge of the United Army was now completely unstoppable!
The Abyssal Monsters were blown to pieces as they retreated step by step!
In no time, they were forced to the foot of Yuanju City’s wall.
"Rumble!"
Legendary Mage of the Elf Race hurled Large Fireballs one after another.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 411: Clearing Abyssal Rift Floor 90 (Part 3)
paragraphs: The next moment.
The iron gate of Yuanju City was on the verge of collapse from the bombing.
With a loud explosion.
The iron gate of Yuanju City completely collapsed.
The United Army began to furiously flood into Yuanju City.
At this moment.
The central square inside Yuanju City was already filled with the strong from various races.
They engaged in close combat within.
Some strong ones flew onto the city walls and fought against those Great Demon Monarchs.
The fires of war spread everywhere.
Even Han Xing and the others charged into the city.
At this moment, someone shouted aloud.
"Look overhead, that’s where the teleportation array of Yuanju City is."
Upon hearing these words.
Everyone simultaneously lifted their heads.
Then, they saw a massive teleportation array floating in mid-air.
That teleportation array was continuously transporting abyssal monsters over.
Abyssal monsters surged out from the teleportation array like a fountain.
At this moment, someone shouted aloud: "Follow me to attack into the sky."
"Destroy the teleportation array of Yuanju City!"
Countless strong individuals began rushing into the sky.
However, at this moment.
Four or five fiery red meteors fell from the sky.
These meteors carried the power of heaven and earth destruction.
Directly crashing into Yuanju City, causing an earth-shattering explosion!
"Boom!"
Four or five mushroom clouds rose.
When everyone fixed their eyes.
Four or five demigod-level Great Demon Monarchs appeared abruptly.
Judging by the strength of their aura, only slightly weaker than Julius.
They looked at the Holy Spirit Realm United Army with disdain in their eyes.
"Unexpectedly, you ants really made it here!"
"And almost destroyed our race’s teleportation array!"
"A bit capable, but this is the end for you."
"Next, you shall all, together with your faith, rest here forever!"
At this moment.
Three strong individuals stepped out from the United Army.
A dwarf, a giant, and an elf.
These are the three major races of the Holy Spirit Realm.
All three of these strong individuals actually had demigod-level combat power!
"Ugly demons, stop bragging."
"We came this time to destroy Yuanju City’s teleportation array, so you will never easily invade the Holy Spirit Realm again!"
The Demon Monarchs showed surprise in their eyes.
"Interesting, surprisingly hid three demigods."
"However, you seem to have a slight shortage in numbers."
The next moment.
Five Great Demon Monarchs charged towards the three demigods of the Holy Spirit Realm.
The strong from both sides fought together.
Han Xing and the others knew this was the final battle of Yuanju City.
"Quick battle, kill these demigod-level demons."
Everyone nodded simultaneously.
The next moment.
Shen Yun suddenly raised the Holy Hammer in his hand.
Then, a brilliant holy light burst from his hammer.
And it ascended towards the sky.
At this moment, all allies of the United Army felt a strong amplification!
Meanwhile.
Zhang Lianmeng waved her magic staff.
An extremely terrifying wave of ice element appeared.
Then, all abyssal monsters within a radius of hundreds of thousands of meters were covered with a layer of ice crystals.
Including those five demigod-level demons!
Then, there were Han Xing’s arrows, Su Xiaoyang’s vines.
And Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi.
This burst caught everyone off guard.
They originally thought that these humans’ previous performance was already terrifying enough.
But they now realized it was just the tip of the iceberg.
"Crack! Crack!"
The ice crystals shattered.
Frozen blood mist danced.
When those five demigod-level demons noticed Han Xing and the group, it was already too late.
Because the three demigods of the Holy Spirit Realm also realized this was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
They shone brightly, concentrating all their strength, and delivered their strongest strike.
"Boom!
This was the full force strike of Han Xing’s five, along with the three demigods!
The terrifying energy surge.
Engulfed millions of abyssal monsters around, tearing them into pieces.
When the energy surge faded away.
The rocky bodies of the five demigod-level demons, having endured such a powerful attack, were covered in countless cracks.
Even about to explode into fragments.
At this moment, a demigod-level demon said unwillingly.
"Damn it, you were hiding experts!"
"Even if you kill us and destroy the teleportation array, so what?"
"The advance of the Abyss Race cannot be stopped!"
"The Holy Spirit Realm will inevitably become our territory, hahaha!"
Amid the laughter of these demons.
And then crumbled into fragments.
Han Xing and the others heard a system prompt.
[Successfully killed Demon Monarch·Spectime, demigod-level creature, gained 13.724 billion experience points, automatically absorbed the enemy’s divine power value, divine power value +100...]
[Successfully killed Demon Monarch Emermar...]
A series of three system prompts appeared.
The group gained over 40 billion experience points and an additional 300 divine power points!
The other two demigod-level demons were killed by the three demigod-level powerhouses of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Feeling the rapidly growing divine power within.
The five showed joyful smiles on their faces simultaneously.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow, it would be great if every time we cleared Abyssal Rift’s 90th level, we could gain this much divine power."
"It won’t be long before we can directly break through 10,000 divine power!"
Of course, Cheng Jianyong could only think.
Such opportunities only exist when clearing Abyssal Rift for the first time and killing the monsters inside.
Subsequently killing these demigod-level demons would only give experience points, not divine power.
Meanwhile.
Everyone looked up at the massive teleportation array in the sky.
The mission objective stated that destroying the teleportation array meant completing the Abyssal Rift 90th level challenge.
So, Han Xing unhesitatingly drew the bowstring.
Then, an arrow was shot!
"Boom!"
Under everyone’s watch,
that massive teleportation array was destroyed.
Then, a system prompt appeared.
[Abyssal Rift 90th level challenge completed, this battle took 31 minutes and 17 seconds, breaking the fastest challenge record for this level.]

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 412: First Clear Reward: Divine Demon Battleship!
paragraphs: [Abyssal Rift 90th level challenge has been completed, the battle took 31 minutes and 17 seconds, setting a new fastest completion record for this level.]
[In the Yuanju City defense battle, you have made outstanding contributions, battle merit is being tallied...]
[In this battle, you cumulatively killed: 3 Demigod-level creatures, 27 Legendary-level creatures, 40.32 million other Abyssal Monsters, destroyed eleven Dark Energy Cannons...]
[Comprehensive rating: S-level.]
[Your team receives settlement rewards: 44.1 billion Experience Points, Abyssal Seal *20, Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest *1]
Upon hearing the long system prompts.
Everyone’s pupils showed a strong expression of surprise and joy.
They didn’t expect that the rewards for the 90th level would be settled like this.
Unexpectedly, they based the rewards on their contributions in the war.
"Interesting."
Han Xing said with a slight surprise: "They actually evaluate us based on our kills and other contributions, and then give corresponding rewards."
Shen Yun also said in surprise: "Yeah, this mechanism is quite different from the previous challenges."
However, Cheng Jianyong was somewhat puzzled.
"Brother Xing, we’ve made such a great contribution this time, and it’s only an S-level rating?"
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing replied, "It’s normal, after all, we didn’t kill two of the Demigod-level demons, the United Army also put in a lot of effort."
"Getting an S-level rating is already quite good."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong nodded in realization.
At this moment.
The battlefield had come to a standstill.
Within the Holy Spirit Realm United Army, the shadows of those powerful figures gradually dissipated.
At the moment of disappearing, they seemed to have realized something.
They showed a look of sudden enlightenment in their eyes.
Han Xing heard a Legendary Mage of the Elf Race whisper, "So that’s it... I died in that battle 1200 years ago."
"But because of some power, I came back to life, and fought again."
"That’s not so bad after all..."
"I just don’t know if this is a reward or a punishment..."
When those strong figures had all disappeared.
Yuanju City returned to the appearance it had when they first saw it.
Weathered walls, broken gates, fully displaying its age.
Everyone continued to wait for the system prompt.
Because this was their first time clearing the 90th level of the Abyssal Rift.
According to the system’s mechanism, there should be a first-clear reward.

[You have completed the challenge of the 90th level in the Abyssal Rift. Since you are the first to clear the 90th level, you receive a first-clear reward: Abyssal Seal *100, Divine Demon Battleship Blueprint *1.]
Wow!
Divine Demon Battleship?
The blueprint, just hearing the name sounds awesome!
Han Xing was excited and wanted to check the attributes of this battleship.
Before they could check the attributes of this new blueprint.
The system prompt appeared again.
[Due to the damage to the Teleportation Array in Yuanju City, the next 10 levels of the Abyssal Rift located in the Abyss Realm are not yet open, so further challenges are not possible...]
[Survivors, you have temporarily reached the end of the Abyssal Rift...]
Upon hearing this prompt, everyone looked at each other with puzzled expressions.
"Huh? Does this mean we’ve already cleared it?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
After thinking for a moment, they confirmed that this guess was true.
They had indeed reached the end of the Abyss!
At this moment, Shen Yun asked somewhat confusedly, "The next 10 levels are not open yet, when will they be open?"
Other people also felt puzzled and clueless.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing said, "I don’t know, but if they’re not open, they’re not open."
"Anyway, the rewards from the 90th level are already quite high."
"Later, we’ll continue from the 80th level to the 90th level, each time we can at least increase our Experience Points by 10%."
"The leveling up speed is still very fast."
As Han Xing estimated.
They now take at least 4 hours from the 80th level to the 90th level in one go.
This benefit is considered quite good.
Everyone nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
At this moment, looking at the pile of blueprints and items in his backpack, Han Xing’s mood began to get excited.
He still had many rewards to digest.
So Han Xing said, "Let’s go, let’s get out for a while."
"We’ll come back to continue the challenge later."
Everyone nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
Then they stepped into the Teleportation Array.
In front of them, a flash of light.
Everyone returned to the Holy Spirit Realm.
Han Xing checked the time, they had entered the Abyssal Rift in the morning, and when they emerged, the Sun was already overhead.
They had spent almost 6 hours.
Going from the 70th level all the way to the end of the Abyssal Rift.
Finally stopping at the Sea of Lava.
The next part was the moment everyone had been eagerly anticipating: the tallying of the harvest.
levels of battle.
They collected a total of 23 pieces of Epic Equipment, one Divine Artifact.
Additionally, there were two blueprints, plus one Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest.
The first thing everyone focused on, naturally, was this treasure chest.
After all, opening a chest is an irresistible temptation for players.
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Brother Xing, what’s the treasure chest used for, let us take a look."
Han Xing nodded and then took the treasure chest out of his backpack.
"Clang!"
The heavy treasure chest landed on the ground of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Compared to the Sun Treasure Chests from the Battle Merit Store, with their bright red exterior.
This Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest had a black metallic luster, appearing extremely profound.
Shen Yun curiously said, "The Sun Treasure Chest, with the prefix Abyssal, what can you get from it?"
Then, they all checked the attributes of this Sun Treasure Chest together.

[Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest]: You can open the chest to obtain Shadow of Darkness (Leather Armor), Executioner’s Hand (Light Armor), Flame of the Tyrant (Cloth Armor), Giant God Stone (Heavy Armor) series, Abyssal Demon Artifact Set...
