In front of them, a flash of light.
Everyone returned to the Holy Spirit Realm.
Han Xing checked the time, they had entered the Abyssal Rift in the morning, and when they emerged, the Sun was already overhead.
They had spent almost 6 hours.
Going from the 70th level all the way to the end of the Abyssal Rift.
Finally stopping at the Sea of Lava.
The next part was the moment everyone had been eagerly anticipating: the tallying of the harvest.
levels of battle.
They collected a total of 23 pieces of Epic Equipment, one Divine Artifact.
Additionally, there were two blueprints, plus one Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest.
The first thing everyone focused on, naturally, was this treasure chest.
After all, opening a chest is an irresistible temptation for players.
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Brother Xing, what’s the treasure chest used for, let us take a look."
Han Xing nodded and then took the treasure chest out of his backpack.
"Clang!"
The heavy treasure chest landed on the ground of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Compared to the Sun Treasure Chests from the Battle Merit Store, with their bright red exterior.
This Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest had a black metallic luster, appearing extremely profound.
Shen Yun curiously said, "The Sun Treasure Chest, with the prefix Abyssal, what can you get from it?"
Then, they all checked the attributes of this Sun Treasure Chest together.

[Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest]: You can open the chest to obtain Shadow of Darkness (Leather Armor), Executioner’s Hand (Light Armor), Flame of the Tyrant (Cloth Armor), Giant God Stone (Heavy Armor) series, Abyssal Demon Artifact Set...

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 412: First Clear Reward: Divine Demon Battleship!_2
paragraphs: "Abyssal Magical Artifact Set?"
Everyone was a bit puzzled.
Cheng Jianyong asked skeptically, "What’s an Abyssal Magical Artifact? Never heard of it?"
"It’s something opened from the Sun Treasure Chest, the attributes should be pretty good, right?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Not sure, let’s open it and see."
With that said.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate and opened it directly.
A towering black light surged up.
Inside the treasure chest, Han Xing saw a black magic robe, with faint red magma patterns flowing on it.
And beneath the cloak, lay many Philosopher’s Stones, and several black hexagonal stones...
Han Xing collected everything inside the treasure chest.
[Successfully opened the Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest, obtained Philosopher’s Stone *124, obtained Abyssal Seal *6, obtained Tyrant’s Flame Robe...]
"Magic Robe?"
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of this cloak appeared.
[Tyrant’s Flame Robe lv60, Quality: Abyssal Magical Artifact, Armor: 2327~2516, Spirit +5000, Constitution +2000]
[Attached Effect]: High-level Burn Reduction, Flame Sacrifice, Tyrant’s Fury, Tyrant’s Authority!

Note: Can be combined with Tyrant’s Flame Lower Armor, Helmet, Wrist Guard, and Boots to form the Tyrant’s Flame Set Effect, three-piece set attribute: all element damage increased by 33%, five-piece set attribute: all elemental attack damage increased by 55%, and reduces cooldown by 50% (not effective for ultimate skills).
"So strong!"
After viewing the attributes of this equipment.
Everyone sincerely exclaimed in admiration!
This magic robe, if equipped on Zhang Lianmeng, would significantly enhance her damage output.
And more importantly, this is just the attributes of a single magic robe.
Bear in mind, the Abyssal Magical Artifact Set has four more parts.
By then, once all five pieces are gathered.
Zhang Lianmeng’s attack will surely undergo a terrifying transformation!
At this moment, Han Xing remembered that he still had a divine artifact-level necklace in his backpack.
This necklace not only increased two thousand points in Constitution and Spirit, but also had many magic damage amplification effects.
Especially the last divine-level effect: Power of Royal Authority.
Within 120 seconds, for every enemy killed, 1 point of Spiritual Power is increased.
With the mage’s attack range and damage.
It would only take about a minute to accumulate tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands of Spiritual Power.
By then, Zhang Lianmeng might even outstrip Han Xing in attack power.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly tossed the sparkling gem necklace in his hand to Zhang Lianmeng.
Just in time, her level was almost there too.
After Zhang Lianmeng accepted it, she slightly opened her mouth, exclaiming,
"A divine artifact... necklace..."
"Such strong attributes."
After saying that, Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing hesitantly.
Han Xing nodded, "Take it, it was prepared for you."
Hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng also nodded, no longer declining.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong was suddenly enlightened, "So that’s it, the Abyssal Magical Artifact is equivalent to the Holy Spirit Realm’s divine artifact level equipment."
"And it includes all four types of armor!"
"Damn, which means, we don’t even need to bother with the lower levels of the Abyssal Rifts now."
"We can just keep farming the 90th level of the Abyssal Rifts!"
"Soon, by farming seven or eight Abyssal Sun Treasure Chests a day, it won’t take long for all of us to be equipped with divine artifact sets!"
After hearing Cheng Jianyong’s analysis, everyone seemed to realize this.
At this moment, everyone’s breathing became a bit rushed.
They couldn’t wait to continue exploring the Abyssal Rifts and get the full set of divine artifacts!
Han Xing then smiled and said, "It’s not that simple."
"According to this calculation, in order to get the Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest, each of our evaluations must reach S-level each time."
"And, 4 types of sets, about 20 pieces in total."
"To open them all, it will probably take a long time."
Everyone nodded.
They didn’t overthink because of the long duration.
After all, they were originally prepared for a prolonged battle in the Abyssal Rifts.
At this point, Shen Yun seemed to remember something.
"By the way, Brother Xing, didn’t you say that the Trickster God’s treasury is hidden on the 90th level of the Abyssal Rifts?"
"Did we forget something this time?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was briefly stunned.
Then he slapped his thigh and exclaimed, "Oh crap, I really forgot!"
Everyone glanced at each other.
Han Xing then said, "Whatever, we still have to go into the Abyssal Rifts many more times."
"Exploring the Trickster God’s treasury another time isn’t too late."
Everyone nodded together.
Then, Han Xing began examining his other newly acquired reward.
Divine Demon Battleship Blueprint.
[Divine Demon Battleship Blueprint]: Top technology of the Abyss Race! Can be used to construct a Divine Demon Battleship that integrates both mobility and lethality through materials.
[Ship Length]: 174.38 kilometers
[Ship Width]: 16.24 kilometers
[Warship-mounted Cannons]: A maximum of 874 cannons can be mounted on each side. Types of cannons: Dark Energy Cannon, Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, Sunset Nether River Cannon...
[Main Cannon]: The battleship comes with 2 main cannons, one in the front and one in the back.
Note: The battleship’s main cannon has an attack power of 5 million, with a long cooldown time for each use.

[Warship Power]: Demon God-level Power Core, capable of achieving long-distance teleportation effects, with an extreme teleportation distance of 12.74 million kilometers, cooldown time of 500 seconds.
After reading through the attributes of this battleship blueprint.
Han Xing was deeply shocked for a long time.
"Oh my... it really is a battleship!"
"This firepower intensity, and teleportation effect, is just too damn terrifying!"
The main cannon’s attack power is a full five million, even surpassing the Catastrophe-level Defense Tower and high-tier ancient weapons under the augmentation of the Sun Crown Stele!

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 412: First Clear Reward: Divine Demon Battleship!_3
paragraphs: Plus, a teleportation distance of over 12 million kilometers.
It’s simply an invincible weapon of mass destruction!
At this moment, a doubt rose in Han Xing’s mind.
That is, whether this battleship can receive the Holy Artifact Sun Crown Stele’s augmentation?
If it could, then he wouldn’t need any Godslayer-level weapon!
Just the firepower of this battleship’s main cannon alone is already ten times that of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon!
With the augmentation of two Sun Crown Steles, it would definitely rival the power of Godslayer-level weapons, possibly even surpass them!
Just then.
Han Xing noticed a note at the bottom of the blueprint.
Note: The Demon God Battleship is a mobility technology; augmentation items related to territories are only effective within a 10,000-kilometer range.
"Damn! Of course, it doesn’t work."
After reading this note, Han Xing’s eyes showed a look of inevitability.
"However, although it can’t provide permanent augmentation, as long as the battleship is near my territory, it can also enjoy the augmentation effect, which is already quite good."
After all, on the Demon God Battleship, those two main cannons are still very formidable.
They have already surpassed the high-tier ancient weapons and catastrophe-level weapons in his territory.
They can be used as Han Xing’s new trump card.
Thinking of this, Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
With a nervous heart, Han Xing checked the construction materials for this Demon God Battleship.

[Materials required to construct the Divine Demon Battleship]: Philosopher’s Stone*1 million, Rhythm Black Iron*8 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*100,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*500,000, Calamity Divine Gold*20,000, Abyssal Seal*100, Demon God’s Heart*1, Permanent Gold Ingot, Mithril...
Looking at this long list of materials.
Han Xing rolled his eyes.
The consumption is simply terrifying.
Excluding the Ancient Elf Secret Ingot and Demon God’s Heart, which he hasn’t seen yet.
Just the other materials alone would be enough to completely deplete a major clan’s accumulation to build a single Demon God Battleship.
Han Xing glanced at his warehouse.
With his own resources, he could at least build...
One, two, three, four...
Uh, surprisingly enough to build dozens...
Looking at the materials in his warehouse, Han Xing suddenly burst into laughter.
"Didn’t realize, unknowingly, I actually stockpiled this many materials."
"It’s truly my hard work."
Han Xing shamelessly sighed.
Completely forgetting that most of these materials were scavenged from the Insect Race’s ruins.
"The Divine Demon Battleship can’t be built just yet, but we can first look at the effect of the Dark Energy Cannon."
Then, Han Xing checked the construction materials for the Dark Energy Cannon.
[Materials required to construct the Dark Energy Cannon]: Philosopher’s Stone*8,000, Shadow Divine Stone*20,000, Abyssal Magic Stone*50,000, Calamity Divine Gold*20
The variety and quantity of materials needed for this are much more normal.
With Han Xing’s current resources, except for the Abyssal Magic Stone not being plentiful in reserves.
He can pull up a hundred units at once!
Having experienced the terror of this technology.
Han Xing didn’t hesitate to immediately pull up a hundred units!
"Buzz!"
A circle of purple smoke instantly appeared around the Ten Thousand Stars City territory.
System prompt appeared.
[Construction in progress, remaining time 31 hours 27 minutes...]
After doing all of this.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
Then, he and his team members continued to enter the Abyssal Rift.
Meanwhile.
A few survivors also entered the Abyssal Rift.
Now, the Abyssal Rift region is considered a relatively popular dungeon among survivors.
Every day, many survivors enter the Abyssal Rift, bringing out various opportunities.
These opportunities include the Philosopher’s Stone, Abyssal Magic Stone, and various equipment, etc...
Especially some exclusive sets in the Abyss Realm.
Until now, survivors only realized that sets can appear in the Abyssal Rift.
Before this.
They could only obtain equipment from various treasure chests and some wild Sky Island monsters.
What they got were all scattered pieces.
Although the attributes were also powerful, compared to sets, the gap is still immense.
According to survivors’ calculations.
A complete set of Golden Equipment, accounting for set attributes, could even compare to wearing a full set of epic scattered pieces for a survivor!
So, a large number of survivors began to flood into the Abyssal Rift, hoping for a lucky break to assemble a Golden Set!
And as the entry ticket to the rift, the price of Strong Fragment naturally follows suit, rising to prices that ordinary survivors can hardly afford.
So, to avoid wasting Strong Fragments.
Every time survivors enter, they choose to spend more time and start challenging from level 1.
At this moment.
A team of survivors above level 40, equipped with refined gear, entered the Abyssal Rift.
Among them, Han Xing recognized one female mage.
It was Tangxin Mumu who interviewed him once before.
Now, she continues to run her All Gods Daily, occasionally taking time to dungeon crawl with her team, killing monsters, and whatnot.
The All Gods Daily’s daily viewership is over a hundred million, providing her quite substantial income.
So, not lacking in resources.
Tangxin Mumu has also kept up in level, always staying just behind the first tier.
At this moment, a survivor in the team called Don’t Beat Cucumber said: "Sister Mu Mu, last time we stopped at the 43rd level."
"This time, we’ve invited the great Zhang Jian, he’ll surely help us get through the 43rd level!"
"Who knows, he might even lead us straight to the 45th level."
Tangxin Mumu lifted her beautiful eyes, glancing at the tall Berserker in the team.

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 413: Abdullah’s Magma Pillar
paragraphs: Zhang Jian, at level 45, possesses formidable strength.
He is among the most powerful survivors, second only to top-tier experts like Luo Chan and Dragon Abyss.
He can be considered a top-tier fighter.
Seeing Tangxin Mumu looking over.
Zhang Jian tried to squeeze out a gentle smile on his somewhat serious face.
"Don’t worry, Mumu, as long as I’m here, we can definitely make it to the 45th floor,"
Zhang Jian reassured Tangxin Mumu, patting his chest.
Tangxin Mumu responded with a polite smile.
At this moment, that smile almost melted Zhang Jian’s heart.
Zhang Jian mustered up the courage and said, "Um, Mumu..."
Tangxin Mumu looked up at him with a puzzled expression.
"What is it?"
"Well, after this Abyssal Rift concludes, do you see when you might have some time for us to go to the Witch Race Main City... for a stroll?"
After saying this, a tint of blood appeared on Zhang Jian’s rough face, seeming extremely shy.
Tangxin Mumu’s smile suddenly froze.
However, the teammates around them caught Zhang Jian’s implications and started to jeer.
Under Zhang Jian’s hopeful gaze, a trace of a bitter smile appeared in Tangxin Mumu’s eyes.
She shook her head and said, "I’m really sorry, Captain Zhang Jian."
"The All Gods Daily business is so busy, I can only squeeze in time to level up with the team now."
"Really sorry."
These words amounted to a rejection of Zhang Jian’s invitation.
Having said this, she gave him a slight bow.
The smiles on the teammates’ faces froze, seemingly not knowing how to diffuse the situation.
Although they knew Tangxin Mumu had a direct personality.
This time, they had a hard time inviting this powerhouse, Zhang Jian, over.
If she directly refuses now, what if he decides not to help them continue challenging the Abyssal Rift?
Zhang Jian awkwardly scratched his head and said, "No... no problem..."
"Mumu, just contact me whenever you have time.
Zhang Jian seemed quite easy to talk to.
The teammates all breathed a sigh of relief as well.
The survivor called Don’t Beat Cucumber came forward to smooth things over and said, "Sister Mu Mu is really busy, Brother Zhang Jian, don’t take it to heart."
With that, he pulled Zhang Jian aside to chat.
At this time, a female teammate came next to Tangxin Mumu and softly comforted her, "Sister Mu Mu, it’s okay."
Tangxin Mumu nodded, a faint bitter smile stirring in her heart.
A reminiscent expression flashed through her mind.
It has been more than two years since arriving in this world.
She, Tangxin Mumu, relying on her own abilities, had achieved some accomplishments.
Now, among human survivors, she was considered a notable figure.
Coupled with her pleasant looks, she had many admirers.
This Zhang Jian was naturally among them.
Among the survivors, this Zhang Jian indeed stood out.
Not only did he have a private residence in Xingyu City, but he also became a squad leader in the Witch Race army through his abilities.
However, Tangxin Mumu couldn’t muster any interest.
Since in her heart, the silhouette of that man would occasionally appear.
Tangxin Mumu murmured in her heart, "You haven’t appeared in front of us for so long..."
"By now, you should have reached an even higher realm, right?"
The person she referred to, of course, was Han Xing.
It must be said, she wasn’t that familiar with Han Xing.
But Han Xing’s brilliance was simply too dazzling.
Since arriving in this world, this man had repeatedly created miracles.
He not only saved humanity from the brink of annihilation.
Now, he had brought all humanity to the Witch Race Territory, giving them a place to live again.
No matter how little you pay attention, his name would still surface in your ears occasionally.
Tangxin Mumu looked at that name in her friend list, yet she never dared to contact him first.
She sighed.
She could only bury this thought in her heart.
At this moment, a teammate suddenly said, "We struggled so hard just to reach over 40 floors."
"But the Star God team had cleared 70 floors more than a year ago."
"It’s really incomparable!"
The other teammates nodded in agreement.
"Indeed."
"However, since the Star God cleared the 70th floor, there hasn’t been any further action.
"It seems the difficulty beyond the Abyssal Rift isn’t ordinary if even a powerhouse like the Star God has been stuck for so long."
Other team members nodded. "The deeper into the Abyssal Rift you go, the harder it gets."
"Now, apart from the Star God, the highest team is Dragon Abyss."
"They’ve already reached the 49th floor and are about to challenge the 50th floor."
At this time, Don’t Beat Cucumber also came over and said, "Dragon Abyss, should be the strongest survivor team besides the Star God, right?"
Others pondered for a moment and nodded.
"Should be, before the strongest under the Star God were Boundless and Zhou Huang."
"But ever since everyone arrived at the Witch Race Territory, those two vanished without a trace."
"If those two were around, maybe they would’ve already cleared the 50th floor..."
Yet, that was clearly not possible.
Zhou Huang was taken away by that mysterious woman, whereabouts unknown.
As for Boundless, even Han Xing didn’t know where he had gone.
At this time.
A curious teammate walked over to the Brave Monument on the first floor.
Upon seeing the ranking changes on the monument, he was immediately astonished!
"Oh my, look everyone!"
"The Star God has made a move, he actually cleared the 90th floor directly! Oh my God!"

sentences.text: Zhang Jian, at level 45, possesses formidable strength.
He is among the most powerful survivors, second only to top-tier experts like Luo Chan and Dragon Abyss.
He can be considered a top-tier fighter.
Seeing Tangxin Mumu looking over.
Zhang Jian tried to squeeze out a gentle smile on his somewhat serious face.
"Don’t worry, Mumu, as long as I’m here, we can definitely make it to the 45th floor,"
Zhang Jian reassured Tangxin Mumu, patting his chest.
Tangxin Mumu responded with a polite smile.
At this moment, that smile almost melted Zhang Jian’s heart.
Zhang Jian mustered up the courage and said, "Um, Mumu..."
Tangxin Mumu looked up at him with a puzzled expression.
"What is it?"
"Well, after this Abyssal Rift concludes, do you see when you might have some time for us to go to the Witch Race Main City... for a stroll?"
After saying this, a tint of blood appeared on Zhang Jian’s rough face, seeming extremely shy.
Tangxin Mumu’s smile suddenly froze.
However, the teammates around them caught Zhang Jian’s implications and started to jeer.
Under Zhang Jian’s hopeful gaze, a trace of a bitter smile appeared in Tangxin Mumu’s eyes.
She shook her head and said, "I’m really sorry, Captain Zhang Jian."
"The All Gods Daily business is so busy, I can only squeeze in time to level up with the team now."
"Really sorry."
These words amounted to a rejection of Zhang Jian’s invitation.
Having said this, she gave him a slight bow.
The smiles on the teammates’ faces froze, seemingly not knowing how to diffuse the situation.
Although they knew Tangxin Mumu had a direct personality.
This time, they had a hard time inviting this powerhouse, Zhang Jian, over.
If she directly refuses now, what if he decides not to help them continue challenging the Abyssal Rift?
Zhang Jian awkwardly scratched his head and said, "No... no problem..."
"Mumu, just contact me whenever you have time.
Zhang Jian seemed quite easy to talk to.
The teammates all breathed a sigh of relief as well.
The survivor called Don’t Beat Cucumber came forward to smooth things over and said, "Sister Mu Mu is really busy, Brother Zhang Jian, don’t take it to heart."
With that, he pulled Zhang Jian aside to chat.
At this time, a female teammate came next to Tangxin Mumu and softly comforted her, "Sister Mu Mu, it’s okay."
Tangxin Mumu nodded, a faint bitter smile stirring in her heart.
A reminiscent expression flashed through her mind.
It has been more than two years since arriving in this world.
She, Tangxin Mumu, relying on her own abilities, had achieved some accomplishments.
Now, among human survivors, she was considered a notable figure.
Coupled with her pleasant looks, she had many admirers.
This Zhang Jian was naturally among them.
Among the survivors, this Zhang Jian indeed stood out.
Not only did he have a private residence in Xingyu City, but he also became a squad leader in the Witch Race army through his abilities.
However, Tangxin Mumu couldn’t muster any interest.
Since in her heart, the silhouette of that man would occasionally appear.
Tangxin Mumu murmured in her heart, "You haven’t appeared in front of us for so long..."
"By now, you should have reached an even higher realm, right?"
The person she referred to, of course, was Han Xing.
It must be said, she wasn’t that familiar with Han Xing.
But Han Xing’s brilliance was simply too dazzling.
Since arriving in this world, this man had repeatedly created miracles.
He not only saved humanity from the brink of annihilation.
Now, he had brought all humanity to the Witch Race Territory, giving them a place to live again.
No matter how little you pay attention, his name would still surface in your ears occasionally.
Tangxin Mumu looked at that name in her friend list, yet she never dared to contact him first.
She sighed.
She could only bury this thought in her heart.
At this moment, a teammate suddenly said, "We struggled so hard just to reach over 40 floors."
"But the Star God team had cleared 70 floors more than a year ago."
"It’s really incomparable!"
The other teammates nodded in agreement.
"Indeed."
"However, since the Star God cleared the 70th floor, there hasn’t been any further action.
"It seems the difficulty beyond the Abyssal Rift isn’t ordinary if even a powerhouse like the Star God has been stuck for so long."
Other team members nodded.
"The deeper into the Abyssal Rift you go, the harder it gets."
"Now, apart from the Star God, the highest team is Dragon Abyss."
"They’ve already reached the 49th floor and are about to challenge the 50th floor."
At this time, Don’t Beat Cucumber also came over and said, "Dragon Abyss, should be the strongest survivor team besides the Star God, right?"
Others pondered for a moment and nodded.
"Should be, before the strongest under the Star God were Boundless and Zhou Huang."
"But ever since everyone arrived at the Witch Race Territory, those two vanished without a trace."
"If those two were around, maybe they would’ve already cleared the 50th floor..."
Yet, that was clearly not possible.
Zhou Huang was taken away by that mysterious woman, whereabouts unknown.
As for Boundless, even Han Xing didn’t know where he had gone.
At this time.
A curious teammate walked over to the Brave Monument on the first floor.
Upon seeing the ranking changes on the monument, he was immediately astonished!
"Oh my, look everyone!"
"The Star God has made a move, he actually cleared the 90th floor directly!
Oh my God!"

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 413: Abdullah’s Magma Pillar_2
paragraphs: "What?!"
Upon hearing this, the team members were immediately shocked.
After all, they were just discussing how the 70th floor had stalled Han Xing and his team for over a year.
Yet in the blink of an eye, others had soared directly to the 90th floor!
This was truly unbelievable!
With eyes full of disbelief, they all gathered around the stone monument.
Including Tangxin Mumu, who also walked towards the Heroic Monument.
And at the top of the monument, indeed, were the names of Han Xing and the others, along with the floor they cleared.
At this moment, everyone gasped.
"Hiss! They really cleared the 90th floor!"
"Terrifying!"
"I thought that after the Star God broke through to Legend, the momentum would slow slightly, but now it seems we overestimated it."
"The Star God is someone without limits!"
Listening to the team’s admiration for that man.
A genuine smile appeared on Tangxin Mumu’s face.
Then, a sense of powerlessness surged in her heart once again.
"You’re flying faster and faster..."
"It seems that in this lifetime, I will never be able to stand by your side..."
At this time, the team members noticed something off about Tangxin Mumu’s state.
Don’t Beat Cucumber asked, "Sister Mu Mu, what’s wrong? Are you feeling unwell?"
Tangxin Mumu took a deep breath, then shook her head, saying, "I’m fine."
"Now, you guys, turn on the recording and photo functions to provide me with some material."
"Currently, information about the Star God clearing the 90th floor of the Abyssal Rift should not have been discovered by other players."
"We need to be the first to publish detailed information on this."
"And then, to provide higher popularity for our All Gods Daily."
Upon listening, the team members were astonished at Tangxin Mumu.
They all knew that among the survivors, the one with the highest popularity was naturally Han Xing.
Any news about him could attract a large number of clicks.
Tangxin Mumu realized this in an instant.
The team members couldn’t help but give her a thumbs up, saying, "As expected of Sister Mu Mu, thinking of so much so quickly!"
"Indeed! Sister Mu Mu was able to set up All Gods Daily through her own abilities."
Off to the side, Zhang Jian looked at Tangxin Mumu with eyes full of admiration.
However, he realized that she didn’t seem to have any interest in him.
Thinking of this, a sense of defeat rose in Zhang Jian’s heart.
Meanwhile.
A post swiftly appeared in All Gods Daily.
"After One and a Half Years of Stagnation, the Star God Returns as a King, Speed Clears the Abyssal Rift 90-floor!"
The striking headline instantly drew the attention of countless survivors.
And when they clicked on the post.
Seeing the names of Han Xing and others on the Brave Monument, they exclaimed immediately.
"Damn! No wonder it’s the Star God; what a massive move right from the start!"
"So awesome! I really envy those who can be teammates with the Star God!"
"Yeah, if I were the Star God’s teammate, I’d probably have broken through to Legend already..."
"Guys, stop chatting, I’ve already started mining on the Star God continent."
"If I mine a lot, maybe I can meet the Star God in person.
"I’m also mining, this time, let’s see if I can get a photo with the Star God!"
"Wow, you can get a photo with the Star God while mining? I’m coming immediately!"
"I’ll go too, wait for me!"
Han Xing and the others didn’t check the forum, so they were unaware of the survivors’ discussions about them.
After beginning the teleportation.
The scene in front of them changed in an instant.
Han Xing and his team appeared in the Abyssal Rift.
This time, they chose to start the challenge from the 85th floor.
This was because, on the 85th floor, there was a demigod-level demon.
Killing it would not only yield a significant amount of experience but also have a chance to drop a Divine Artifact Fragment.
The rewards were substantial.
As soon as they entered, a system prompt appeared.
"Abyssal Rift 85-floor challenge is about to begin, Brave Squad, please prepare..."
Meanwhile.
A dense army of Abyssal Monsters appeared around them once again.
They looked at Han Xing and his team with crazed and hostile eyes.
Within a few seconds.
Those fireballs falling from the sky arrived as scheduled.
They were the approaching demons.
"Boom!"
After a deafening explosion.
The Great Demon Monarch wielding the Molten Rock Pillar appeared once more.
"Human... a human has actually come here?"
"Interesting."
The familiar lines were there.
The group exchanged smiles.
But they confirmed one thing.
And that was, these demons could indeed resurrect infinitely within the Abyssal Rift.
Moreover, upon resurrection, they wouldn’t retain memories from their previous encounter.
Thus, this demon did not remember being instantly killed by Han Xing and his team just a few hours ago.
The demon leapt high, with its familiar opening move.
This time, Han Xing’s Divine Power Domain spread over immediately.
"World-destroying..."
Just halfway through its line, the Great Demon Monarch’s expression froze.
Because its divine power was sealed, it fell directly from mid-air.
During the fall, after several attempts, it found its demon power was still unusable.
And had to crash onto the ground.
"Boom!"
An explosive sound emerged.
The demon struggled to crawl up from the ground, its face flushed red.
It asked incredulously, "Human, what did you do?"
"Why can’t I use my Power of the Demon?"
These demons referred to divine power as Power of the Demon.
Han Xing couldn’t be bothered to answer this question.
He simply pulled back his bowstring.
Realizing the terrifying attack power of Han Xing.
The Great Demon Monarch attempted to struggle and get up from the ground.
Yet, after a familiar set of control and burst attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 413: Abdullah’s Magma Pillar_3
paragraphs: Its rock-like body was again covered with countless cracks.
Realizing its imminent demise, the demigod level demon let out an earth-shattering roar.
"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!"
"How could I die by your hands, how could I die by those human hands!"
"Damn it!"
"Bang!"
The massive body of the Great Demon Monarch exploded on the spot.
Under the terrified gaze of the nearby Abyss Legion.
Han Xing and his team commenced a one-sided slaughter.
It took 11 minutes.
Finally, all the monsters on the 85th level of the Abyssal Rift were slain.
Then, it was the familiar battlefield cleanup session.
After collecting all the spirits and various materials fallen on the ground.
They came to the corpse of the demigod level demon.
This time, besides a powerful spirit and a drop of pure Demon Blood.
There was also a stone pillar a hundred meters thick, with magma flowing over it.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said with great interest: "Wow, did we just get the demon’s fire poker?"
Han Xing picked up the spoils from the ground and then posted the attributes of the fire poker... no, the Molten Rock Pillar.
[Abdullah’s Magma Pillar lv60, Quality: Divine Artifact, Power +10000, Constitution +4000, Hit Rate -20%]

[Attached Effect]: Thousand Jins of Power (Deal an additional 100,000 true damage when attacking), Destruction (All attacks include shock damage), Storm Chaos Dance (Wield the massive pillar, spinning frantically, dealing 150% heavy strike damage to enemies along the way!)
Note: This weapon is a melee weapon, can be equipped by Swordsmen, Berserkers, etc., Power requirement: 80000.
Everyone was surprised by the attributes of the pillar.
"Wow, what immense power!"
"True to a level 60 Divine Artifact!"
Then, everyone looked at Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong scratched his head and said, "Oh come on, don’t look at me."
"Even though my power is almost there, I don’t want to use such a weapon!"
"It’s too ugly!"
Hearing this, Shen Yun curiously said, "Are you sure? This is a level 60 Divine Artifact."
Cheng Jianyong said, "Of course I’m sure!"
"I’m a Legendary Sword Master, do you think this pillar suits me?"
"You want me to use this pillar, how do I perform the Storm Chaos Dance, how do I unleash the Heaven-Shocking Sword?"
Hearing this, everyone seemed to imagine that scenario.
Letting a Swordsman attack with a pillar indeed felt out of place.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly said, "Well, maybe it’s not impossible?"
"If you use such a big weapon, you should be even more impressive when slaying enemies, right?"
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong somewhat doubtfully said, "Uh... really?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
"Think about it, other warriors’ weapons are at most one or two meters long."
"And you, you have a pillar over a hundred meters long!"
"Once you bring it out, you’ll undoubtedly be the focus of the entire field."
"Then, when you use this pillar to slay enemies, won’t it be super cool?"
Cheng Jianyong also seemed to imagine that scene.
Somewhat unsure, he said, "It does seem pretty cool, huh?"
The team members unanimously agreed.
"Yes, very cool!"
"This pillar is perfect for you."
Cheng Jianyong, after hearing this, shyly scratched his head, "Well... I’ll try it when I reach level 60?"
Everyone laughed upon hearing this.
Then, Han Xing directly tossed the Divine Artifact Pillar to him.
Afterward, the team proceeded through the levels.
Level 86...
Level 87...
Level 88...
Then, they directly arrived at level 90.
The massive Yuanju City appeared in front of everyone once again.
The system prompt appeared.
[The challenge of Abyssal Rift level 90 is about to begin, Survivors please prepare for battle, and participate in the battle from 1200 years ago...]
[This battle will be scored based on your combat performance, and rewards will be given accordingly.]
[Do your utmost to cause destruction to the Abyss Legion.]
As the words fell.
The previously empty level 90 battlefield once again became a scene of blazing fire and deafening shouts.
Han Xing said, "Everyone heard the system prompt, right."
"This time, we go all out."
"Let’s see if we can achieve a better result!"
After hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Then, at the next moment when the Holy Spirit Realm United Army charged.
Shen Yun directly applied dual buffs.
Blessing of Honor!
Blessing of Courage!
The team members only felt their internal attributes skyrocketing!
However, it wasn’t over yet.
Shen Yun raised the Holy Hammer high.
A dazzling sphere of light rushed into the sky.
Church Secret Technique—Holy Light Shines!
Everyone’s attributes soared again.
"Whoosh—"
A gust of wind passed by.
Then, a trace of bloodiness flashed in Han Xing’s pupils.
In the next moment.
The entire battlefield of Yuanju City was suddenly enveloped in a blood-red world!
The ground was studded with Broken Swords, bones were scattered everywhere.
In the distance, there were mists filled with Resentful Spirits.
This scene was even comparable to the deepest part of Hell!
At this moment, the demons exclaimed: "Why does it feel like we’re back in the Abyss Realm..."
"But, this aura feels different somehow."
Before they could react.
Endless meteors fell from the sky.
Han Xing had directly used his mass attack ultimate, Fallen Star Arrow Rain.
Under the swarming of Endless Arrow Prison, coupled with Shen Yun’s triple buffs, the damage of each meteor was magnified to the maximum!
At this moment, it wasn’t like meteors falling.
It was like the entire sky was crashing down.
"Buzz!"
"Boom!"
The entire battlefield of Yuanju City fell into momentary silence.
When the powerful ones snapped back to reality.
They discovered that the terrifying number of the Abyssal Army, reaching over ten billion, had been reduced by more than half!
And this was the terror of Han Xing’s full-force burst state!
With a single strike, billions of lives were reaped!
This included several Five-Star Dominators and even Legends!
The demons felt a cold sweat running down their backs...

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 414: SSS-level Evaluation
paragraphs: Han Xing unleashed a Fallen Star Arrow Rain, annihilating billions of Abyssal Monsters!
However, this was not the end.
Han Xing did not pause for a moment.
He began to madly charge towards Yuanju City!
Because he knew, only by destroying the teleportation array in the central area of Yuanju City could he complete the challenge of the 90th layer!
Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also followed.
The purpose was to ensure Han Xing, in his burst state, was not disturbed by other attacks.
At this moment, seeing those five figures charging towards them,
the Abyss Demons instantly felt a chill run down their spines!
They reacted quickly.
And shouted frantically, "The enemy is charging over!"
"Quick, stop them!"
"Dark Energy Cannon! Quickly use the Dark Energy Cannon!"
As the words fell, dozens of Dark Energy Cannons on the city walls began to charge.
However, in his most powerful state, Han Xing not only saw an explosive increase in all attributes.
Even his attack speed and attack range were greatly enhanced.
Even though he was still tens of thousands of meters away from Yuanju City’s walls.
But in Han Xing’s eyes, it was no different from right in front of him.
Among the Abyss Demons, a nimble figure leaped into the air.
Then, directly drew the longbow in his hand.
The next moment, an arrow imbued with golden divine power shot swiftly.
So fast that it was impossible to react!
"Boom!"
After a deafening explosion.
That Dark Energy Cannon was directly blasted by Han Xing!
Then the second, the third!
"Boom! Boom!"
The terrifying sounds of explosions kept resounding.
With each blast, the hearts of the Abyssal Monsters sank a bit.
In less than ten seconds...
That human, with his own power, destroyed all their Dark Energy Cannons.
Among them, a few Dark Energy Cannons that had just launched an attack were blocked by a human wielding a shield.
Causing no harm to that human.
At this moment, all eyes focused on Han Xing.
The strong of the Holy Spirit Realm United Army momentarily forgot to move!
Just because Han Xing’s current performance was too terrifying, too shocking.
It felt like he alone could overturn the entire battlefield!
"How can the Human Race have such a terrifying existence?"
"This human, clearly only has a Legendary level aura, how did he do it?"
"It feels like there’s nothing for us to do at this rate."
Han Xing also wanted to take advantage of the momentum and directly rush to Yuanju City to destroy that teleportation array.
However, that was impossible.
As Han Xing was about to reach Yuanju City.
Five balls of flame fell from the sky.
"Boom!"
Five Demigod-level Great Demon Monarchs appeared simultaneously.
As Yuanju City’s trump card.
They had, of course, seen everything Han Xing had done in his burst state.
Being Demigod-level demons.
They thought nothing in this world could surprise them anymore.
In their hearts, there was only an endless desire for slaughter and destruction.
However, now, this Legendary level human, truly shocked them.
Seeing Han Xing rushing directly towards them, the leading Great Demon Monarch shouted, "Don’t underestimate him, attack together!"
"Let’s block him!"
These proud Demigod-level demons, pressured by a Legendary level human, had to unite,
Something they had never considered before.
Then, five terrifying attacks were directed straight at Han Xing!
At this time, Cheng Jianyong, holding a longsword, suddenly appeared in front of Han Xing.
"You guys, don’t think you’re the only ones with teammates!"
"We are Brother Xing’s solid support!"
The demons saw Cheng Jianyong, but directly ignored him, "Don’t mind him, focus all our attacks on that human."
Being directly ignored, Cheng Jianyong felt a bit humiliated.
He angrily shouted, "Damn it, ignoring me?
"Today, I’ll show you Old Cheng’s power!"
Although his burst skill, the Heaven-Sundering Sword, was on cooldown.
Cheng Jianyong had more than one legendary skill.
At this moment, he directly threw the divine artifact in his hand into the air.
A massive sword array appeared between heaven and earth.
This skill was Divine Demon Swordsmanship - Storm Style!
The five Demigod-level demons were instantly enveloped by this sword array.
The demons exclaimed, "What kind of move is this?"
"I feel my movements are restricted!"
And they were shocked to find the human’s aura was also rising rapidly.
In a short moment, he broke through from high-tier Legend to Demigod level.
"Another Legend possessing Demigod combat power level demon..."
"Is this generation of the Human Race so terrifying?"
Before the demons could react.
At this time, Han Xing’s arrows and Zhang Lianmeng’s large fireballs were already coming.
"Puff! Puff puff!"
"Boom!"
That area was instantly engulfed by terrifying energy waves,
And additionally.
Cheng Jianyong’s sword array crazily swung out sword Qi.
In less than a second.
The five demons felt their bodies developing countless cracks, almost on the verge of collapse.
"Damn it! How is this possible?"
The roars of the Great Demon Monarchs echoed across the Yuanju City battlefield, and everyone could hear the unwillingness and disbelief in their voices.
However, in Han Xing’s most powerful state, coupled with being the focus of everyone’s attacks.
They had no chance of turning the tables!
With an explosive sound.
The five demons were blasted to pieces on the spot...
The Yuanju City battlefield fell into complete silence.
Whether it was the Abyssal Army or the Holy Spirit Realm United Army.
All stood still in place simultaneously.
Then, Han Xing and his team, without any hesitation, directly charged into Yuanju City.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 414: SSS-level Evaluation_2
paragraphs: Looking at the gigantic teleportation array, an arrow was shot.
"Whoosh!"
The arrow fell into the core of the teleportation array, triggering a violent explosion.
"Buzz!"
After a tremor, the teleportation array shattered directly.
In the dazed eyes of the Holy Spirit Realm United Army.
They watched as the heavily protected teleportation array of Yuanju City.
Was effortlessly blasted apart in front of those few humans.
The so-called trump cards and tactics of Yuanju City did not play any blocking role.
Such an enemy is truly despairing just to think about.
But fortunately, these few humans are their allies.
Han Xing and others stood in place, watching as the teleportation array exploded.
And this also signified the end of the battle of Yuanju City once again.
The figures of the Holy Spirit Realm United Army gradually dissipated.
Before disappearing completely, the eyes of that group of powerhouses showed a sense of realization once again.
They looked at Han Xing and said, "Turns out, not humans of our era..."
"What a pity, if they had participated in the final battle, we wouldn’t have had to destroy the teleportation array of Yuanju City at the cost of total annihilation..."
At the same time, a series of system notifications appeared in front of Han Xing and the others.
[Abyssal Rift Level 90 challenge has been completed, the battle took 7 minutes and 14 seconds, a new fastest record for this level has been set.]
[In the defense and offense battle of Yuanju City, you have made exceptionally distinguished contributions, battle merit is being calculated...]

[In this battle, you collectively killed 5 demigod-level creatures, 43 legendary creatures, and other abyssal monsters: 320 million, destroyed eleven dark energy cannons, destroyed the teleportation array of Yuanju City...]
[Overall evaluation is: SSS-level.]
[The team received settlement rewards: 87.2 billion experience value, Abyssal Seal*100, Abyssal Sun Treasure Chest*3]
"Wow, an SSS-level evaluation! Directly rewarded with three Sun Treasure Chests!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed: "This is too awesome, isn’t it?"
A look of surprise appeared on everyone’s face.
They didn’t expect to receive such a high evaluation this time.
Three Sun Treasure Chests, meaning a high probability of obtaining three Abyssal Magical Artifacts.
And Abyssal Magical Artifacts are of the same level as the Divine Artifacts of the Holy Spirit Realm.
This trip to Yuanju City, the rewards are quite terrifying!
Shen Yun praised: "No wonder he’s Brother Xing, truly fierce in full burst state!"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
What does it mean for one person to suppress a massive army? This is it!
Cheng Jianyong said with some regret: "What a pity, Brother Xing’s state can’t last long."
"Otherwise, according to our speed of taking down the teleportation array in 7 minutes, merely repeating the 90th level quickly, everyone could reach level 60 in less than half a month."
Of course, everyone knew that was impossible.
Han Xing could at most only go full burst once a day.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the appearance of three black large treasure chests in the storage.
Before he could open them.
A black teleportation gate appeared in front of him.
[Abyssal Rift Level 90 challenge complete, subsequent levels are not yet open, survivors please leave the Abyssal Rift through the teleportation array...]
Seeing this notification, everyone exchanged glances.
They did not enter the teleportation array, but continued to walk towards the depths of Yuanju City.
Because there was still one thing left to do.
That was, to find the God of Trick’s Divine Treasure Vault.
Passing through the vast Yuanju City, they arrived at the end of Level 90 of the Abyssal Rift.
The place was shrouded in a layer of mist.
However, everyone could feel waves of intense heat hitting their faces.
As if a flaming world lay beyond the mist.
Han Xing mused: "According to the system, beyond Yuanju City should be the Sea of Lava."
"But because it is covered in mist, we cannot see the scene there."
Shen Yun replied after listening: "Brother Xing, does that mean we can’t go to the Sea of Lava?"
"Without clearing this map mist, we can’t reach there."
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head and said: "Not very sure, but let’s try."
"Last time, even the Great Demon Monarch was able to pass through the mist and enter the Abyssal Rift."
"We should also be able to act within the mist."
After saying that, Han Xing took the lead and walked forward.
Not long after, he reached the dense mist.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
[The area ahead is not yet open, please explore later...]
Hearing this notification, everyone sighed with some disappointment.
So, it was still not possible?
Before they could remain disappointed for long, another system notification appeared.
[Detected Brave Squad has high-tier legendary combat power, qualified to explore the Abyss Realm.]
[Granting access...]
Hearing this system notification, everyone was filled with joy.
A moment later.
The mist in front of Han Xing and the others became much thinner.
Though still present, the scenes inside were now visible.
"Wow, it’s giving us access?"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise: "This is pretty good!"
Everyone began to head deeper into the mist.
This time, they faced no more obstruction.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing felt waves of scorching heat approaching.
The deeper they went into the mist, the more intense this heat became.
Almost comparable to the temperatures on the Flame Plateau.
However, their constitutions could easily bear it.
Furthermore, with Zhang Lianmeng occasionally waving her magic staff, conjuring walls of ice.
No one felt overly uncomfortable.
After ten or so minutes.
The mist grew even thinner.
Faintly, they could even hear waves crashing against the rocks.
"Splash... Crash..."
When they completely emerged from the mist, the scene before them suddenly changed.
A vast, practically endless red ocean appeared before them.
Only, it wasn’t water.
But boiling lava.
"Boom!"
The lava churned continuously.
Meanwhile, meteorites ablaze kept falling from the sky.
These meteorites crashed into the Sea of Lava, creating waves thousands of meters high!
The terrifying heatwave almost seemed to swallow the entire world whole.
"Sss... Sizzle..."
The sound of burning kept coming.
A system notification appeared.
[You have reached the Sea of Lava, world impact +885, legendary points +10.]
[Please note, the Sea of Lava contains extremely violent chaotic power, neither divine power nor demon power can be used here, please do not attempt to use divine power to cross the Sea of Lava.]
[After crossing the Sea of Lava, you will officially reach the Abyss Realm.]
[Abyssal demons may appear above the Sea of Lava, survivors please be cautious.]
Hearing the system’s prompt, everyone frowned slightly.
"Not being able to use divine power, does that mean we can’t fly over the Sea of Lava?" Cheng Jianyong asked uncertainly.
After thinking for a moment, Shen Yun nodded, "Seems so, otherwise those demons wouldn’t have gone to great lengths to establish Yuanju City as a teleportation transit hub."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong said in surprise: "This Sea of Lava is so vast, no wonder those demons couldn’t come over."
"Brother Xing, did the God of Trick hide his treasure vault here?"
Han Xing nodded, "To be precise, that guy hid the treasure vault within the Sea of Lava."
"I only recently realized, the location that woman mentioned was actually beneath the lava."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expression changed simultaneously.
A sense of oppression arose in their hearts.
The location of the vault, beneath the lava.
Which meant they must use their flesh to enter the Sea of Lava.
Just the thought of it was unbearably stifling and uncomfortable.
Cheng Jianyong complained, "Wow, that God of Trick is something else."
"Of all places, why hide it under lava!"
At this point, Shen Yun frowned and asked, "Brother Xing, is there any way?"
Han Xing said, "Currently, no."
"According to the distance, we need to delve at least a hundred thousand meters deep into the Sea of Lava to find the entrance to the God of Trick’s treasure vault."
"And this lava isn’t ordinary lava, it contains an extremely violent power."
"An ordinary legendary powerhouse would be incinerated to ashes in less than a second entering it."

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 415: Ultimate Skill—Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow
paragraphs: "With our current constitution, even if we activate all states, we still can’t withstand the scorching heat."
Han Xing said, and the team members frowned deeply.
Because they knew.
With their current strength, they still couldn’t withstand the high temperatures of the Sea of Lava.
"Let’s come back next time."
Han Xing said, "Once we all break through to demigod, we should be able to enter the 100,000-meter zone of the Sea of Lava with our flesh bodies."
The team members nodded.
Although a bit regretful, they also knew that Han Xing was right.
After all, the God of Tricks’ treasure vault sounded tempting,
but if they had to risk their lives for it, it seemed not quite worth it.
Just as everyone was about to turn and leave,
Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, don’t we still have a legendary skill to draw?"
"Why not draw first and see if there’s a skill that could come in handy?"
Hearing this, everyone seemed to remember something.
Earlier, they had slain so many demigods.
Including a pseudo-god.
The legendary points obtained were enough for them to draw a third legendary skill.
And Han Xing could draw a fifth one.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Draw it."
Although no one had much hope,
it didn’t stop them from trying.
Meanwhile.
The four simultaneously clicked draw, and a white light appeared on them simultaneously.
At this moment, a surge of memories emerged from within them.
Everyone involuntarily closed their eyes and began receiving this thick, no, vast memory.
Three seconds later.
When they reopened their eyes, there was a look of surprise in their eyes.
From everyone’s expressions, it was clear.
The skills drawn this time must be very powerful.
The four immediately applied the newly drawn legendary skills.

[Legendary Skill—Elemental Resonance]: Mage’s legendary passive skill. After learning, increases all elemental effects by 200% (burning, paralysis, frozen, tearing, etc.) and changes single negative states to stackable negative state layers (up to 10 layers).

[Legendary Skill—Divine Demon Swordsmanship: Sword Qi Cross]: Summons Void Sword Intent, each sword swing can summon a large amount of sword qi to attack enemies. Each sword qi deals 80% of attack power as damage, lasts 100 seconds, cooldown 36 hours.

[Legendary Skill—Elf Will]: Elf race’s legendary passive, after learning, the low altitude flight skill becomes high altitude flight (unlimited flight distance, movement speed increased from 100% to 200%, and no cooldown), when attacking enemies in flight state, damage increases by 88%, skills below legendary level have a 33% cooldown reduction...

[Legendary Skill—Holy Light Barrier]: Radiant Knight creates a layer of Holy Light Barrier centered on themselves, enveloping all allied units. The barrier’s defense value is bound to the Radiant Knight’s life value, reducing 50% of abnormal damage received, with no cooldown.
The first three legendary skills are respectively for the mage, warrior, and elf shooter.
Among them, Su Xiaoyang and Zhang Lianmeng both have a legendary level passive skill, extremely powerful.
Similar to Han Xing’s Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill, it nearly changes their attack forms.
[Elemental Resonance] allows the mage’s abnormal states to stack.
In other words, even small skills like Fireball and Ice Cone Technique can stack abnormal damage.
This is very terrifying.
With Zhang Lianmeng’s magic casting speed, it might only take two or three seconds to stack hundreds of abnormal state layers.
Just thinking about it is frightening!
Everyone seemed to understand Zhang Lianmeng’s skill effect.
Shen Yun praised, "After Sister Lian Meng learns this skill, I estimate the damage can at least double."
The team members nodded in agreement.
No need to say much about Su Xiaoyang’s [Elf Will].
The description is very clear.
It also changes the attack form, allowing for cooldown-free flight.
In combat during flight state, it not only increases attack power but also significantly reduces skill cooldown.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong thought, "I remember Little Sister Yang’s flying skill doesn’t require divine power to use, right?
"Now, she can fly indefinitely, couldn’t she just cross the Sea of Lava and reach the Abyss Realm directly?"
Everyone paused upon hearing this.
Then they all fell into thought.
It must be said, Cheng Jianyong made a valid point.
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "I don’t think so."
"The Sea of Lava, besides not allowing flight, has another major danger."
"Uh, what is it?" Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion.
Han Xing pointed overhead.
Everyone looked up.
Meteorites whizzed down like shooting stars.
They crashed into the Sea of Lava, making a sound like a nuclear explosion.
Everyone immediately understood.
Even if you could fly over the Sea of Lava, you have to be careful of those constantly falling meteorites.
If hit by one, you’d be in a place of no return!
Everyone continued to check the newly drawn skills.
There wasn’t much to say about Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi.
This skill increased both his burst damage and sustained damage.
Quite formidable.
Summing up the damage coefficients of all sword qi, it’s much more terrifying than the previous skill, Heaven-Sundering Sword.
As for the last Holy Light Barrier, it left everyone a bit puzzled.
According to the skill description, this Holy Light Barrier can indeed protect allies.
But the downside is, the defense value of the Holy Light Barrier is bound to Shen Yun’s life value.
In other words, if the Holy Light Barrier takes damage, it’s equivalent to Shen Yun taking damage as well.

Han Xing said, and the team members frowned deeply.
Because they knew.
With their current strength, they still couldn’t withstand the high temperatures of the Sea of Lava.
"Let’s come back next time."
Han Xing said, "Once we all break through to demigod, we should be able to enter the 100,000-meter zone of the Sea of Lava with our flesh bodies."
The team members nodded.
Although a bit regretful, they also knew that Han Xing was right.
After all, the God of Tricks’ treasure vault sounded tempting,
but if they had to risk their lives for it, it seemed not quite worth it.

Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, don’t we still have a legendary skill to draw?"
"Why not draw first and see if there’s a skill that could come in handy?"

Earlier, they had slain so many demigods.
Including a pseudo-god.
The legendary points obtained were enough for them to draw a third legendary skill.

it didn’t stop them from trying.

At this moment, a surge of memories emerged from within them.
Everyone involuntarily closed their eyes and began receiving this thick, no, vast memory.
Three seconds later.
When they reopened their eyes, there was a look of surprise in their eyes.
From everyone’s expressions, it was clear.
The skills drawn this time must be very powerful.
The four immediately applied the newly drawn legendary skills.

After learning, increases all elemental effects by 200% (burning, paralysis, frozen, tearing, etc.) and changes single negative states to stackable negative state layers (up to 10 layers).
[Legendary Skill—Divine Demon Swordsmanship: Sword Qi Cross]: Summons Void Sword Intent, each sword swing can summon a large amount of sword qi to attack enemies.
Each sword qi deals 80% of attack power as damage, lasts 100 seconds, cooldown 36 hours.

[Legendary Skill—Elf Will]: Elf race’s legendary passive, after learning, the low altitude flight skill becomes high altitude flight (unlimited flight distance, movement speed increased from 100% to 200%, and no cooldown), when attacking enemies in flight state, damage increases by 88%, skills below legendary level have a 33% cooldown reduction...

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 415: Ultimate Skill—Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow
paragraphs: Shen Yun pondered for a moment and then said, "Brother Xing, how about I go down and try it first?"
Han Xing hesitated after hearing this.

At this moment, Shen Yun continued, "My life value is still quite high, and this barrier can reduce abnormal damage taken by 50%, meaning the burning damage from the Sea of Lava will be greatly reduced for me."
"I think I should be able to withstand it."
Han Xing thought for a moment, nodded, and said, "Okay, you can go ahead and try."
"But, no more than ten seconds down there."
"After ten seconds, if you don’t appear, I’ll go down to rescue you."
Shen Yun nodded solemnly after hearing this.
In the slightly tense gaze of the group.
A layer of Holy Light Barrier appeared on Shen Yun, enveloping his whole body.
Then, Shen Yun leapt directly into the Sea of Lava.
"Sizzle... sizzle..."
The sound of high-temperature burning reappeared.
The group watched as the Holy Light Shield sank into the lava, not even a bubble rising.
Three seconds later.
Cheng Jianyong asked in the chat channel, "Xiaoyunzi, any sound?"
"If you’re still alive, make some noise."
A moment later, Shen Yun’s voice came through the team channel.
"Screw you, of course I’m alive."
The group sighed in relief after hearing this.
Cheng Jianyong continued to ask, "How do you feel now, can you still hold on?"
Shen Yun replied, "Yes, I’m now at a depth of about four to five hundred meters below the lava."
"The temperature here is very high, almost reducing my life value by 1% every second."
"But I can easily recover it with a Healing Technique."
Hearing this, the group’s eyes instantly brightened.
Because this means Shen Yun can indeed stay in the lava for an extended period.
Ten seconds later.
Shen Yun surfaced as promised.
After reaching the shore, he dismissed the effect of the Holy Light Barrier.
Then he looked at Han Xing and smiled, "Brother Xing, the experiment is done.
"In the first thousand meters, the temperature isn’t too high and basically doesn’t harm me."
"But around a depth of a thousand meters, the temperature gets higher, and there’s a very violent energy that damages my Holy Light Barrier."
"It reduces my life value by about 2% every second."
"However, the rate of life value loss isn’t too high, and I can withstand it with Healing Techniques."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong seemed to think of something, and said worriedly,
"Xiaoyunzi, you mean the deeper we go, the higher the temperature."
"This time, we have to go to depths of tens of thousands of meters, are you sure your life value can hold up?"
The group also thought of this issue, and a look of concern reappeared in their eyes.
Han Xing also said, "If it doesn’t work, let’s talk about it next time, there’s no need to take risks."
Shen Yun replied, "Right now, with my Great Recovery Technique and Small Recovery Technique, I can recover up to 30% of my life value per second at the limit."
"There shouldn’t be any problem."
"And if other Healing Skills assist me, it will be even more secure."
Upon hearing this.
Su Xiaoyang softly said from the side, "I... I have a Tree of Life skill here, which can restore teammates’ life..."
"Even if faced with fatal damage, it will forcibly keep 1 life value..."
After saying this, she glanced at everyone timidly.
However, upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up instantly.
He had also forgotten the effect of the Legendary Skill Su Xiaoyang had drawn last time.
Combined with Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier, it could indeed have a very good effect.
Shen Yun smiled and said, "Then there’s no problem."
Zhang Lianmeng also held Su Xiaoyang’s hand and excitedly said, "Little Sister Yang, you’re amazing!"
Han Xing also gave her a thumbs up, showing encouragement.
Su Xiaoyang’s face turned red, extremely shy.
"Brother Xing, shall we start going down now?" Cheng Jianyong asked eagerly.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Wait a minute, I’ll draw a skill first and see."
For this skill, Han Xing was very much looking forward to it.
Because the fourth skill, Endless Arrow Prison, greatly increased his burst damage.
And this fifth skill, it must only be stronger.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume 400 Legendary Points to draw the Wild Ranger’s fifth exclusive skill?]
"Yes."
At the moment Han Xing clicked confirm.
A vast amount of memory surged from his mind.
At this moment, Han Xing’s eyes suddenly widened.
This feeling is unmistakable.
The fifth skill is also an Ultimate Skill!
At the same time, a white light again crossed the endless space from the sky of the Holy Spirit Realm, appearing above Han Xing’s head.
A large amount of memory gushed out from Han Xing’s mind.
In the memories, he saw a resolute-faced figure, wearing a kasaya, looking like a monk.
But strangely, this monk was also carrying a bow.
"Uh... a monk?"
Han Xing was puzzled in his heart.
Although Han Xing knew that the profession of Wild Ranger has been passed down for many years.
The strong ones who inherited this profession over the generations came from various backgrounds.
But he didn’t expect that one of them was a monk.
This peculiar combination was indeed a bit abstract.
At this time, the monk carrying the longbow looked over.
His expression remained resolute, like a wrathful Arhat.
"All beings nourish the spirit with all things, and the spirit has nothing to repay all beings..."
"This world is a huge prison and hell..."
"I am willing to use the power of reincarnation..."
He seemed to want to say something to Han Xing, but for some reason, he was abruptly interrupted.
At the same time.
Han Xing also finished digesting the information in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 415: Ultimate Skill—Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow (Part 3)
paragraphs: A system notification appeared.
[Extraction successful, Wild Ranger’s exclusive skill acquired: Ultimate Skill - Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow]

[Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow]: Shoots six arrows, trapping the target in reincarnation. Each arrow hit reduces the enemy’s power by one major realm and causes significant memory loss. When all six arrows hit, the enemy’s power and memory are completely erased (This skill can most affect demigod-level creatures. For divine-level creatures, the effects of each arrow are reduced by 80%, and it is ineffective against true god-level creatures.)
"Oh my..."
After reading the skill description, Han Xing was stunned for a long time.
"Is it fair to say that this skill truly lives up to its monk creator?"
"This is way too overwhelming, too bizarre!"
This skill, on the surface, doesn’t seem to have much destructive power.
But compared to the previous skills, it’s even more terrifying.
Aside from reducing the enemy’s strength, the memory erasure is particularly frightening.
Imagine.
Han Xing is in a duel with a demigod.
One arrow shot and the opponent drops from demigod to legend, with massive memory loss.
It’s possible they can’t even remember why they’re here.
And when Han Xing hits with all six arrows, the opponent directly degrades from demigod to a Tier One small creature!
How can you even fight that?
When Han Xing posted the skill’s effects in the party channel.
The team members all gasped in disbelief.
They all marveled at the skill’s bizarreness and power.
After calming down a bit.
Han Xing said to everyone: "Let’s go, we can try entering the Sea of Lava now."
The team nodded together.
Han Xing turned around, looking at the surging waves of lava before them.
Now, a problem stood before the group.
That is, from here to the location of the God of Tricks’ treasure lay about a thousand kilometers.
After reaching some coordinates in the Sea of Lava, they had to continue diving to find the treasury.
Although the issue of reaching the depths of the Sea of Lava is resolved.
In the absence of flight, crossing these thousand-plus kilometers.
Is no small challenge either.
Among them, except for Su Xiaoyang.
No one else possessed the ability to fly independently without relying on divine power.
In fact, it’s not a problem for them.
Besides the Gale Wings Secret Elixir, they have a flying tool.
Han Xing said: "Bring out the Oracle Thrones."
Everyone nodded.
In the next moment.
Five jewel-encrusted thrones appeared.
They were the Oracle Thrones.
Indeed, Han Xing had recently found some Divine Oracle Scripture and made two more Oracle Thrones.
Now, all team members had their own exclusive throne.
The Oracle Thrones were naturally equipped with a flight function, along with a teleportation feature.
As long as Han Xing set the location, they could instantly arrive.
However, just as Han Xing was about to activate the teleportation function on the Oracle Throne, the system notified him.
[Notice: Due to excessive chaotic energy here, precise positioning during Oracle Sign teleportation is impossible.]
[There’s a high chance of deviating from the teleport target, please teleport cautiously...]
Upon seeing this notice, everyone expressed some surprise.
"Can’t teleport?"
Han Xing frowned slightly.
Then, he shook his head and said: "Forget it, it’s only over a thousand kilometers."
"We can just use the Oracle Thrones’ flight function to fly over gradually."
After hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
They could sit atop and cross the Sea of Lava.
Along the way, as long as they were careful of the giant waves erupting from the sea surface, to avoid being overwhelmed.
And just be sure not to get hit by the meteorites falling from the sky.
The five of them seated themselves on the thrones and then set off towards the depths of the Sea of Lava.
Although they said that by being cautious, they could safely cross the Sea of Lava.
In actual implementation, it was still somewhat challenging.
The five of them hadn’t gone far over the Sea of Lava’s surface when they spotted a ten-thousand-meter-high wave of lava surging towards them.
The lava wave looked like a curtain of flame, covering the sky and earth.
"Boom!"
"Splash!"
A thundering sound came, with the overwhelming momentum of devouring everything, sweeping towards them.
Even without being close, they felt the scorching heat washing over them.
"Holy moly! Is it this intense?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, shocked.
Han Xing quickly reminded:
"Ascend, quickly!"
As soon as he spoke.
The five of them immediately manipulated their Oracle Thrones to ascend rapidly.
As they ascended.
A huge meteorite, trailing with blazing flames, was crashing down from above!
"Crap!"
"Evade quickly!"
Seeing the enormous meteorite about to hit Shen Yun.
Zhang Lianmeng stood up on the throne.
Then, hundreds of massive ice cones instantly formed and shot towards the meteorite.
"Puff! Puff puff puff!"
"Sizzling..."
The sound of melting glaciers echoed.
Zhang Lianmeng’s ice cones vanished completely.
But the blazing meteorite was also pierced through by the ice cones’ terrifying penetrating power.
The flame extinguished, and it was left riddled with holes.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng hurled a large fireball at the massive meteorite.
"Boom!"
Like a cannonball exploding in the air.
The meteorite shattered into countless pieces and plummeted down.
Seeing this, everyone looked at Zhang Lianmeng.
"Wuhu, Sister Lian Meng is incredible!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in awe.
Shen Yun also gave Zhang Lianmeng a grateful glance.
Zhang Lianmeng smiled gently.
Afterwards.
The group maintained a course at fifty thousand meters in altitude.
Any meteorites falling along the way were forcibly obliterated by their attacks.
The Sea of Lava below continued roiling, with ten-thousand-meter waves repeatedly emerging.
They dared not fly too fast.
After all, the frequency of meteorite descents here was exceedingly high.
If they weren’t careful, they might crash into one directly.
Half an hour later.
The five finally reached their target location.
They had now reached the depths of the Sea of Lava.
Looking around, everything was glowing red.

Any meteorites falling along the way were forcibly obliterated by their attacks.
The Sea of Lava below continued roiling, with ten-thousand-meter waves repeatedly emerging.
They dared not fly too fast.
After all, the frequency of meteorite descents here was exceedingly high.
If they weren’t careful, they might crash into one directly.
Half an hour later.
The five finally reached their target location.
They had now reached the depths of the Sea of Lava.
Looking around, everything was glowing red.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 416: Unlocking the Divine Treasure Vault!
paragraphs: The heatwaves surged one after another.
This place seemed like a world of flames.
Han Xing and the others stared at the churning magma below.
The thought of having to jump in next made everyone feel a slight sense of suffocation.
Cheng Jianyong swallowed and said, "Brother Xing, is this the place?"
Han Xing carefully checked the position on the small map, then nodded.
"This should be the place."
"Next, we just need to jump into the Sea of Lava and descend 130,000 meters, then we should reach the location of the God of Trick’s vault."
Everyone nodded.
At this moment, Han Xing’s tone suddenly changed, and then he said, "Get ready!"
"It’s time to jump."
They all took a deep breath.
Three seconds later.
They retracted the Oracle Throne and plummeted from high above!
"Whoosh—whoosh—"
The wind roared past their ears.
Five figures, like five tiny black dots, dropped into the massive Sea of Lava.
The heatwaves were so intense that they couldn’t open their eyes.
Han Xing said, "Speed up, let’s charge below."
"Shen Yun, remember to activate the Holy Light Barrier just before entering the magma!"
"Got it, Brother Xing!"
Shen Yun’s expression instantly turned serious, and his spirit became intensely focused.
Just as they were about to make contact with the magma.
A layer of Holy Light Barrier suddenly emerged from his body.
Then, this barrier rapidly expanded, enveloping everyone.
The next moment.
The five of them were protected by a ball of energy barrier.
With a loud crash, they plunged into the Sea of Lava.
"Blub...blub..."
Two bubbles rose, and then, the five figures sank, disappearing completely.
In the depths of the Sea of Lava.
It was as if they had entered a world of red.
All around was surging magma.
Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier kept being corroded, emitting a sizzling sound.
But for now, it could barely hold on.
There was a look of delight on everyone’s faces.
Cheng Jianyong praised, "Not bad, Xiaoyunzi, you actually managed to protect us entering under the magma."
Shen Yun smirked disdainfully, "No problem."
Then, everyone continued to delve deeper.
The terrifying high temperature made the oxygen inside the Holy Light Barrier scarce.
Zhang Lianmeng wanted to use Ice Magic to cool down the team.
But at this moment, she was surprised to find she couldn’t harness the Power of Ice Elements here.
The Power of Elements in this place was extremely chaotic.
Especially the Power of Ice, which was completely undetectable.
Several attempts were met with failure.
Zhang Lianmeng looked at Han Xing and said, "Brother Xing, I can’t use my Ice Skills..."
Han Xing comforted, "It’s okay, this temperature won’t affect us much."
"Mm." Zhang Lianmeng nodded gently.
Shen Yun continued to support the Holy Light Barrier, leading the team forward.
Ten thousand meters...
Twenty thousand meters...
Thirty thousand meters...
When they reached a depth of fifty thousand meters, the magma became thick and viscous.
Like various metals and other substances melted together.
The temperature increased accordingly.
Then to seventy thousand meters...
Eighty thousand meters...
Until they reached one hundred thousand meters deep.
The magma here had already settled together.
Continuing deeper, they were met with significant resistance.
At the same time, the terrifying high pressure and temperature continuously pressed against Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier.
Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier was rapidly melting, and his face gradually turned pale.
The Defense Value of the Holy Light Barrier consumed his Life Value.
So Shen Yun’s Life Value was rapidly depleting.
He constantly used various Recovery Skills, but it was still a struggle.
Just then.
Su Xiaoyang raised his longbow, and a small tree full of greenery appeared out of nowhere before them.
This tree seemed to be just over a meter tall.
But that was because they were within the Holy Light Barrier, and the space was not large.
Su Xiaoyang had deliberately shrunk it.
A complete Tree of Life was tens of thousands of meters tall, comparable to the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
At this moment, a vigorous Power of Life emanated from the small Tree of Life.
Shen Yun’s pale face began to quickly recover.
He took a long breath and said, "This is much better now."
After arduously advancing another thirty thousand meters.
They finally arrived at their target location.
"This is the place," Han Xing said.
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes instantly lit up.
The oppressive Sea of Lava always gave them a sense of crisis.
Hearing Han Xing’s words, everyone couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
However, when they looked around, they discovered it was still all fiery red.
Apart from magma, there was nothing else.
"Where is it, Brother Xing? I don’t see anything," Cheng Jianyong asked, puzzled.
After scanning the area, Han Xing also didn’t find any sign of a treasure vault.
Before this, they had already visited several locations the woman had mentioned.
All of them were correct coordinates.
So there was no reason for her to deceive him on this matter.
Han Xing frowned and said, "Shen Yun, move the Holy Light Barrier, let’s search around."
"Alright."
Shen Yun responded immediately and began to maneuver the Holy Light Barrier, moving through the magma.
After exploring roughly a thousand meters around.
An enormous black steel door suddenly appeared in front of them.
Their eyes immediately brightened.
"There it is!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
Shen Yun also said excitedly, "Is that it, Brother Xing?"
Han Xing glanced and said, "Get closer and take a look."
Shen Yun nodded, controlling the Holy Light Barrier to rapidly approach the door.
However, upon closer inspection, they found.
