chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 416: Opening the Divine Treasure Vault! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Outside of this steel gate, there’s nothing else.
But they didn’t panic.
Because on this steel gate, they felt an extremely dense Power of Space.
Perhaps beyond the gate, lies another world.
At the same time, the attributes of the steel gate appeared in front of everyone.
[Divine Treasure Vault Gate]: Contains a strong Divine Power Seal, to enter, the Token of the God of Tricks is needed.
Cheng Jianyong cursed: "This damned God of Tricks, it’s enough to put the vault so deep, but to also have a Divine Power Seal on the gate."
"That’s just too cautious!"
The others also rolled their eyes.
Han Xing said, "No worries, the Divine Power Seal isn’t a problem for us."
"Though we will need to endure it a little bit."
The team members immediately understood Han Xing’s plan.
This calls for using the Giant Beast Tail Spike to forcibly break the Divine Power Seal.
They have done this kind of thing quite a lot.
Cheng Jianyong patted his chest and said, "Don’t worry Brother Xing, boldly prick it!"
"We can bear a little pain."
"Alright."
Han Xing nodded,
then he directly pulled out the Beast’s Tail Spike.
Instantly, everyone felt a terrifying sting.
Previously, being at a distance, they didn’t feel the intensity.
But now, they deeply realized how terrifying the Beast’s Tail Spike was!
In a moment, everyone started bleeding profusely.
Shen Yun’s Life Value was dropping faster.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but gasp, "My god! This absurd?"
Luckily, Han Xing used it for less than a second, forcibly breaking the Divine Power Seal, then retracted it.
Additionally, Xiaoyang’s Tree of Life was still there.
Quickly restoring everyone’s Life Value.
The team breathed a sigh of relief and then glanced deeply at Han Xing.
At the same time.
The state of the steel gate in front of them had changed to: Enterable.
They looked at each other.
Then pasted the Holy Light Barrier on it, Han Xing directly reached out and opened the gate, revealing a layer of Energy Barrier inside.
Behind the gate, it seemed to connect to another space.
This layer of Energy Barrier didn’t obstruct them, it was merely blocking the outside lava.
Before entering, they already sensed the aura of various treasures inside.
"This vault of the God of Tricks looks like it will yield great rewards."
Han Xing said, with a smile on his face.
The others nodded in agreement.
Then, they all jumped in together.
The scene changed.
The endless Sea of Lava disappeared.
A magnificent treasury piled high with various gems, sparkling appeared inside.
The moment they entered, they were like discovering the treasure of a Giant Dragon, drawing in all their gazes.
Various Philosopher’s Stones, Shimmering Terra Stones, piled up in stacks inside.
The strong wave of Divine Power left them throbbing with excitement!
Cheng Jianyong excitedly exclaimed, "Wow... It wasn’t in vain for us to expend so much effort to enter this vault."
"That God of Tricks, this guy has been hiding so many treasures over the years!"
Since Han Xing and the others had seen the depths of the original relic No. 5, few things could surprise them.
However, now, the things inside this vault still shocked them greatly.
The God of Tricks, as a true Divine Spirit.
Over the years, the depth of its treasures naturally rivaled relic No. 5.
The quantity of Philosopher’s Stones, Shimmering Terra Stones inside, roughly estimated has exceeded millions...
This even without accounting for other materials.
And anything placed by the God of Tricks inside the vault.
The minimum is at the level of a Philosopher’s Stone!
Han Xing was relieved, it’s fortunate they cleared their backpacks before coming.
Otherwise, if they suddenly found their backpacks lacking space, it would be embarrassing.
The team excitedly rushed over.
They began exploring inside the magnificent treasury.
Han Xing passed by each corner, and the treasure chests were filled with various splendid gems.
Han Xing took a rough glance, revealing the names and attribute introductions of these gems.
[Blue Lion Heart Gem]: Special item, can be used for Equipment Enchantment embedding, increasing 300 Strength Attribute points.
[Unicorn Gem]: Special item, can be used for Equipment Enchantment embedding, increasing 200 Constitution points, 50 Armor points...
[Death Gem]: Special item...
These gems can all be embedded into Equipment.
One or two might not seem like a big improvement.
But know this, these items are akin to Runes, capable of being embedded into every piece of Equipment!
With all Equipment added together, the improvement is exceptionally scary!
"Truly worthy of the Divine Spirit’s vault!"
"These items, I will gladly accept them all."
Han Xing had a joyful look in his eyes, then waved his hand and put all the gems into his backpack.
At the same time, the team members also had various discoveries.
They resembled passing bandits.
Seeing treasure chests full of gems, they exclaimed loudly before stuffing them all into their backpacks at once.
Just then, Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, come and see what this is?"
Han Xing heard and walked over.
In front of Shen Yun, were several large boxes filled with black long metal ingots, of unknown material.
On these metal ingots, Han Xing felt a strong Element wave.
"Oh? What are these things?"
Han Xing picked up a metal ingot, and its attributes became visible.

[Ancient Elf Secret Ingot]: Forged by mixing Extreme Ice Divine Stone, Thunder Divine Stone, Philosopher’s Stone, Waveless Metal, Red Flame Divine Stone, has strong Element waves, can be used to build High-Level buildings and Defense Towers...

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 416: Unlocking the Divine Treasure Vault! (Part 3)
paragraphs: After reading the introduction of this material, Han Xing secretly showed a look of realization.
"So, this is the Ancient Elf Secret Ingot..."
"No wonder it’s so precious, requiring so many kinds of Divine Stones to forge."
Han Xing glanced over briefly.
In the few large boxes in front of him, there were at least hundreds of thousands of Ancient Elf Secret Ingots.
And in other corners of this treasure vault, there were several similar large boxes.
A rough estimate revealed that the number of Ancient Elf Secret Ingots was no less than a million.
Now, the materials needed to forge the Demon God Battleship were once again complete.
Han Xing was in a very good mood.
Then, the group continued to explore deeper into this treasure vault.
As they ventured further, they increasingly realized the immense wealth contained within.
Besides those gems, metals, and Secret Ingots,
there were also piles of various biological horns, leathers, wings, and so on.
Many of these creatures were species that had long been extinct in the Holy Spirit Realm.
They were infused with extremely strong divine power waves.
In their lifetimes, they probably had at least the strength of a High-tier Demigod.
These body parts of the creatures are also excellent forging materials. If taken to the Dwarf Race for forging,
perhaps several Divine Artifacts could be crafted from them.
With excitement.
The five reached a section deep within the vault.
There, there were two small altars, each less than a meter high.
On top of the altars hovered two crystal-clear rhombic crystals.
The moment they saw these two rhombic crystals, their eyes instantly lit up.
Because they recognized these crystals.
"Divine Format!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed!
Indeed, these things were Divine Formats.
Essential items needed for the Legends of the Holy Spirit Realm to break through to Demigod!
For those large clans, a single Divine Format could greatly enhance their foundation.
And now, they had directly found two.
"Wow, this God of Tricks really had a lot of good stuff."
"Even has two Divine Formats."
The group quickly stepped forward.
Then, the attributes of the two Divine Formats appeared before them.
[Divine Format·Trick]: Special item. (Can achieve different effects through different methods of use.)

[Effect 1]: Legendary powerhouses can greatly enhance their divine power value by absorbing the divine power contained in the Divine Format, with an enhancement range of 2000~3000. (The Divine Format shatters after absorption.)
[Effect 2]: For any profession, after reaching Level 60, using this Divine Format allows breaking through to Demigod, gaining mastery over part of the ’Trick’ Law.
[Divine Format·Justice]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: Legendary powerhouses can greatly enhance their divine power value by absorbing the divine power contained in the Divine Format, with an enhancement range of 5000~6000.
[Effect 2]: For any profession, after reaching Level 60, using this Divine Format allows breaking through to Demigod level powerhouse, gaining mastery over part of the ’Justice’ Law.
After reading the attributes of the two Divine Formats, everyone showed a look of realization.
"I see, it’s not restricted by profession. As long as you use this Divine Format when you reach Level 60, you can directly break through to Demigod?"
Cheng Jianyong said: "In that case, can’t we use these two Divine Formats to directly break through later?"
Han Xing, after pondering for a moment, shook his head and said: "I remember that old tree mentioned before."
"All Legends are only considered to have broken through to Demigod when they start learning to touch the Power of Rules."
"And Divine Format is a carrier of rules, so it can help us break through more easily."
"But there is a downside; all the rules in the Holy Spirit Realm are already controlled by those Divine Spirits now."
"That means, if we use their Divine Format to break through."
"As long as the Divine Spirits controlling the ’Trick’ and ’Justice’ Laws do not die, we will never have a chance to reach the Divine Level."
After hearing Han Xing’s explanation,
they also realized the downside of using this kind of Divine Format to break through.
Cheng Jianyong regretfully said at this moment: "What a pity we didn’t take out the God of Tricks last time."
"Otherwise, we would have had a direct path to godhood."
Han Xing said at this moment: "That’s not really unfortunate."
"The God of Tricks is basically a weak god, you can tell from the strength of the divine power in the Divine Format."
"Its ’Trick’ Divine Format only increases divine power value by two to three thousand, while ’Justice’ Divine Format increases it by five to six thousand."
"That’s nearly double."
"Take a look at Lian Meng’s Elemental Divine Format, each one can increase divine power value by at least 5000 to 10000."
"So even if you master the ’Trick’ Law, your strength won’t be that great after reaching godhood."
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback for a moment, then nodded and said: "Wow, what Brother Xing said makes sense!"
"A weak god like the God of Tricks, even if it breaks through, it’s not very useful, its combat strength won’t be that great either."
The team members also nodded one after another.
However, in actuality, any Divine Spirit is very powerful.
After mastering the rules, there’s almost no attack that can harm them below Divine Level.
But Han Xing and his group are exceptions.
With the two Holy Artifact Steles and a vast amount of resources to build defense towers,
they possessed the means of godslaying.
Otherwise, the God of Tricks would have been overwhelmingly powerful compared to Demigods.
Cheng Jianyong continued to ask: "Brother Xing, what about this ’Justice’ Divine Format?"
Han Xing glanced at it and nodded: "This Divine Format is not bad."
"The God of Justice, among the Divine Spirits, probably is not a weak one."
"We can use it to break through to Demigod first, and then figure out a way to take out the God of Justice later."
As soon as Han Xing said this,
there was an explosion above them.
"Boom!"

And now, they had directly found two.
"Wow, this God of Tricks really had a lot of good stuff."
"Even has two Divine Formats."
The group quickly stepped forward.
Then, the attributes of the two Divine Formats appeared before them.
[Divine Format·Trick]: Special item. (Can achieve different effects through different methods of use.)

[Effect 1]: Legendary powerhouses can greatly enhance their divine power value by absorbing the divine power contained in the Divine Format, with an enhancement range of 2000~3000. (The Divine Format shatters after absorption.)
[Effect 2]: For any profession, after reaching Level 60, using this Divine Format allows breaking through to Demigod, gaining mastery over part of the ’Trick’ Law.
[Divine Format·Justice]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: Legendary powerhouses can greatly enhance their divine power value by absorbing the divine power contained in the Divine Format, with an enhancement range of 5000~6000.
[Effect 2]: For any profession, after reaching Level 60, using this Divine Format allows breaking through to Demigod level powerhouse, gaining mastery over part of the ’Justice’ Law.
After reading the attributes of the two Divine Formats, everyone showed a look of realization.
"I see, it’s not restricted by profession.
As long as you use this Divine Format when you reach Level 60, you can directly break through to Demigod?"
Cheng Jianyong said: "In that case, can’t we use these two Divine Formats to directly break through later?"
Han Xing, after pondering for a moment, shook his head and said: "I remember that old tree mentioned before."
"All Legends are only considered to have broken through to Demigod when they start learning to touch the Power of Rules."
"And Divine Format is a carrier of rules, so it can help us break through more easily."
"But there is a downside; all the rules in the Holy Spirit Realm are already controlled by those Divine Spirits now."
"That means, if we use their Divine Format to break through."
"As long as the Divine Spirits controlling the ’Trick’ and ’Justice’ Laws do not die, we will never have a chance to reach the Divine Level."
After hearing Han Xing’s explanation,
they also realized the downside of using this kind of Divine Format to break through.
Cheng Jianyong regretfully said at this moment: "What a pity we didn’t take out the God of Tricks last time."
"Otherwise, we would have had a direct path to godhood."
Han Xing said at this moment: "That’s not really unfortunate."
"The God of Tricks is basically a weak god, you can tell from the strength of the divine power in the Divine Format."
"Its ’Trick’ Divine Format only increases divine power value by two to three thousand, while ’Justice’ Divine Format increases it by five to six thousand."
"That’s nearly double."
"Take a look at Lian Meng’s Elemental Divine Format, each one can increase divine power value by at least 5000 to 10000."
"So even if you master the ’Trick’ Law, your strength won’t be that great after reaching godhood."
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback for a moment, then nodded and said: "Wow, what Brother Xing said makes sense!"
"A weak god like the God of Tricks, even if it breaks through, it’s not very useful, its combat strength won’t be that great either."
The team members also nodded one after another.
However, in actuality, any Divine Spirit is very powerful.
After mastering the rules, there’s almost no attack that can harm them below Divine Level.
But Han Xing and his group are exceptions.
With the two Holy Artifact Steles and a vast amount of resources to build defense towers,
they possessed the means of godslaying.
Otherwise, the God of Tricks would have been overwhelmingly powerful compared to Demigods.
Cheng Jianyong continued to ask: "Brother Xing, what about this ’Justice’ Divine Format?"
Han Xing glanced at it and nodded: "This Divine Format is not bad."
"The God of Justice, among the Divine Spirits, probably is not a weak one."
"We can use it to break through to Demigod first, and then figure out a way to take out the God of Justice later."
As soon as Han Xing said this,
there was an explosion above them.
"Boom!"

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 417: The Mad Great Demon Monarch
paragraphs: It was as if the Divine Spirits were enraged.
Terrifying thunder spanned countless spaces, seemingly ready to descend upon everyone.
Keep in mind, they were currently in the Abyss Realm.
Plus, they were tens of thousands of meters deep in the Sea of Lava, within the God of Tricks’ treasury.
Yet, Han Xing’s words were still perceived.
This indicated that, regarding the situation in the Holy Spirit Realm, those Divine Spirits likely always knew.
Even in the Abyss Realm, they couldn’t escape.
Everyone’s expression was somewhat grave.
After a moment of contemplation, Han Xing suddenly laughed: "These Divine Spirits who have mastered the rules are indeed a bit outrageous."
"As long as you mention them, they can sense it."
"But even if they sense it, it doesn’t matter since they can’t come to the Holy Spirit Realm anyway."
Upon hearing this, the heavy expressions on their faces vanished, gradually turning into light-hearted smiles.
Han Xing was serious about wanting to eliminate the God of Justice.
After all, he already knew that none of these Divine Spirits were any good.
After mastering the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm, they all just fled and subsequently caused a series of disasters.
So, even if he wiped out all these Divine Spirits, Han Xing had no psychological burden.
Of course, the premise is that he possesses such power.
Han Xing retracted his thoughts, then said: "That ’Justice’ Divine Format."
"Xiaoyunzi, you hold onto it first, and see if you can find something better later."
"If not, you can use this one for your breakthrough."
Shen Yun nodded and accepted it without any hesitation.
Now, among the five people.
Shen Yun had acquired the Justice Divine Format.
Han Xing had the Divine Format left by the Hunter.
As for Zhang Lianmeng’s Seven Elements Divine Format, only two shards were left to collect.
Now, they just needed to find Divine Formats for Cheng Jianyong and Su Xiaoyang to make breakthroughs.
But that was a task for later.
Han Xing continued, "Alright, pack up everything in the treasury, and we can go."
Everyone exchanged smiles.
Then resumed the joyful plunder.
"Clang! Clang!"
Chests filled with precious Divine Stones and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots were all taken by them.
The God of Tricks had painstakingly amassed wealth over tens of thousands of years, only to have it all plundered by Han Xing and the others.
If the God of Tricks could sense this now, his heart would surely be bleeding.
But Han Xing and his group cared little about that.
Three or four minutes later.
After confirming there were no more treasures in this treasury.
Han Xing led the group out.
They returned to the depths of the Sea of Lava.
Then, Han Xing closed the treasury’s door.
"Creak!"
The metal door closed again, still floating in the Sea of Lava.
Within Shen Yun’s Holy Light Barrier, the group continued to ascend.
Watching as the door below gradually became distant.
It seemed that after today, for a very, very long time, no other beings would arrive here.
Perhaps, someday in the future, a strong individual would find this place and open the treasury with surprise.
Only to find nothing inside, unsure of how they would feel.
Ten minutes later.
They emerged from the Sea of Lava.
After leaving that oppressive space,
everyone felt a refreshing sense of relief.
"Wuhu! We’re finally out!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed.
At this moment, Shen Yun lifted the Holy Light Barrier.
He looked across the Sea of Lava and suddenly said, "Brother Xing, we now have the clearance to explore the Abyss Realm."
"Does this mean we can cross the Sea of Lava and head to the Abyss Realm?"
Hearing this, everyone could not help but gaze towards the deeper part of the Sea of Lava.
Regarding the Abyss Realm, this dangerous and powerful place, they indeed felt a significant curiosity.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes, we can."
"However, our current strength is not sufficient; it’s still too early to venture into the Abyss Realm.
"Didn’t you hear what those demons said?"
"Inside, there are not only numerous Great Demon Monarchs but also even more powerful Demon Gods."
"At the very least, we need to all break through to Demigod to confidently explore the Abyss Realm."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in agreement.
Then, they summoned the Oracle Throne again and headed back the way they came.
Half an hour later.
Han Xing and his group returned to the Holy Spirit Realm.
The familiar sight of Ten Thousand Stars City appeared before them.
Looking at the territory with its hundreds or even thousands of exaggerated Defense Towers, Han Xing felt waves of security.
With these things around, even if real Divine Spirits came to trouble them, he wouldn’t be daunted.
Then, Han Xing and the others placed all the materials from their bags into the underground warehouse of Ten Thousand Stars City.
After a brief rest, the five regrouped.
Next, they would begin their journey of upgrading.
Time flew by.
In a blink, a month had passed...
Han Xing and his group tirelessly battled against the Abyssal Rift.
Meanwhile, the Holy Spirit Realm heralded a new change.
Elf Realm.
In the Elf Royal City.
Countless soldiers stood ready.
Watching the purple teleportation arrays rising all around.
The elves floating in the air looked distressed.
"Damn it! Those demons are here again!"
"This is their thirteenth invasion this month."
"Does anyone know how these Demons’ teleportation arrays are established?"
"Why do we never detect anything?"
Within the Elf Realm, no one could answer this question.
The Demon Race’s teleportation arrays seemed to appear out of thin air.
Without any warning.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 417: The Frenzied Great Demon Monarch (Part 2)
paragraphs: Moreover, this thing looks more like a one-way teleportation array.
Only out, no return.
In other words, once those Abyssal Monsters appear, all paths are effectively cut off.
And their goal, is just one.
That is, before death, to inflict greater destruction on the Holy Spirit Realm.
At this moment, an Elf powerhouse spoke.
"Enough talk! Those Demons are emerging again, let’s quickly follow the army and suppress them."
"Don’t let those Demons ravage our Elf Realm."
As soon as he finished speaking, he immediately rushed in the direction of the teleportation array,
In an instant, Elf armies from various places mobilized one after another.
At the same moment, those terrifyingly-shaped Demons surged out from the teleportation array like a tide.
Upon their emergence, a menacing expression appeared on their faces.
"Finally, I’ve arrived in the Holy Spirit Realm! Now, I can slaughter these pitiful ants without restraint!"
"I want to kill all these Elves and arrange their corpses in the shape of a hexagram!"
"Hahaha!"
Those Demons laughed madly.
Meanwhile, powerhouses of the Elf Race rushed over.
They shouted, "Vile Demons, cease your arrogance!"
"Soldiers, follow me to slay them!"
A fierce battle erupted between the two sides once more.
"Boom! Boom!"
The black Power of the Demon and the blue Divine Power of the Elf Race clashed repeatedly.
Half an hour later.
With the advantage of defense towers and numbers, the Elf Race once again extinguished the mad advance of the Abyssal Army.
At this moment.
Some Legendary Elves bore some injuries.
They stood on the spot with difficulty, letting out a long sigh of relief.
"Finally, we’ve slaughtered these crazy Demons again."
"Truly, I wonder how many monsters the Abyss Realm still holds!"
Just as they were about to find peace.
A towering red column of light suddenly appeared in the Elf Royal City.
This column of light was larger than any previous teleportation array.
Simultaneously, an extremely powerful aura surged forth.
Moreover, this aura appeared in the residential zone of the Royal City.
At least millions of Elf Race civilians felt this aura, and instantly died violently!
"Puff! Puff! Puff!"
The bodies of millions of civilians exploded!
All Legendary Powerhouses cast their gaze over there, shock flashing in their eyes!
From this aura, they sensed an overwhelming fear.
And what could invoke such fear in these legends could only be an existence of even higher level!
"Demigod..."
"Oh my god, a Demigod-level Demon actually came through the teleportation array!"
"Could it be that the Abyss Realm is preparing for full-scale invasion?"
The Legendary Elves cried out in despair.
Yet, from the Elf Royal City, came the maniacal laughter of that Demigod-level Demon,
"Haha! Hahaha!"
"Humble Elf Race, you’ve been blocking the plans of my Abyss Realm, delaying our strides of invasion!"
"Now, it’s time to pay the price!"
The Demigod-level Demon extended its blood-red demon claws.
The overwhelming black aura spread over the sky above the Elf Royal City.
If this strike were to fall.
At least tens of millions of civilians would perish in an instant!
Just as it was about to act, to harvest the lives of that group of civilians.
At that moment.
A whisper appeared within the Royal City.
"Demon..."
Then, an extremely ancient aura surged up.
This aura seemed to have been dormant for too long, even emanating a decaying sensation.
However, among those Legendary Elves, it sparked a Demigod-level aura.
Even stronger than that Great Demon Monarch.
"Buzz!"
Caught unprepared, the Demigod-level Demon was directly blasted into the sky.
The Elves felt this aura familiar yet powerful.
A moment later, as if remembering something, they exclaimed one after another: "That seems to be Deimer; he’s not dead?"
"My god! A genius from ten thousand years ago!"
The Demigod-level Demon, after being blasted into the air, roared in rage.
"Who dares to ambush me?"
"Show yourself, I want to tear you into pieces!"
The moment the Great Demon Monarch’s voice fell.
In the Royal City appeared a male Elf with all-white hair and pointed ears.
Although possessing Demigod-level strength, his appearance was extremely old.
Upon seeing the back of this mighty figure, the civilians of the Elf Race below looked on with doubtful and uncertain eyes.
For they discovered that this silhouette was strikingly similar to a certain figure venerated in their ancestral grounds,
"This silhouette seems to be our race’s eleventh Elf King..."
"My gosh... How could this appear here?"
Upon hearing the civilians’ address, the Demigod-level Demon seemed to comprehend something.
"Eleventh Elf King, one from ten thousand years ago; you really are an older entity than me..."
"Old one! How have you survived?"
The Great Demon Monarch inquired bluntly.
"Humph!"
In response, the aged Elf snorted coldly.
The Demigod-level Demon instantly felt as if struck by lightning.
Dark blood even sprayed from its mouth.
The demon blood fell upon the ground of the Royal City, making sizzling sounds,
Yet it felt no fear; instead, a gleeful smile emerged on its face.
Displaying the madness of the Abyss Realm to its fullest!
"Interesting, you look like you’re on your last breath, yet you can still explode with high-tier Demigod strength."
"This, might be the trump card of your Elf Race, right?"
"Forcing you, this old creature, out, and I’ve exceeded my objectives!"
"Hahaha!"
As it finished speaking, it took the initiative to charge toward the Demigod-level Elf.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 417: The Mad Great Demon Monarch (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Boom!"
The intense collision turned the world into two colors in an instant.
One side was bright white, and the other was overwhelming red.
At this moment, the white divine power suppressed the magic power of the Great Demon Monarch.
Now, the situation looked like the Elf’s power was clearly more formidable than its own.
Yet, this Great Demon Monarch was nearly burning everything in the battle against its opponent.
The Great Demon Monarch seemed unable to hold on.
So it shouted loudly!
"Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"
As the words fell, the Great Demon Monarch’s body expanded dramatically again, and its aura directly reached high-tier Demigod Level!
With just the flesh body’s strength, it already rivaled those Insect Kings that achieved flesh ascension in the Insect Race ruins!
Relying on the body’s strength, it rushed forward to engage in close combat with the Elf Race’s formidable fighter!
Each of its strikes would be intercepted by the demigod-level Elf, resulting in some injuries.
"Puff! Pfft Pfft!"
Demon blood splattered!
Nonetheless, this Great Demon Monarch showed no fear.
It charged towards the demigod-level Elf, fearless and relentless.
Pushing the Abyss Race’s madness to its extreme.
The demons of the Abyss Realm are truly powerful.
Rarely meeting any opponents at the same level.
Han Xing and the others felt nothing because their power was sufficient to crush the demigod-level demons head-on.
Without giving the opponent any chance to entangle in battle.
For other demigods, even if one level higher than these demons, it would still be extremely troubling.
Under its frenzied tactics.
The demigod Elf seemed reluctant to use all its power, being continually pushed back.
It’s crucial to remember that its aura was of a high-tier demigod.
Yet it was being suppressed by this demon of only middle-tier demigod level.
At this moment, the Great Demon Monarch, bleeding, wore a look of surprise.
"I see, this old fellow has already been wounded, should have perished ten thousand years ago."
"Yet by some means, managed to survive till now, hence hesitates to attack full force."
"Hahaha!"
"Today, see me tear you apart alive!"
The injuries on the Great Demon Monarch were already severe.
But it showed no fear, charging more ferociously.
As if, in its eyes, defeating the ruler of the Elf Race was a grand honor.
Even if it meant sacrificing life, it was worth it!
The elderly-looking Elf frowned.
While the Great Demon Monarch engaged in its insane tactics, it did not act impulsively.
Instead, chose to adopt passive defense.
The white divine power enveloped its body, like a Holy Light Ball.
Each swing of the Great Demon Monarch’s fist would send the Holy Light Ball flying tens of thousands of meters away.
Then, the Great Demon Monarch would chase after it, executing relentless suppressive attacks.
"Bang! Bang Bang!"
The Holy Light Ball was continuously struck and flown.
It laughed maniacally!
"Haha! Hahaha!"
"What Elf King, is nothing more!"
Facing the Great Demon Monarch’s mockery, the Elf King inside the Holy Light Ball sighed.
Being knocked around like a ball before billions of tribesmen, even sounded slightly embarrassing.
Yet he did not act impulsively.
Understanding his physical condition, all objectives were to stall this Great Demon Monarch from harming other civilians.
And at that moment.
In the distance appeared another extremely formidable presence.
Upon its emergence, the white divine power blasted through the blood-red magic power of the Great Demon Monarch.
In the Elf Main City, the oppressive feeling overhead vanished.
Moreover, a strong belief surfaced in their hearts.
Everyone knew.
This was the Elf King of this generation!
Possessing top demigod level combat power!
"Elf King!" the Great Demon Monarch exclaimed.
Before it could react.
It saw the Elf King, at great speed, swiftly rushing towards the location of the Great Demon Monarch.
In an instant, the Elf King directly showcased crushing-level combat power!
He extended a finger.
A white divine power shot forth.
"Puff!"
The Great Demon Monarch’s body was instantly pierced with a blood hole, rapidly falling.
Before it could react.
The Elf King appeared beneath it at an even faster speed.
He extended his right hand, then opened his palm.
A mass of white divine power coalesced therein.
"Boom!"
A light pillar shot skyward.
Directly pierced through the proudly boasted body of the demigod-level demon.
The Great Demon Monarch spat out another mouthful of fresh blood.
Clutching the blood hole on its chest, it looked at the Elf King, shocked, and said: "So strong!"
"Are you the Elf King of this era?"
"Your power is nearly approaching the Demon God of my race!"
The Elf King did not respond.
Instead glanced, eyes as sharp as flames!
At this moment, from the Elf King’s eyes, two highly destructive white beams shot forth again!
"Zing! Zing!"
Aware of the terrifying attack power of the Elf King, the Great Demon Monarch hurriedly dodged.
Yet, as it regained composure.
It found the Elf King already behind it.
Even swifter than the speed of the divine white beams.
"So fast..."
The next moment.
The Great Demon Monarch suddenly felt pain at its neck.
Before it could respond.
It saw its head separated from its body.
The Great Demon Monarch’s eyes filled with a look of confusion.
Seemingly not expecting the Elf King’s actions to be so swift, yet fierce.
The demon’s head was hoisted by the Elf King in mid-air, watching as its body fell into the endless deep void.
In the final moments of life, this demigod-level demon seemed to accept its impending death.
A sinister grin appeared at its mouth corner.
"Two Elf Kings come together to kill me, and even forced out your Elf Race’s ace card!"
"I die not in vain!"
"Hahaha!"
In its rampant laughter.
The demon’s head was crushed on the spot.
Blood stained the sky!
"Puff!"
After the Great Demon Monarch’s death, battles in other areas swiftly concluded as well.
After bearing certain casualties.
The Elf Race finally repelled this invasion of the Abyssal Army once again...

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 418: Full Level for All Members
paragraphs: Moments later, two Elven Kings from different eras stood together.
The elderly Elf King said, "These recent years, you’ve worked hard."
The current Elf King respectfully bowed and then shook his head, saying, "I haven’t done much; it is you who have suffered."
"Seriously injured as you are, you still worry about the safety of the Elf Race, guarding the Royal City until now."
"Generations of Elves will always remember your contributions!"
The elderly Elf shook his head, "This is nothing."
"Miris, what I am more concerned about is what is to come."
The Elf King looked over.
"Through observing recent events, I have discovered something."
"The one-way teleportation arrays of the Abyss Realm have no pattern and can transport a large number of Abyssal Monsters."
"This mirrors the scenes from ten thousand years ago exactly."
"First came the probing, then more and more Abyssal Monsters were sent to harass us."
"Next, Demigod level and even high-tier Demigod level demons will emerge from the Abyss."
Miris, the modern Elf King, was shocked upon hearing this.
He respectfully asked, "Former King, are you implying that the Abyss Realm will launch a full-scale invasion like ten thousand years ago?"
The elderly Elf nodded, "It is very possible."
"Now, Demigod-level demons have already appeared."
"Though you have slain them, you should know the power of the Abyss Realm is much greater than that."
"The Abyss Realm is a domain of its own, not bound by the rules of the Holy Spirit Realm, allowing them to break the limits of Demigods."
"Above the Demigod-level Demon Monarchs, there are even more powerful Demon Gods..."
After hearing the elderly Elf speak.
Miris stood in place, worry clouding his eyes...
In the ensuing days.
Just as the elderly Elf had predicted, the frequency of teleportations from the Abyss Race increased.
Even Middle-tier Demigod level Demon Monarchs began to appear.
The Elf Race paid a great toll in lives and injuries for this.
Time flew by.
Another month passed.
In the City of Ten Thousand Stars at this time.
Five incredibly formidable figures appeared.
They were Han Xing and his group, having returned from the Abyssal Rift at level 60.
The five of them were clad in complete sets of black leather armor, magic robes, heavy armor, and light armor...
These were Abyssal Magical Artifact Sets: Shadow of Darkness, Executioner’s Hand, Flame of the Tyrant, Giant Demon Stone, and more.
At this moment.
The five stood there, excitement on their faces.
During their two-month journey through the Abyssal Rift, they explored it at least 400 times.
All of them had reached level 60, including Coal Ball.
The reason they continued for another half month.
Was because they were missing only the last piece, the Executioner’s Hand Helmet.
Effort pays off for those who work hard.
After half a month’s effort.
They opened nearly 200 Abyssal Sun Treasure Chests.
At last, they obtained the final piece of Executioner’s Hand!
Now, equipped with a full set of Abyssal Magical Artifacts, their attributes had significantly increased.
Han Xing glanced at his panel attributes.
[Name]: Han Xing·Witch Race Saint Master
[Profession]: Wild Ranger·Legend
[Level]: Level 60 (0%)
[Attributes]: Power 65231+65231, Agility 91739+91739, Spirit 59269+59269, Constitution 63871+63871.
[Divine Power Value]: 7132.

[Equipment]: Demon-Defying Battle Bow (Red), Dark Shadow Bracelet (Abyssal Magical Artifact), Dark Shadow Helmet, Shadow of Darkness Leather Armor, Dark Shadow Lower Armor, Shadow of Darkness War Boots (Dark Shadow Set 5/5), Shining Soul Necklace (Orange), Demon Eye Ring (Orange)...
Compared to before, Han Xing switched out the Orange Wandering Demon Set for the complete set of Abyssal Magical Artifacts, significantly boosting his attributes.
Now, he only needed to change his weapon and then search for other Sacred Artifact Equipment.
Han Xing’s equipment would essentially reach a perfect level.
Speaking of Sacred Artifacts.
Han Xing currently held two Sacred Artifact Equipment.
They were the Galaxy Dream-Casting Necklace and the Master of War Ghosts Wristguard.
Both pieces of equipment are level 60.
Logically, Han Xing should be able to equip them directly now.
However, when he tried to equip them, he received a system prompt.
[Due to your profession tier not breaking through to Demigod, you cannot equip Sacred Artifact level sets.]
At this point, Han Xing realized that in order to equip Sacred Artifact Sets, there were additional requirements.
Besides reaching level 60, breaking through to Demigod was also necessary.
The team members were also looking at their panels, excitement showing in their eyes.
Their strongest attributes had all surpassed 110,000.
Zhang Lianmeng’s Spirit Attribute even surpassed 130,000.
Although still trailing behind Han Xing’s 180,000 Agility Attribute.
Compared to when they were level 57.
Their power had experienced a spectacular surge.
Cheng Jianyong regretfully shook his head and said, "It’s a pity we can’t immediately break through to Demigod."
"Otherwise, I’d dare to challenge the Dwarf King or a top Demigod like Hawthorne Glaser!"
The team members simultaneously looked at him.
Shen Yun jokingly said, "So what level do you think your current strength is?"
Cheng Jianyong pondered, "In a non-burst state, probably on par with an Initial-tier Demigod, and in a burst state, I should be able to take on a Middle-tier Demigod."
Everyone nodded.
At over 50 levels, Cheng Jianyong could heavily wound a typical Demigod in burst state.
Reaching level 60, having such power is already outstanding.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, they were prodigies rarely seen in thousands of years.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 418: Full Level for All Members (Part 2)
paragraphs: If Cheng Jianyong can break through to demigod, he might undergo another significant transformation.
Then, perhaps he could directly possess the combat power of a high-tier demigod, or even a top demigod.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, what’s your current strength level?"
Han Xing smiled, "Take a guess."
Cheng Jianyong thought for a moment, "I reckon Brother Xing might be capable of going toe-to-toe with someone like the Dwarf King by now?"
Han Xing shook his head.
In fact, he didn’t even know the extent of his current combat power.
Because he had too many trump cards in his hand.
Without relying on these trump cards, Han Xing estimated he might not be a match for the Dwarf King.
But he was still stronger than a typical high-tier demigod.
If he used his trump cards, he dared to challenge even a divine level entity.
It’s hard to imagine that this was something achievable by someone only at the legendary level.
This was almost like crossing two major levels to fight.
If Han Xing could break through to demigod, how terrifying could his power become?
The mere thought of it was exciting.
But right now, not only had Han Xing not broken through, but the other team members had not either.
There were two reasons.
One was the lack of suitable divine formats.
The second was that Han Xing had other ideas in mind.
Shen Yun had the ’Justice’ divine format, but because the God of Justice himself hadn’t died yet,
this divine format was only considered a backup option.
If the God of Justice knew his divine format was being treated as a backup by Han Xing and the others, he might die of anger.
At this moment, Shen Yun suddenly said, "Brother Xing, didn’t you have a divine format of the Wild Ranger?"
"Aren’t you going to use it to break through?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No rush, that old tree told me."
"Besides using someone else’s divine format to break through, there’s another way to become a demigod."
"And that is to condense your own divine format."
"It said that this path is the road to becoming the strongest divine spirit."
"I want to try and see if there’s a chance to accomplish this."
Hearing this.
The team members recalled the events that the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots had told them at that time.
Condensing one’s own divine format and then breaking through to demigod is an extremely difficult task.
No, even saying extremely difficult doesn’t quite capture it!
According to the old tree, in history, it had only seen two people achieve this.
One was the Hunter, the other was the Emperor of the Demon Race.
Both of these figures do not need much elaboration, as they had far-reaching impacts in the history of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Their achievements far surpassed that of a divine spirit.
However, no matter how difficult this task becomes,
they all believed that Han Xing could achieve it.
Because he was someone who constantly created miracles.
Looking at the team’s expressions.
Han Xing said at this point, "Seems like we have a chance, we need to head to the Sky Island Forest again and ask that old tree about the specific method.
"Strive to have everyone break through to demigod as soon as possible."
Everyone nodded.
"Brother Xing, where to next?"
Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked, his eyes filled with anticipation.
Han Xing understood what he was thinking.
In the past two months, everyone had spent their time in the Abyssal Rift.
Faced with the overwhelming number of abyssal monsters, they were almost sick of it.
Now, they desperately wanted a change of scenery.
Han Xing thought for a moment, planning his subsequent actions in his mind.
There were many places he needed to go.
First being Zhang Lianmeng’s Seven Elements Divine Format.
Only the last two pieces were missing now.
And he knew where these two divine formats were located.
Respectively, at Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands.
But these two places were too far away from them.
Going there and back would take at least two to three months.
The second place he wanted to visit was within the Endless Void.
The last time, the corpse of that beast lingered on Han Xing’s mind.
Because, inside the beast’s body, he saw a true divine spirit and a vast race.
Now, with his current strength, he could deal with these divine spirits.
If possible, Han Xing wanted to return near the beast’s corpse and probe the reality of that divine spirit.
As for the third objective.
That was, of course, finding the remaining Holy Artifact Set.
But this search had no clues, not even a known location.
Besides that, there were also other goals like exploring the ancient ruins of the Dwarf Race.
These all needed to be accomplished step by step.
Thinking of this, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, head to Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands first."
"Collect those two divine formats and let Lianmeng break through to demigod first."
The teammates’ eyes lit up upon hearing this.
They nodded eagerly.
They indeed wanted to see the changes after the survivors broke through to demigod.
Fortunately, Zhang Lianmeng could set an example for them.
Just as the teammates were about to set off.
A powerful aura suddenly rose from the distance.
And it quickly rushed towards Han Xing and the others.
The five of them stood in place.
Because this aura was very familiar to them.
Moments later, a short-haired youth with a neat appearance appeared before Han Xing and the others.
High Priest Xiao looked at Han Xing and then at the team members around him.
Then he saluted and said, "Greetings, Saint Master."
"Greetings, warriors of the Human Race."
Han Xing waved his hand and said, "Xiao, what’s the matter?"
Xiao hurriedly said, "Saint Master, I have something urgent to report!"
"Half a month ago, the Elf Race issued a call for help to all the major races in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"The Abyss Race is massively invading their Elf Realm, and it’s escalating."
"In fact, there’s already a sign of a comprehensive invasion."
"With the Elf Race alone, they cannot resist the powerful Abyss Realm."
"They are now requesting assistance from all the major races in the Holy Spirit Realm!"
Upon hearing Xiao’s words.
The five of them exchanged a glance.
As they had just emerged from the Abyssal Rift, and now to hear that the Abyss Realm was about to fully invade?
Han Xing asked, "Is the situation on the Elf Race’s side very dire?"
Xiao replied worriedly, "It’s quite dire..."
"According to them, the Demon Race has now begun recklessly activating one-way teleportation arrays, with a large number of abyssal monsters emerging from them daily."
"The Elf Race’s forces are being heavily depleted, and even some Sky Islands have already fallen."
"And most critically, a middle-tier demigod level demon appeared from the Abyss Realm’s teleportation array not long ago."
"After being wounded by the Elf King, that demon fled the Elf Realm; now, no one knows where it is hiding in the Holy Spirit Realm."
At this moment, all five of them furrowed their brows.
The Elf Race’s situation was indeed dire, as even a middle-tier demigod level demon had appeared.
And most alarmingly, they let that demigod level demon escape.
This indicates that the Abyss Realm has already developed the means to transmit demigod demons to the Holy Spirit Realm.
With their recent exploration of the Abyssal Rift, they’ve become more aware of the Abyss Realm’s fearsome nature.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, demigods are the pinnacle of combat power.
In the Abyss Realm, besides demigod level Great Demon Monarchs, there are even more terrifying beings known as Demon Gods.
These are creatures with combat power equivalent to divine level entities.
Han Xing asked with a frown, "You said this was news from half a month ago?"
Xiao nodded, "Yes, Lord Saint Master."
"For the past few days, I couldn’t sense your presence and didn’t want to disturb you, so I didn’t contact you, Saint Master."
Han Xing nodded, his brow furrowing again.
According to Xiao’s account.
The Abyss Realm’s invasion had already been intensifying prior to this.
After half a month, the situation for the Elf Race might be even worse.
This is an issue concerning the entire Holy Spirit Realm; letting the Elf Race face it alone seems out of the question.
Moreover, it’s very likely the Elf Race cannot withstand such pressure.
Once the Elf Race collapses, the Abyss Realm can invade the Holy Spirit Realm even more recklessly.
By then, there won’t be a single safe place in the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
Han Xing asked, "Have strong warriors from other races already gone over?"
Xiao replied, "Most races have sent their strong warriors, with their legends and demigods heading there first."
"As for their armies, they might still be on their way."

"And that is to condense your own divine format."
"It said that this path is the road to becoming the strongest divine spirit."
"I want to try and see if there’s a chance to accomplish this."
Hearing this.
The team members recalled the events that the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots had told them at that time.
Condensing one’s own divine format and then breaking through to demigod is an extremely difficult task.
No, even saying extremely difficult doesn’t quite capture it!
According to the old tree, in history, it had only seen two people achieve this.
One was the Hunter, the other was the Emperor of the Demon Race.
Both of these figures do not need much elaboration, as they had far-reaching impacts in the history of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Their achievements far surpassed that of a divine spirit.
However, no matter how difficult this task becomes,
they all believed that Han Xing could achieve it.
Because he was someone who constantly created miracles.
Looking at the team’s expressions.
Han Xing said at this point, "Seems like we have a chance, we need to head to the Sky Island Forest again and ask that old tree about the specific method.
"Strive to have everyone break through to demigod as soon as possible."
Everyone nodded.
"Brother Xing, where to next?"
Cheng Jianyong tentatively asked, his eyes filled with anticipation.
Han Xing understood what he was thinking.
In the past two months, everyone had spent their time in the Abyssal Rift.
Faced with the overwhelming number of abyssal monsters, they were almost sick of it.
Now, they desperately wanted a change of scenery.
Han Xing thought for a moment, planning his subsequent actions in his mind.
There were many places he needed to go.
First being Zhang Lianmeng’s Seven Elements Divine Format.
Only the last two pieces were missing now.
And he knew where these two divine formats were located.
Respectively, at Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands.
But these two places were too far away from them.
Going there and back would take at least two to three months.
The second place he wanted to visit was within the Endless Void.
The last time, the corpse of that beast lingered on Han Xing’s mind.
Because, inside the beast’s body, he saw a true divine spirit and a vast race.
Now, with his current strength, he could deal with these divine spirits.
If possible, Han Xing wanted to return near the beast’s corpse and probe the reality of that divine spirit.
As for the third objective.
That was, of course, finding the remaining Holy Artifact Set.
But this search had no clues, not even a known location.
Besides that, there were also other goals like exploring the ancient ruins of the Dwarf Race.
These all needed to be accomplished step by step.
Thinking of this, Han Xing said, "Let’s go, head to Crystal Mountain and the Monsoon Islands first."
"Collect those two divine formats and let Lianmeng break through to demigod first."
The teammates’ eyes lit up upon hearing this.
They nodded eagerly.
They indeed wanted to see the changes after the survivors broke through to demigod.
Fortunately, Zhang Lianmeng could set an example for them.
Just as the teammates were about to set off.
A powerful aura suddenly rose from the distance.
And it quickly rushed towards Han Xing and the others.
The five of them stood in place.
Because this aura was very familiar to them.
Moments later, a short-haired youth with a neat appearance appeared before Han Xing and the others.
High Priest Xiao looked at Han Xing and then at the team members around him.
Then he saluted and said, "Greetings, Saint Master."
"Greetings, warriors of the Human Race."
Han Xing waved his hand and said, "Xiao, what’s the matter?"
Xiao hurriedly said, "Saint Master, I have something urgent to report!"
"Half a month ago, the Elf Race issued a call for help to all the major races in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"The Abyss Race is massively invading their Elf Realm, and it’s escalating."
"In fact, there’s already a sign of a comprehensive invasion."
"With the Elf Race alone, they cannot resist the powerful Abyss Realm."
"They are now requesting assistance from all the major races in the Holy Spirit Realm!"
Upon hearing Xiao’s words.
The five of them exchanged a glance.
As they had just emerged from the Abyssal Rift, and now to hear that the Abyss Realm was about to fully invade?
Han Xing asked, "Is the situation on the Elf Race’s side very dire?"
Xiao replied worriedly, "It’s quite dire..."
"According to them, the Demon Race has now begun recklessly activating one-way teleportation arrays, with a large number of abyssal monsters emerging from them daily."
"The Elf Race’s forces are being heavily depleted, and even some Sky Islands have already fallen."
"And most critically, a middle-tier demigod level demon appeared from the Abyss Realm’s teleportation array not long ago."
"After being wounded by the Elf King, that demon fled the Elf Realm; now, no one knows where it is hiding in the Holy Spirit Realm."
At this moment, all five of them furrowed their brows.
The Elf Race’s situation was indeed dire, as even a middle-tier demigod level demon had appeared.
And most alarmingly, they let that demigod level demon escape.
This indicates that the Abyss Realm has already developed the means to transmit demigod demons to the Holy Spirit Realm.
With their recent exploration of the Abyssal Rift, they’ve become more aware of the Abyss Realm’s fearsome nature.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, demigods are the pinnacle of combat power.
In the Abyss Realm, besides demigod level Great Demon Monarchs, there are even more terrifying beings known as Demon Gods.
These are creatures with combat power equivalent to divine level entities.
Han Xing asked with a frown, "You said this was news from half a month ago?"
Xiao nodded, "Yes, Lord Saint Master."
"For the past few days, I couldn’t sense your presence and didn’t want to disturb you, so I didn’t contact you, Saint Master."
Han Xing nodded, his brow furrowing again.
According to Xiao’s account.
The Abyss Realm’s invasion had already been intensifying prior to this.
After half a month, the situation for the Elf Race might be even worse.
This is an issue concerning the entire Holy Spirit Realm; letting the Elf Race face it alone seems out of the question.
Moreover, it’s very likely the Elf Race cannot withstand such pressure.
Once the Elf Race collapses, the Abyss Realm can invade the Holy Spirit Realm even more recklessly.
By then, there won’t be a single safe place in the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
Han Xing asked, "Have strong warriors from other races already gone over?"
Xiao replied, "Most races have sent their strong warriors, with their legends and demigods heading there first."
"As for their armies, they might still be on their way."

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 419: Abyss Realm Invasion, Journey to the Elf Race
paragraphs: Han Xing nodded after hearing.
"I understand."
"Reply to the Elf Race that I am preparing to go to the Elf Realm."
"As for the army..."
"You will lead half of the Witch Race soldiers, along with half of the legendary and demigod powerhouses from our race, to the Elf Race to provide support."
Xiao was instantly shocked.
Currently, Han Xing’s camp is no longer what it used to be,
Since he subdued the Thunder Beasts of the Broken Land, the number of powerhouses has reached an extremely large number.
When Han Xing says half the powerhouses, it means hundreds of legendary figures and five or six demigods.
In the entire Holy Spirit Realm, apart from the three major races, I’m afraid no other race can muster so many powerhouses.
Xiao hurriedly said respectfully, "Xiao, receiving orders!"
Han Xing nodded.
After Xiao left.
Han Xing looked at the team members and said, "Let’s go, let’s prepare to head to the Elf Realm."
"If the Abyss Realm launches a full invasion, it’s a matter that affects the entire Holy Spirit Realm."
"So no matter where we go now, it’s not safe."
"Let’s first check out the situation over at the Elf Realm."
Everyone nodded solemnly after hearing this.
Then, Han Xing led the Ten Thousand Stars City, and directly left the Witch Race Continent.
From the Witch Race Territory, heading to the Elf Realm.
Even at Han Xing’s speed, it takes four to five days.
If Xiao leads the army forward, this time will be doubled.
Thus, Han Xing’s idea is the same as other major races.
First take Cheng Jianyong and others over, then wait for the others to come.
Upon reaching the familiar Witch Race Border.
Under the gaze of the soldiers.
Han Xing and his team directly entered the Void Turbulence.
One day later.
The massive Ten Thousand Stars City was floating in the air.
Heading slowly toward the direction of the Elf Realm.
During the journey, everyone had nothing to do.
Thus, Han Xing began to check the buildings in his territory.
After more than two months of development, with his massive resource investment.
Han Xing built 400 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, 200 Dark Energy Cannons, and 100 Frozen Star Cannons.
Plus Catastrophe-level Weapons: 50 Towers of Annihilation Lightning, 20 Withered Snowflakes.
Now, Han Xing tallied the number of high-end Defense Towers in his territory.
Altogether, it reached 1600 units.
These Defense Towers consumed a large amount of Han Xing’s resources.
If it weren’t for the depletion of materials like the Extreme Ice Divine Stone, Thunder Divine Stone, and Shimmering Terra Stone,
Han Xing could have raised a few thousand more in one go!
He looked at the blueprints in his backpack.
Now, he still has three blueprints that haven’t been built yet.
The first is the [Catastrophe-level Weapon: Fury Heart Storm]
Building Fury Heart Storm requires Waveless Metal, but until now, Han Xing has not encountered such material.
The second is the Abyss Realm’s [Divine Demon Battleship], needless to say much about this one.
It requires almost a sea of materials to craft a single one.
However, Han Xing has almost gathered everything, just missing the final crucial material, the [Demon God’s Heart], to make it.
As for the last one.
It’s a half-finished product from the Insect Race, a Godslayer Level Weapon: [Celestial Rail Strike Device]
This blueprint also lacks the final material called [World Will].
Even more elusive than the [Demon God’s Heart].
Thinking of this, Han Xing regrettably shook his head, "Alas, just a little bit more."
"Otherwise, the strength of my territory could be elevated another notch."
But now, the firepower on Ten Thousand Stars City is almost sufficient.
According to Han Xing’s estimation.
With the firepower intensity on Ten Thousand Stars City, it can at least handle five Divine Spirits simultaneously.
Of course, specifically against weak gods like the God of Tricks.
If it were stronger Divine Spirits, Han Xing estimates he could handle only two or three at most.
But this is enough for him to roam freely in the Holy Spirit Realm.
After tallying the strength of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Han Xing couldn’t help but feel more confident.
"Very well, this way, even if the Abyss Realm really starts a full-scale invasion, recreating the scene from 10,000 years ago, I am unafraid."
Then, Ten Thousand Stars City continued toward the Elf Realm.
Time swiftly passed...
In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.
The five of them could see from afar a vast sky island appearing ahead.
Although it’s a sky island, it looks more like a series of forests covered with various green plants.
On top, there is the harmonious chirping of birds and the fragrance of flowers, with spring-like weather year-round.
From time to time, individual elves flap their wings flying by.
Compared to the Sky Island Forest, this place is evidently more beautiful.
At this moment, the system notification appeared.
[Successfully discovered the Elf Realm, World Influence +172, Legendary Points +5.]
The five of them exchanged smiles.
Cheng Jianyong said excitedly, "Wuhu, we’ve finally arrived."
This seemed to be somewhere on the border of the Elf Realm.
Han Xing and his team also saw that many warships and peculiar vehicles had appeared around.
On those vehicles, there were demigods or legendary level powerhouses from various races.
From that primitive forest-like sky island,
The Elf Race had long sent many envoys to welcome powerhouses from various races.
At this moment, individual young and beautiful elves were flying in and out from that forest,
Then welcoming powerhouses from various races.
However, like Han Xing and the others, bringing an entire sky island over was indeed the first.
Powerhouses from various races all cast their eyes over.
And when they saw Han Xing and others on it, they were suddenly shocked.
Since the war that wiped out the Ogre Race, the current Holy Spirit Realm is already aware of the Human Race’s terror.
Their eyes carried complex expressions, but no one came to greet Han Xing and his group.
At the same time.
A female elf from the Elf Race also noticed Han Xing and his team.

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 419: Abyss Realm Invasion, Journey to the Elf Race
paragraphs: Suddenly, my eyes lit up.
After saying a few words to the legendary powerhouse of the Flying Elephant Race in front of her, she slightly bowed.
Then she directly flew towards Han Xing and his companions.
On that beautiful Sky Island,
this female Elf unfolded her transparent wings.
Then she slowly ascended into the sky.
Beneath the plain silk dress was an exquisite figure.
Her two slender jade legs hung in midair, like a fairy dancing gracefully.
This scene left the spectators from various races nearly dumbfounded.
It is commonly acknowledged that the Elf Race is the most beautiful in the Holy Spirit Realm.
At this moment, the female Elf gently landed on Han Xing’s Sky Island.
With a faint smile on her face, she walked toward them.
Han Xing and the others sensed waves of Legendary Level divine power emanating from her.
Upon seeing Han Xing, the female Elf slightly bowed, her movements extremely graceful.
"Honored guests of the Human Race, we thank you for coming all the way to the Elf Realm."
"The Elf Race again expresses gratitude for your support."
Before Han Xing could speak, Cheng Jianyong quickly interjected, "Oh, no, it’s nothing!"
"This Elf Race fairy is too polite."
"The invasion of the Abyss Realm is a matter for the entire Holy Spirit Realm; every being living here has the duty to jointly resist the Abyss Realm!"
"In the face of demons, we are duty-bound!"
He spoke with great fervor and passion.
However, the other team members rolled their eyes at him.
Everyone was aware of Cheng Jianyong’s little intentions.
The female Elf softly laughed.
Her smile, like blooming flowers, directly touched the souls of those present.
Cheng Jianyong was nearly mesmerized.
At this moment, the female Elf introduced herself, "My name is Eliza, and I am a Healing Priest of the Elf Race."
"And this should be Saint Master Han Xing, correct?"
Her gaze fell on Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded.
Eliza’s smile grew even more radiant, as she softly said, "I have long admired the name of Saint Master Han Xing."
"Meeting you now, I find Saint Master Han Xing even more imposing than the legends suggest."
Hearing such praise,
Han Xing was slightly embarrassed.
Yet,
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang behind him were looking at Eliza with peculiar gazes.
As if assessing something.
Eliza smiled gently at the two women, paying no particular mind as she spoke.
"Saint Master Han Xing, our Divine Maiden often mentions you; we often hear her recounting your heroic deeds."
"She also says that she considers herself a good friend of yours."
"Has long wished to invite you to visit the Elf Realm~"
Han Xing hesitated for a moment, "Is it Elinora?"
Eliza nodded her head.
"Yes, if the Divine Maiden knew of your arrival, she would surely be very pleased."
"Saint Master Han Xing, shall I lead you to meet the Divine Maiden?"
Han Xing nodded after listening.
Before Eliza could lead the way.
A multicolored light suddenly appeared from afar, approaching at a rapid speed toward the group.
Then quickly landed on Han Xing’s Sky Island, transforming into a human figure.
"No need, I am already here."
Elinora’s voice rang out.
Eliza appeared greatly surprised upon seeing the appearance of the Elf Goddess.
"Divine Maiden, you’re so fast..."
Elinora nodded lightly, "As soon as Saint Master Han Xing arrived at the Elf Realm, I sensed your presence."
"So I came here at once."
"I see, the Divine Maiden truly holds Saint Master Han Xing in high regard~"
Eliza giggled softly, her tone carrying a hint of playful teasing.
Elinora’s cheeks flushed with a tinge of red but she quickly concealed it.
With grace, she walked toward the group, soon standing beside Eliza.
The two peerless beauties of the Elf Race stood together.
Just one glance could offer a feast for the eyes.
Though Eliza was without fault in every aspect.
Her beauty and aura slightly paled compared to Elinora.
This was normal.
After all, Elinora was being groomed to become the next Elf King.
Bestowed with ample resources from a young age, drawing the attention of all.
When Elinora reached Han Xing’s side, she revealed a stunning smile, "Brother Han Xing, long time no see."
She addressed Han Xing not as others did, with the title of Saint Master,
but more like a friend’s greeting.
Han Xing also nodded, "Long time no see."
The two shook hands lightly,
feeling the soft touch of the fingertips.
Then parted as quickly as they united.
Elinora turned her head, addressing Shen Yun and the others, "Friends from the Human Race, long time no see."
Cheng Jianyong and others were surprised when the Elf Goddess greeted them.
And they awkwardly nodded.
Elinora then said, "Brother Han Xing, you must be weary from travel. I will take you to your resting place."
"Tomorrow, I’ll arrange for you to visit the areas in need of defense."
Han Xing nodded.
Though they did not feel particularly exhausted,
some time to adapt to the Elf Realm’s environment was appreciated.
Elinora turned to Eliza and said, "Eliza, I will handle the reception of Brother Han Xing and his companions."
"You go and welcome the other race’s reinforcements."
Eliza chuckled lightly, then bowed, "Yes, Divine Maiden~"
After speaking, Eliza left Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Then, Elinora led the way through Ten Thousand Stars City toward the Elf Realm.
Along the way,
Han Xing and his companions witnessed more vast Sky Islands, resembling a fairyland.
Many elves flew back and forth across the Sky Islands.
And warships from various races patrolled the area back and forth.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 419: Abyss Realm Invasion, Journey to the Elf Race
paragraphs: Always be ready to respond to the sudden appearance of the Abyss Race’s teleportation array.
At that moment.
Elinora suddenly turned around and said, "Brother Han Xing, what are those areas on your Sky Island that are shrouded in divine power?"
She noticed the area covered in divine power when she arrived at Han Xingkong Island.
But because they had just met, Elinora felt a bit embarrassed to ask.
Han Xing smiled, "Nothing much, just a little hobby of mine."
The areas shrouded in divine power were, of course, Han Xing’s 1600 high-tier defense towers.
Since the last time he annihilated the God of Tricks, Han Xing hadn’t used the firepower over Ten Thousand Stars City on a large scale.
Therefore, even the Divine Spirits.
Their impression of Han Xing was stuck at the level of just over three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Only barely able to deal with one Divine Spirit.
They surely wouldn’t have expected.
In just under a year.
The combat strength of Han Xingguang Island had increased five or six times.
This was his ultimate trump card, not easily deployed.
Under Han Xing’s golden divine power.
Not just Elinora, even a strong figure like the Elf King couldn’t discern anything.
And those Divine Spirits, at this time, dared not expose their own aura.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s explanation.
Elinora nodded with some doubts but didn’t ask further.
At that moment.
Han Xing and his group suddenly stopped.
Because, before them, appeared a Sky Island ravaged by war, a disfigured sight.
All the plants were utterly dead.
The ground scorched black.
On top, there was still a large pile of uncleaned corpses.
Mostly Abyssal Monsters, but also some from the Elf Race.
"Was this the doing of the Abyss Race?" Han Xing asked.
Elinora sighed gently, then nodded lightly, "Yes."
"Now, the teleportation arrays of the Abyss Realm are opening more frequently, and without any warning."
"Their teleportation arrays could appear in any corner of the Elf Realm."
Upon hearing this, everyone frowned.
Because, considering this, the teleportation methods of the Abyss Race are truly inconceivable.
Even if it were in Han Xing’s Witch Race Territory, it wouldn’t be possible.
Moreover, they have to guard against the sudden arrival of those demons and prevent them from breaking out of the Elf Realm, causing destruction in other regions of the Holy Spirit Realm.
This is an incredibly difficult task, requiring a large number of troops.
Relying on the Elf Race alone is indeed impossible.
Elinora sighed lightly again, "Actually, this is considered good."
"Recently, Abyss Demons have been frantically invading our Elf Realm."
"This place is just the border, so it has not received their special attention."
"But in the central area, many Sky Islands have been destroyed by them, and many of our race members have died amid the flames of war..."
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but resentfully say, "These damned demons are truly despicable!"
Everyone nodded their heads.
This is a war between worlds, far more terrifying than a racial war.
No matter how extreme the methods of the Abyss Realm are, it’s not surprising.
After advancing for about ten minutes, they gradually arrived at the central area of the Elf Realm.
Just as Elinora described.
There were signs of turmoil everywhere here.
Han Xing and the others even smelled the scent of those Abyssal Monsters in the air.
They had just come out of the Abyssal Rift not long ago, so they were more sensitive to such smells.
Before they could walk much farther.
In the air ahead, suddenly appeared a massive, blood-colored hexagram teleportation array.
"Buzz!"
Initiating brilliant red light shot skyward.
Everyone instantly frowned.
"Wow, did we just happen to encounter an Abyssal Teleportation Array so soon?" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise.
Elinora softly cautioned, "Everyone, be careful!"
As soon as the words fell, a large number of Abyssal Monsters rushed out from the teleportation array.
Demon Eyes, Resentful Spirits, Demon Winged Dragons, and more...
And among them, Han Xing also saw two or three Legendary Creatures.
No need for everyone to act.
Elinora had already transformed into a multicolored streak of light charging out.
The others witnessed her wielding her Magic Staff, as rainfalls of dazzling light started to descend.
Landing on those monsters, constantly made sizzling sounds.
Each Abyssal Monster was instantly pierced through, then fell down.
And they also discovered Elinora, who was casting magic.
A Legendary Level Demon suddenly rushed out, its gaze locked on Elinora.
"It’s an Elf! I’m going to tear you to pieces!"
It transformed into a beam of blood light and instantly rushed over.
However, Elinora remained calm and unruffled.
She lifted her Magic Staff, and that demon, only at middle-tier Legendary Level, was immediately immobilized.
Before it could struggle.
A multicolored streak of light pierced through its body.
"Swish..."
A sound like flowing water echoed.
Once the streak of light passed over.
That demon remained frozen in mid-air, without a single wound on its body.
Yet, there was no breath left in it.
The demon’s corpse descended into Endless Void.
Without even a wail, it died just like that.
This eerie scene left those Abyssal Monsters frozen in place.
In the next moment, a Legendary Level demon reacted.
It shouted crazily, "It’s the Divine Maiden of the Elf Race!"
"Charge together, disregard the cost, tear her apart!"
A surge of Abyssal Monsters charged at Elinora.
Yet, she showed no sign of fear.
Continued elegantly wielding her Magic Staff.
Rainfalls of dazzling light kept descending.
The Abyssal Monsters perished as many as emerged from the array.
Relying on Elinora alone, she pressured the monsters from that teleportation array.
After observing for a while, Han Xing and his group realized Elinora didn’t need assistance, so they simply stood by.
A few minutes later, Elinora had annihilated all the monsters from the teleportation array.
She took a deep breath, her chest subtly rising and falling.
Then gracefully walked back toward everyone.
Upon reaching Han Xing’s side, Elinora resumed her sacred demeanor again.
"Apologies, everyone, for the wait."

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 420: Opportunity to Restore the World Tree
paragraphs: "Excuse me, everyone, for keeping you waiting." Elinora apologized with a bow.
Han Xing shook his head, "It’s no trouble, the safety of the Elf Realm is paramount."
"Divine Maiden, has the invasion of the Demon Race become so frequent?"
Elinora nodded, "Yes."
"And this is the reason we are forced to seek help from various races."
"Although the Elf Race is still quite powerful, compared to the Abyss Realm, we are far inferior."
"At this rate, it won’t be long before the strong warriors of the Elf Race are completely exhausted."
"Once the defense line of the Elf Race is breached."
"The Abyss Realm can invade the entire Holy Spirit Realm unabated."
"At that time, it will be a huge disaster for all living beings in the Holy Spirit Realm."
Everyone nodded in realization after hearing this.
Cheng Jianyong asked at this point, "Divine Maiden, why does the Abyss Race have to activate the teleportation array in your realm?"
Elinora shook her head, "Specifically, I’m not quite sure."
"I only know that this may be related to the Holy Tree of our race."
Upon hearing this, everyone was momentarily stunned.
Elinora continued, "Ever since the roots of the Holy Tree were injured, it has fallen into slumber."
"The space near the Elf Realm has become unstable."
"Since then, demons have frequently activated teleportation arrays in our Elf Realm."
"I think this might be one of the reasons."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
Han Xing suddenly remembered something.
He asked, "Divine Maiden, do you mean if the Holy Tree is restored and the space in the Elf Realm becomes stable again."
"The Abyss Realm won’t be able to continue invading?"
Elinora looked at Han Xing with some confusion.
She shook her head and said, "Specifically, I’m not quite sure either."
"This matter can only be confirmed by asking my father."
The father she referred to is, naturally, the current Elf King.
Elinora tentatively asked, "Brother Han Xing, do you mean you have a way to help restore the Holy Tree of my race?
Han Xing pondered, "I’m not entirely sure, but I can give it a try."
He looked at the [Ancient Spirit Wood] collected in his backpack.
As early as during the Blood Tide, Han Xing had encountered this material when he opened the first Bright Moon Treasure Chest.
He also knew its use could be to restore the World Tree.
However, due to the scarcity of the source of Ancient Spirit Wood, it can only be obtained from Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
So far, he has collected a total of 130,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood from players.
Han Xing is unsure if the quantity is sufficient, so he could only say he is uncertain.
However, Elinora heard a different significance in Han Xing’s words.
This man truly has a way to restore the World Tree!
Concerning the Holy Tree of the Elf Race, Elinora couldn’t help but feel excited!
She cautiously confirmed again, "Brother Han Xing, is what you said true?"
Han Xing did not answer but directly took out a piece of [Ancient Spirit Wood] and handed it to Elinora.
Feeling the pure white branch radiating endless life force and divine power in her hand.
Elinora’s breath instantly halted.
Then she promptly returned this piece of Spirit Wood to Han Xing.
"Brother Han Xing, please put this away quickly and don’t let the Abyss Realm notice!"
"This matter is too significant. I will take you to discuss it with my father immediately!"
At this moment, Elinora fully believed Han Xing’s words.
With that, she prepared to lead Han Xing and the others in a different direction.
Han Xing had no objections.
Just as well, he hoped to meet the legendary strong figure: the Elf King.
Ten Thousand Stars City began to change direction.
And just then.
At least a dozen red light beams shot up into the sky ahead!
"Boom! BOOM!"
A massive number of abyssal monsters erupted from those beams of light.
Within merely a few seconds, Han Xing and the others saw that each teleportation array had spawned at least tens of thousands of abyssal monsters.
Adding up, the number of monsters had already reached two million!
Among them, there were even a few legendary level presences.
Looking at the surrounding abyssal monsters pouring forth.
Elinora bowed and said, "Ladies and gentlemen, please wait for a moment."
"I have notified the nearby warriors to come and support."
"After dealing with the monsters here, I will take you to meet my father."
Elinora was just about to rush out and confront these monsters alone.
And at that moment, an extremely arrogant laughter echoed.
"Ha ha! Hahaha!"
"Abyss Realm! I have arrived!"
"Pitiful beings, are you ready to enter my Demon Furnace?"
Upon hearing this laughter, everyone instantly knew the identity of the newcomer.
A demigod-level demon.
Elinora frowned.
Clearly, relying on Elinora’s power alone, she could not deal with so many abyssal monsters.
Moreover, among them is a powerful Great Demon Monarch.
But she remained unafraid and was ready to charge forward.
Han Xing stopped her and said, "Divine Maiden, there’s no need to trouble yourself."
"We should all make a move together; after all, we came here to help."
Elinora nodded after hearing this.
Meanwhile.
Team members had already gone into battle readiness,
Shen Yun immediately enhanced with two Blessing Skills.
"Let glory bestow upon you power!"
"Buzz!"
At this moment, everyone’s aura instantly surged!
Elinora couldn’t resist glancing sideways.
Because in that instant.
She sensed the intensity of Han Xing and others’ presence.
High-tier Legend!
However, when they began to release their divine power...
