chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 420: Opportunity to Restore the World Tree_2
paragraphs: The momentum surged again, as if breaking through some sort of barrier.
The powerful divine power fluctuations instantly covered the heavens and earth.
Even the distant Elf Sky Island felt some response.
Elinora’s pupils instantly contracted.
"Five demigods?"
In her perception.
Han Xing and the other four all actually possessed the aura of demigod level!
This was truly terrifying!
Mind you, the last time she saw them was merely six months ago.
At that time, they only had the aura of middle-tier legendary level.
For these strong individuals.
Six months was essentially just a fleeting moment.
Yet now, they actually used such a short time to break through to demigod level?
This was simply inconceivable!
After the shock, Elinora seemed to have sensed something.
Although the aura on the five people was extremely powerful, even stronger than the average demigod.
But they did not have the power of rules.
This indicated that they had not actually broken through to demigod level.
Yet this made it even more terrifying!
Not demigods, yet possessing the aura of demigod level.
This was something even Elinora could not achieve.
Thinking of this, Elinora suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of defeat.
She had always been known as the rare Divine Maiden of the Elf Race for thousands of years, possessing extremely formidable cultivation talent.
Now she realized that compared to these Humans, her talent seemed utterly insignificant.
Not to mention, Han Xing, whose aura was even more vast and unfathomable.
At this moment, Han Xing was unaware of her thoughts.
Instead, he directly began to draw his bowstring.
They planned to handle things themselves.
Ten Thousand Stars City was his trump card, and he did not plan to reveal it now.
With the combat power of the five of them, dealing with these abyssal monsters was akin to using a cannon to shoot mosquitoes.
It was completely a crushing level.
"Boom!"
"Bang!"
Meteor Technique and Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill were launched simultaneously, causing a heaven-shaking explosion.
In an instant, two teleportation arrays were destroyed.
Countless abyssal monster corpses were directly blasted to pieces.
The demigod-level Great Demon Monarch roared angrily.
"Damn it!"
The next moment, it shouted loudly: "Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"
This move seemed to be a burst skill known to all Great Demon Monarchs.
It could instantly ignite all the demon blood in its body, raising its strength to a terrifying level.
A red stream of light swiftly rushed toward everyone.
Elinora felt the terror of this strike, and her breath was momentarily halted.
"Brother Han Xing, danger!"
However, Han Xing and the others, as regulars of the Abyssal Rift.
Had slain not eight hundred but a thousand demigod-level demons over the past two months.
Seeing this creature charging, there was no ripple in their hearts.
Meanwhile.
Su Xiaoyang directly shot out an arrow with a green hue.
The speed of the arrow was even faster than Han Xing.
In an instant, it spanned several kilometers, arriving before the Great Demon Monarch.
The Great Demon Monarch opened its mouth full of sharp teeth, seemingly intending to bite the arrow forcibly.
However, it didn’t expect that upon hitting, the arrow instantly extended countless vines.
"Swish!"
The vines instantaneously wrapped the Great Demon Monarch completely.
"Damn it! What is this?"
The Great Demon Monarch shouted angrily.
Responding to it was Han Xing’s Gale·Break and Zhang Lianmeng’s Chain Fireball.
After the terrifying energy fluctuations.
The Great Demon Monarch was blown up on the spot!
[Successfully killed Great Demon Monarch: Ziloyutro (initial-tier demigod), gained experience value of 13.324 billion, successfully absorbed divine power from the opponent, divine power value +50]
At the same time.
A massive soul fire flew out from where the Great Demon Monarch died, then got absorbed by Han Xing’s Demon Furnace.
This was not the Abyssal Rift.
Those monsters could not continue reviving.
Dead means truly dead.
After the fall of this demigod demon, the other abyssal monsters naturally posed no threat.
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng’s attacks continued to bombard.
In addition, with Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi, and Su Xiaoyang’s finishing strikes.
Monsters fell like rain.
The five of them were like bulldozers, crushing the abyssal monsters on the field.
The Elf Goddess was stunned beside them...
She found that although Han Xing and the others showed the aura of an initial-tier demigod.
In reality, their combat power was more terrifying than imagined!
A few tens of seconds later.
When the last teleportation array was destroyed by Han Xing.
The world was silent.
Then, Han Xing turned and said: "Divine Maiden, let’s continue on."
Elinora seemed to just come back to her senses, hurriedly replied: "Ah? Oh, okay!"
She somewhat bewilderedly led the crowd forward.
And along the way, her gaze frequently landed on Su Xiaoyang.
Because, when Su Xiaoyang made her move just now.
She felt a hint of the Elf Race’s aura in her.
Even more pure than her own.
Moreover, Su Xiaoyang’s displayed combat power was also much more formidable than hers.
At this moment, Elinora suddenly had a strange thought.
This human female, could she be the illegitimate daughter of her father and a human?
Elinora shook her head quickly.
Thinking it impossible.
After all, the Human Race had disappeared for hundreds of years.
Only recently became active again in the Holy Spirit Realm.
However, Elinora’s gaze kept flitting toward Su Xiaoyang.
Those pointed ears, snow-white skin.
No matter how she looked, it seemed like the Elf Race.
Yet she also carried a distinctly human aura.
This was really too strange.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang also noticed Elinora constantly looking at her.
Although feeling somewhat strange.
But with Su Xiaoyang’s personality, she would not inquire further.
Thus, Elinora led the crowd flying toward the depths of the Elf Realm.
Half an hour later.
Han Xing and his group roughly crossed tens of thousands of kilometers.
Along the way, they also saw many instances of abyssal teleportation arrays suddenly appearing.
Indeed, as Elinora said.
Those teleportation arrays appeared randomly without any pattern.
It was unpredictable which area a teleportation array would suddenly appear in, from which numerous abyssal monsters would charge out.
Fortunately.
Throughout the Elf Realm, various areas were guarded by strong individuals from the Holy Spirit Realm.
The arrangements of the Elf Race were quite reasonable.
Each race was divided into areas based on their strength.
Responsibility for the safety of this area was given to them.
If encountering special situations, they could request support from strong individuals from other areas.
Thus, above the Elf Realm, one could see many race warships continuously flying by.
Among these warships, Han Xing sensed many familiar auras.
Including legends from the Sea of Light, Stone Men from the Flame Plateau, and strong individuals from the Dwarf Race.
With the help of these strong individuals, it was like a firefighting unit.
If a teleportation array of the Abyss Race appeared in the area they were responsible for.
They would swiftly rush over to extinguish it.
Thus, even though the Abyss Realm came on fiercely.
The situation on the Elf Race’s side was barely manageable.
However, the territory of the Elf Realm was vast, and they couldn’t cover every place.
So, there would always be some that slip through the net.
The demons’ goal was to cause more damage to the Holy Spirit Realm.
Once they emerged, if not blocked by strong individuals, they would rush out of the Elf Realm.
Looking to prey on those weaker life races.
And this, required the action of those at the border army.
The consensus among the strong individuals of the Holy Spirit Realm was not to let abyssal monsters rush out of the Elf Realm and harm other areas.
The borders of the Elf Realm were extremely wide, requiring lots of manpower.
So, they needed to gather more strong individuals from within their race.
This was a war mobilizing the strength of the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
No race could stand aside.
Ten Thousand Stars City kept floating forward.
Finally, two to three hours later.
Elinora led Han Xing and his group to a different Sky Island.
This Sky Island was still filled with all sorts of trees and flowers.
Like a primitive forest.
And in the center of the forest.
Sat a uniquely styled, magically designed plant palace.

sentences.text: The momentum surged again, as if breaking through some sort of barrier.
The powerful divine power fluctuations instantly covered the heavens and earth.
Even the distant Elf Sky Island felt some response.
Elinora’s pupils instantly contracted.
"Five demigods?"
In her perception.
Han Xing and the other four all actually possessed the aura of demigod level!
This was truly terrifying!
Mind you, the last time she saw them was merely six months ago.
At that time, they only had the aura of middle-tier legendary level.
For these strong individuals.
Six months was essentially just a fleeting moment.
Yet now, they actually used such a short time to break through to demigod level?
This was simply inconceivable!
After the shock, Elinora seemed to have sensed something.
Although the aura on the five people was extremely powerful, even stronger than the average demigod.
But they did not have the power of rules.
This indicated that they had not actually broken through to demigod level.
Yet this made it even more terrifying!
Not demigods, yet possessing the aura of demigod level.
This was something even Elinora could not achieve.
Thinking of this, Elinora suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of defeat.
She had always been known as the rare Divine Maiden of the Elf Race for thousands of years, possessing extremely formidable cultivation talent.
Now she realized that compared to these Humans, her talent seemed utterly insignificant.
Not to mention, Han Xing, whose aura was even more vast and unfathomable.
At this moment, Han Xing was unaware of her thoughts.
Instead, he directly began to draw his bowstring.
They planned to handle things themselves.
Ten Thousand Stars City was his trump card, and he did not plan to reveal it now.
With the combat power of the five of them, dealing with these abyssal monsters was akin to using a cannon to shoot mosquitoes.
It was completely a crushing level.
"Boom!"
"Bang!"
Meteor Technique and Dragon-Hunting Arrow Skill were launched simultaneously, causing a heaven-shaking explosion.
In an instant, two teleportation arrays were destroyed.
Countless abyssal monster corpses were directly blasted to pieces.
The demigod-level Great Demon Monarch roared angrily.
"Damn it!"
The next moment, it shouted loudly: "Blood-Inviting Demon’s Arrival!"
This move seemed to be a burst skill known to all Great Demon Monarchs.
It could instantly ignite all the demon blood in its body, raising its strength to a terrifying level.
A red stream of light swiftly rushed toward everyone.
Elinora felt the terror of this strike, and her breath was momentarily halted.
"Brother Han Xing, danger!"
However, Han Xing and the others, as regulars of the Abyssal Rift.
Had slain not eight hundred but a thousand demigod-level demons over the past two months.
Seeing this creature charging, there was no ripple in their hearts.
Meanwhile.
Su Xiaoyang directly shot out an arrow with a green hue.
The speed of the arrow was even faster than Han Xing.
In an instant, it spanned several kilometers, arriving before the Great Demon Monarch.
The Great Demon Monarch opened its mouth full of sharp teeth, seemingly intending to bite the arrow forcibly.
However, it didn’t expect that upon hitting, the arrow instantly extended countless vines.
"Swish!"
The vines instantaneously wrapped the Great Demon Monarch completely.
"Damn it!
What is this?"
The Great Demon Monarch shouted angrily.
Responding to it was Han Xing’s Gale·Break and Zhang Lianmeng’s Chain Fireball.
After the terrifying energy fluctuations.
The Great Demon Monarch was blown up on the spot!
[Successfully killed Great Demon Monarch: Ziloyutro (initial-tier demigod), gained experience value of 13.324 billion, successfully absorbed divine power from the opponent, divine power value +50]
At the same time.
A massive soul fire flew out from where the Great Demon Monarch died, then got absorbed by Han Xing’s Demon Furnace.
This was not the Abyssal Rift.
Those monsters could not continue reviving.
Dead means truly dead.
After the fall of this demigod demon, the other abyssal monsters naturally posed no threat.
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng’s attacks continued to bombard.
In addition, with Cheng Jianyong’s sword qi, and Su Xiaoyang’s finishing strikes.
Monsters fell like rain.
The five of them were like bulldozers, crushing the abyssal monsters on the field.
The Elf Goddess was stunned beside them...
She found that although Han Xing and the others showed the aura of an initial-tier demigod.
In reality, their combat power was more terrifying than imagined!
A few tens of seconds later.
When the last teleportation array was destroyed by Han Xing.
The world was silent.
Then, Han Xing turned and said: "Divine Maiden, let’s continue on."
Elinora seemed to just come back to her senses, hurriedly replied: "Ah?
Oh, okay!"
She somewhat bewilderedly led the crowd forward.
And along the way, her gaze frequently landed on Su Xiaoyang.
Because, when Su Xiaoyang made her move just now.
She felt a hint of the Elf Race’s aura in her.
Even more pure than her own.
Moreover, Su Xiaoyang’s displayed combat power was also much more formidable than hers.
At this moment, Elinora suddenly had a strange thought.
This human female, could she be the illegitimate daughter of her father and a human?
Elinora shook her head quickly.
Thinking it impossible.
After all, the Human Race had disappeared for hundreds of years.
Only recently became active again in the Holy Spirit Realm.
However, Elinora’s gaze kept flitting toward Su Xiaoyang.
Those pointed ears, snow-white skin.
No matter how she looked, it seemed like the Elf Race.
Yet she also carried a distinctly human aura.
This was really too strange.
At this moment, Su Xiaoyang also noticed Elinora constantly looking at her.
Although feeling somewhat strange.
But with Su Xiaoyang’s personality, she would not inquire further.
Thus, Elinora led the crowd flying toward the depths of the Elf Realm.
Half an hour later.
Han Xing and his group roughly crossed tens of thousands of kilometers.
Along the way, they also saw many instances of abyssal teleportation arrays suddenly appearing.
Indeed, as Elinora said.
Those teleportation arrays appeared randomly without any pattern.
It was unpredictable which area a teleportation array would suddenly appear in, from which numerous abyssal monsters would charge out.
Fortunately.
Throughout the Elf Realm, various areas were guarded by strong individuals from the Holy Spirit Realm.
The arrangements of the Elf Race were quite reasonable.
Each race was divided into areas based on their strength.
Responsibility for the safety of this area was given to them.
If encountering special situations, they could request support from strong individuals from other areas.
Thus, above the Elf Realm, one could see many race warships continuously flying by.
Among these warships, Han Xing sensed many familiar auras.
Including legends from the Sea of Light, Stone Men from the Flame Plateau, and strong individuals from the Dwarf Race.
With the help of these strong individuals, it was like a firefighting unit.
If a teleportation array of the Abyss Race appeared in the area they were responsible for.
They would swiftly rush over to extinguish it.
Thus, even though the Abyss Realm came on fiercely.
The situation on the Elf Race’s side was barely manageable.

So, there would always be some that slip through the net.

Once they emerged, if not blocked by strong individuals, they would rush out of the Elf Realm.

The borders of the Elf Realm were extremely wide, requiring lots of manpower.

No race could stand aside.

Sat a uniquely styled, magically designed plant palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 421: 1 Million Ancient Spirit Woods!
paragraphs: The crowd gazed at the uniquely shaped plant palace.
Elinora whispered, "We’ve arrived, Brother Han Xing, this is Father’s residence."
"Everyone, please wait a moment while I report in."
The crowd nodded, watching the plant palace with great interest.
Indeed, the architectural styles of each race are different.
Compared to the architectural styles of various countries on Blue Star.
The Holy Spirit Realm possesses more races and greater power.
Thus, the architecture here is extremely diverse and aesthetically pleasing.
The doors of the plant palace below were tightly closed, indicating it was the private dwelling of some presence.
Elinora closed her eyes, seemingly communicating with someone.
A moment later.
The doors of the plant palace swung open instantly.
From within, a handsome elf male clad in a long white robe flew out.
The crowd did not sense any powerful aura from him.
But it was precisely because they couldn’t sense his aura’s strength that surprised them.
It’s known that with the current strength of Han Xing and the others, not many can conceal their aura in front of them.
Yet this long-haired, graceful man left Han Xing unable to discern his truth.
Compared to the Dwarf King’s meticulous refinement.
The Elf King appeared more low-key.
Upon seeing Elinora, the Elf King nodded.
Then, he looked at Han Xing and the others and said, "Nora has already told me."
"Saint Master Han Xing, do you truly have the means to restore the World Tree?"
He asked directly and straightforwardly.
Han Xing nodded without any superfluous words.
He took out a piece of Ancient Spirit Wood and tossed it to the Elf King.
When the pale, root-like peculiar object was received in his hand.
The Elf King began to release divine power, cautiously sensing the aura contained within.
A moment later, his expression changed from calm to his pupils enlarging.
Then to his eyes widening completely.
The Elf King exclaimed, "It’s true!"
"This contains immensely powerful spiritual power and life force, highly nourishing to the World Tree as a divine artifact."
"Even comparable to the spiritual qi provided by ten ceremonies we hold!"
He looked at Han Xing and the others with astonishment, his voice almost trembling as he asked, "Saint Master Han Xing, do you have more of such divine artifacts?"
Han Xing did not answer directly but countered with a question.
"Your Majesty the Elf King, how many of these spirit woods do you think would be needed to repair the World Tree?"
The Elf King pondered for a moment before tentatively saying, "Approximately... a million?"
Han Xing frowned, "That many?"
The Elf King nodded, somewhat embarrassed, "The World Tree is the supreme holy artifact among the myriad worlds, though the one in the Holy Spirit Realm is merely a more robust branch."
"But the life force and divine power contained within it far exceed the imagination of us demigods."
Upon hearing this, not only Han Xing.
The team members exchanged glances, their eyes revealing a look of confusion.
"Your Majesty the Elf King, are you saying that this one in the Holy Spirit Realm isn’t the main body of the World Tree?"
Han Xing voiced the doubt in his heart.
Seemingly understanding their question, the Elf King nodded.
"Human friends, please follow me into the royal palace, and then we shall talk."
Plant Royal Palace.
In the spacious reception hall.
The five of them sat separately on a massive plant vine chair,
Elinora, following the Elf King’s instructions, produced leaves filled with green vitality.
Then she brewed them with the Water of Morning Dew.
At that moment, the entire reception hall was filled with rich life force and an invigorating fragrance.
The Elf King said, "I have long heard that human friends enjoy drinking tea."
"Please have a taste."
Han Xing and the others didn’t refuse.
These cups of tea were indeed too fragrant.
Elinora respectfully brought the tea to Han Xing and the others.
As Han Xing received it, a clear plant fragrance wafted into everyone’s nose.
At that moment, they felt refreshed and invigorated, like an enlightening experience.
The five couldn’t resist taking a sip.
Then, a system prompt appeared.
[First time consuming World Tree tea leaves, life value +20000, divine power value +200.]
Seeing this prompt, the crowd paused for a moment.
Han Xing asked in confusion, "Are these leaves from the World Tree?"
The Elf King chuckled lightly and nodded.
"You are correct, Saint Master Han Xing."
"Every century, the Holy Tree sheds some leaves that contain potent life force and divine power, which our tribe collects for the younger ones to consume."
"However, it’s only during the first consumption that this effect occurs."
Han Xing and the others nodded.
At this point, the Elf King regretfully added.
"Unfortunately, since the severe damage to the World Tree seven hundred years ago, its life force has been draining significantly."
"The leaves fall more frequently, but those on the tree no longer hold much life force."
"We are greatly concerned that the Holy Tree might fall into decline, a major catastrophe for the entire Holy Spirit Realm and even other worlds."
Han Xing noticed the latter part of the Elf King’s words.
"Other worlds?"
The Elf King seemed to anticipate Han Xing’s question and replied, "You have visited the Dwarven ancient ruins."
"You should know that apart from the Holy Spirit Realm, in the endless void, there are indeed many other worlds."
The crowd nodded in agreement.
This fact was indeed known to them.
The Elf King continued, "In fact, even the World Tree in the Holy Spirit Realm is merely one of the countless branches, one of the more powerful ones."

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 421: 1,000,000 Ancient Spirit Wood! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "The true World Tree is hidden within the endless Void, where no living being can find it."
"In the Void, the branches of that World Tree can connect countless small worlds, bringing the breath of life to those worlds."
"If the branches of the World Tree are damaged, it will no longer provide fresh breath of life to this world, and this world will not be far from destruction."
"In the Ancient Ruins of the Dwarf Race, that Race serves as a cautionary tale."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
"Uh, you also know about this Race?"
The Elf King nodded slightly, "I know a thing or two."
"When a world is no longer infused with new life force, it can no longer give birth to new beings."
"Over time, this world will become lifeless."
"At this time, a Void catastrophe will descend upon this world."
"And in the Ancient Ruins, that’s how that Race perished."
After hearing the Elf King’s explanation, everyone nodded in realization.
Han Xing gave the Elf King a deep look.
Indeed, such a top-level Beings truly know a lot.
Even that there are other worlds hidden in the Void, and even why these worlds are destroyed.
He knew the ultimate answers.
And shared them without reservation with Han Xing and the others.
This was also a demonstration of the Elf King’s sincerity.
At this moment, Han Xing and his four companions exchanged a glance.
For they all had the same thought.
If...
Other worlds are hidden within the Void.
Then, were they, the Humans who suddenly arrived at the Holy Spirit Realm from Blue Star,
also from within the Void?
If so, could they find the former Blue Star within the Void and return?
This question sparked endless imagination among them...
But Han Xing quickly pulled his thoughts back.
He asked, "Your Majesty the Elf King, do you mean that if the branch of the World Tree in the Holy Spirit Realm were to die."
"Then, the Holy Spirit Realm might fall into the same plight."
"In the near future, it might even face complete destruction?"
The Elf King nodded.
However, Han Xing was even more perplexed.
He continued to ask, "According to you."
"The World Tree is the most powerful Holy Artifact in the entire Void Worlds."
"How could its branches be destroyed?"
The Elf King seemed to have anticipated Han Xing’s question and sighed, "It was done by that Demon Emperor."
"Him?" Han Xing was instantly startled.
The Elf King nodded, "In the past ten thousand years, he has taken action twice."
"Once, he cleaved open the Abyssal Rift, creating a passage between two realms."
"Once, he damaged the root of the World Tree in the Holy Spirit Realm."
Upon hearing this, everyone took a deep breath.
From the Elf King’s few words, they sensed the power and terror of that Demon Emperor.
Fear that his strength is far beyond just the Divine Spirit Level.
Even a True God, completely integrated into the rules, is inferior to this Demon Emperor.

Han Xing suddenly thought of something and asked again, "Isn’t it true that the Demon Emperor, wasn’t he forced to retreat almost to defeat in the face of a united front of strong beings from the Holy Spirit Realm ten thousand years ago?"
"Can he still be that formidable?"
However, the Elf King gave a wry smile, "That battle ten thousand years ago was full of mysteries."
"In fact, as far as I know."
"In the end, it wasn’t the Demon Emperor who was forced to retreat, but rather he stopped wanting to fight the beings of the Holy Spirit Realm."
"He withdrew his forces back to the Abyss Realm."
"That one is truly terrifying!"
"No one knows what his true intention is, damaging the Holy Spirit Realm might just be one piece of his plan."
At this moment, the Elf King cast a Divine Power Seal and completely enveloped the Plant Royal Palace.
He quietly said, "Moreover, as far as I know."
"That battle at the end even forced out the ancient beings from the Age of Ten Thousand Gods..."
As soon as the Elf King finished speaking.
A rumbling thunder was heard overhead.
"Boom!"
And this thunderbolt was straightly heading towards the Plant Kingdom.
Everyone felt an oppressive sense of heavenly punishment!
The Elf King casually released a white light.
The white light shot upwards.
Then it collided with the thunderbolt.
"Sizzle...sizzle..."
The two energies tangled with each other.
After a dull explosion, both energies vanished.
The Elf King gave a helpless glance at Han Xing and said, "My young friends have seen, there are many eyes watching the Holy Spirit Realm."
"This has already reached the utmost limit of the information I can reveal..."
Han Xing nodded, "I understand, Your Majesty the Elf King."
"Let’s end this topic here."
The Elf King nodded.
"Now, shall we discuss the matter of repairing the Holy Tree?"
"All right."
Han Xing nodded and replied, "Your Majesty the Elf King, you previously mentioned that repairing the World Tree requires one million Spirit Woods."
"And the amount of Spirit Woods I have is far from this number."
The Elf King quickly shook his head, "It’s okay, Saint Master Han Xing."
"Even if the number of Spirit Woods isn’t a million, a small amount of it will still do."
"For the past seven hundred years, we of the Elf Race have been dedicating all our efforts to repairing the damage to the Holy Tree."
"But no matter how hard we try, all we can do is to delay as much as possible the depletion of the World Tree’s life force..."
"A Holy Artifact like the World Tree is tremendously powerful, making repairs extremely difficult."
The Elf spoke with a look of regret and shook his head.
"If there could be these Spirit Woods for the World Tree to absorb to recover some of its injuries."
"It is expected that with the strong life force of the World Tree, it should be able to slowly heal itself..."

"All right."
Han Xing nodded and replied, "Your Majesty the Elf King, you previously mentioned that repairing the World Tree requires one million Spirit Woods."
"And the amount of Spirit Woods I have is far from this number."
The Elf King quickly shook his head, "It’s okay, Saint Master Han Xing."
"Even if the number of Spirit Woods isn’t a million, a small amount of it will still do."
"For the past seven hundred years, we of the Elf Race have been dedicating all our efforts to repairing the damage to the Holy Tree."
"But no matter how hard we try, all we can do is to delay as much as possible the depletion of the World Tree’s life force..."
"A Holy Artifact like the World Tree is tremendously powerful, making repairs extremely difficult."
The Elf spoke with a look of regret and shook his head.
"If there could be these Spirit Woods for the World Tree to absorb to recover some of its injuries."
"It is expected that with the strong life force of the World Tree, it should be able to slowly heal itself..."

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 421: 1,000,000 Ancient Spirit Wood! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Hearing this, a look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
This is like when humans get an external injury; if the bleeding stops, the wound will heal itself slowly over time.
But if it’s not treated in time, the wound might worsen and lead to death.
Of course, the situation of the World Tree is much more complex than that.
At this moment, Han Xing asked, "Your Majesty, Elf King, how much Spirit Wood do you think is needed to restore the World Tree?"
The Elf King thought for a moment, "About a hundred thousand should be enough?"
After speaking, he cautiously glanced at Han Xing.
Han Xing, upon hearing this, breathed a little sigh of relief.
This number was actually much lower than he had imagined.
So, he directly replied, "I have it."
The Elf King was filled with strong surprise in his eyes.
"Saint Master Han Xing, are you saying that you have 100,000 of such Spirit Wood?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
At this moment, a look of joy appeared in the Elf King’s eyes.
"That’s great!"
"Now, finally, the World Tree has hope!"
Elinora, who was listening to the conversation on the side, also showed a joyful expression.
"Then there’s no time to lose!"
"Saint Master Han Xing, let’s go restore the World Tree right now!"
The Elf King stood up from the throne with a start.
At this point, Han Xing suddenly coughed.
"Uh, please wait a minute, Your Majesty the Elf King."
Hearing these words, the Elf King looked at Han Xing with confusion.
Han Xing seemed a bit embarrassed as he said, "Regarding the matter of compensation..."
The Elf King was momentarily stunned after hearing this.
Then, as if realizing something,
he and Elinora exchanged a knowing smile.
Of course, there was no mockery in their smiles; rather, they felt it was right and proper.
The Elf King smiled and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, I was too excited and forgot about this matter; please forgive me."
His attitude was very friendly, which led everyone present to breathe a little easier.
After all, no matter the world, when two forces negotiate, once interests are involved, some disputes may arise.
Moreover, in fact, restoring the World Tree is beneficial to the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
So the Elf King had reasons to refuse Han Xing’s request,
but the key point is, the World Tree belongs to the Elf Race.
This is something universally acknowledged within the Holy Spirit Realm.
Moreover, for thousands of years, the Elf Race has benefited immeasurably from the World Tree.
As the saying goes, where there is gain, there must be toil.
So, after the World Tree was damaged, the Elf Race has been actively trying to repair it.
They have expended a lot of manpower and precious resources.
They did not ask other races within the Holy Spirit Realm for assistance.
They were quite clear on this point.
Now that Han Xing has brought the Ancient Spirit Wood capable of restoring the World Tree, seeking compensation from the Elf Race is, in their view, entirely appropriate.
"Straightforward!" Han Xing praised the Elf King.
The team members also laughed.
They liked people who were easy to talk to.
The Elf King didn’t mind but instead asked, "What does Saint Master Han Xing require?"
"Whatever your requests are, feel free to mention them. No matter what the Saint Master needs, we will do our best to find it for you."
This statement reveals the Elf King’s determination to restore the World Tree.
He was even prepared to make significant sacrifices.
However, after thinking for a moment, Han Xing said, "Actually, what I need isn’t that precious; it’s just somewhat hard to find."
"I need large quantities of Waveless Metal, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot, Chaos Divine Stone, Calamity Divine Gold, and other materials."
Upon hearing this, the Elf King’s eyes widened slightly.
He didn’t think Han Xing’s demands were extremely valuable.
Instead, compared to the Ancient Spirit Wood, they seemed very ordinary.
However, the Elf King immediately thought of something and tentatively asked, "I wonder how much Saint Master Han Xing needs?"
Han Xing replied, "This time, I plan to provide 130,000 pieces of ’Ancient Spirit Wood’ for the World Tree."
"According to the ratio, one piece of Spirit Wood can be exchanged for 100 pieces of Waveless Metal, Thunder Divine Stone, and Extreme Ice Divine Stone."
"As for the Ancient Elf Secret Ingot, it’s a trade of 20 pieces for one."
"And for materials like Chaos Divine Stone and Calamity Divine Gold, it’s a 1:1 exchange ratio, Your Majesty the Elf King, what do you think?"
The Elf King and Elinora exchanged glances and then smiled lightly.
Because the materials Han Xing mentioned, although they are relatively rare,
they can still be found within the Holy Spirit Realm.
Among them, the Ancient Elf Secret Ingot, their race has quite a few reserves.
Such materials are used for building large Defense Towers or advanced warships.
So every major race has some reserves of these materials.
They were really worried that Han Xing would directly request their Elf Race’s Holy Artifact.
That would have been difficult for them.
But fortunately, Han Xing wasn’t too excessive, and the quantity of materials needed was fairly reasonable.
For a moment, the Elf King and Elinora, in their hearts, raised their Affinity for Han Xing a few notches.
[Because of your actions, you have moved the Elf King, Elf Race Affinity +300.]
Upon hearing this message, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s face.
Because this indicated the deal was sealed.
The Elf King nodded heavily, "Of course, Saint Master Han Xing, we agree to your terms."
Han Xing also smiled, "Then, without further ado, Your Majesty the Elf King, shall we set out now to the World Tree to proceed with the restoration?"
Both of them were people who acted swiftly and decisively.
The Elf King nodded seriously, "Alright!"
"Saint Master Han Xing, please wait for me outside for a moment, I will join you shortly."
After hearing this, everyone left the Elf Race’s Royal Palace together.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 422: Awakening the World Tree
paragraphs: After leaving the Royal Palace where the Elf King resided, everyone stood mid-air, deep in thought.
The conversation with the Elf King had left a significant impression on them.
Firstly, they gained a deeper understanding of the World Tree, such a transcendent Holy Artifact.
It turns out, the World Tree in the Holy Spirit Realm is merely one of the countless branches of the Supreme Holy Tree.
The true body of the World Tree lies within the Endless Void, connecting countless worlds.
The World Tree might be the most powerful Holy Artifact in the entire Void.
Without exception.
Then, the Demon Emperor of the Demon Race made everyone realize its terrifying power once again.
To be able to harm even the Supreme Holy Artifact like the World Tree, the Demon Emperor is truly terrifying.
At this time, Han Xing couldn’t help but ponder a question.
If the Demon Emperor is already this strong, what about the one known alongside it: the Hunter?
Just how powerful is he?
And how did such a powerful being like the Hunter die?
Back then, what he mentioned about the Supreme Hall, what does it mean?
Han Xing was still clueless about these questions.
Even though his current strength was enough to roam the Holy Spirit Realm with impunity.
He still felt a certain powerlessness in front of those mysterious and ancient existences.
After waiting for a moment.
The Elf King slowly flew out from the Elf Royal Palace.
This time, he donned a pure white long robe, adorned with various elegant symbols and pendants.
He appeared extremely sacred and graceful.
He looked at Han Xing and the others and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, and friends of the Human Race, I apologize for the wait."
"Now, shall I take you to the location of our race’s Holy Tree?"
Everyone nodded.
Then they parked the Ten Thousand Stars City next to the Royal Palace.
Leaving Coal Ball to guard it.
With Coal Ball’s current strength, it was enough to deal with ordinary initial-tier Demigods.
And those Legendary-Level creatures, if they dared to approach, they probably wouldn’t even know how they died.
So, leaving Coal Ball to guard the Ten Thousand Stars City made everyone feel very assured.
And even if there was an unexpected situation.
The five of them still had the Oracle Thrones.
Five Oracle Thrones, capable of traversing five million kilometers consecutively!
Nigh traversing half the Elf Realm.
So, no matter where they were, they could return at the first opportunity.
At this moment, the five followed behind the Elf King while flying.
As for Elinora, she had gone ahead early to the location of the World Tree, saying she wanted to make some preparations.
Without relying on the Ten Thousand Stars City, the five’s movement speed not only didn’t slow down, it actually soared dramatically!
Especially Su Xiaoyang, she could now infinitely use the skill [High Altitude Flight].
In flight state, her movement speed increased by 200%.
On the field, even Han Xing’s speed couldn’t match Su Xiaoyang’s.
The Elf King turned into a white light ahead, maintaining a distance from everyone.
As a top Demigod, his movement speed was naturally much faster than Han Xing and the others.
However, when he noticed Han Xing and the others’ movement speed wasn’t slow, a hint of surprise appeared in his eyes.
It’s important to know, he was a top Demigod.
A being whose strength was infinitely close to that level.
Yet those human Legendary Level beings exhibited such speed, which indeed exceeded his expectations.
And in fact, Han Xing and team could go even faster.
That is by summoning the Oracle Throne for flying.
However, the Oracle Throne was one of their hidden cards.
A hidden card is naturally meant to be concealed.
If it becomes known, it wouldn’t be a hidden card, but a hand card.
Thus, they continued maintaining their initial-tier Demigod movement speed, following behind the Elf King.
Six of them spanned tens of thousands of kilometers.
Along the way, they encountered no fewer than a dozen teleportation array burst incidents.
Upon seeing this, the Elf King would cast a stream of light, resolving them with ease.
Whether Legendary or Demigod, upon being hit by the stream of light, they would instantly perish.
Dying entirely!
The Elf King’s casual actions still sent shivers through everyone.
Even in Han Xing’s perception, he was slightly more formidable than the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser.
Han Xing couldn’t help but have some doubts.
Because they already knew that Hawthorne Glaser was a Divine Spirit-level Giant Dragon.
To resist some rule of the Holy Spirit Realm, it had fallen from the Divine Spirit level to a top Demigod.
So how did the Elf King achieve this level of power?
Under full burst, how does he compare to a true Divine Spirit, stronger or weaker?
Han Xing felt a twinge of curiosity towards this openly strongest figure in the Holy Spirit Realm.
However, with such a powerful presence leading the way.
They could say the path ahead was unobstructed.
In less than half an hour.
They had crossed nearly a hundred thousand kilometers.
Here, it was already deep within the Elf Realm.
All around were vast Sky Islands, filled with verdant green.
Previously, these Sky Islands were often home to many Elves.
But now, those Elf civilians had been relocated to safe zones.
The Sky Islands were now defended by Elf Race soldiers.
At this point, the Elf King’s transmission voice suddenly appeared in everyone’s ears.
"Friends of the Human Race, we are near our race’s Holy Land."
Upon hearing this, everyone noticed the change in the surrounding environment.
Firstly, the sky here appeared brighter, as if at the break of dawn, with bursts of Divine Light emerging through the cloud layer.
Even the air contained a trace of life’s breath.
"So we’re almost there?"
Cheng Jianyong asked in confusion, "But why haven’t we seen the World Tree?"

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 422: Awakening the World Tree (Part 2)
paragraphs: Everyone expressed their confusion.
After all, in their impression, the World Tree should be a huge Holy Tree.
But so far, none of them had seen even a hint of the World Tree.
Looking ahead, Han Xing suddenly said: "There’s a cloud layer ahead, it seems to be some kind of restriction."
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze forward.
Indeed, there’s a dense cloud layer obscuring their view, making it impossible to see inside.
This seems to be a method unique to the Elf Race.
As they gradually approached this cloud layer.
The Elf King was already waiting in mid-air.
He looked at everyone and smiled.
"Ladies and gentlemen, are you ready to witness the honor of the Holy Tree?"
Seeing the Elf King so earnest, everyone solemnly nodded.
Their curiosity had been thoroughly piqued.
They were eager to know what this sacred Ancient Tree looked like.
The Elf King did not delay; he waved his hand directly.
The heavy cloud layer in front of them vanished instantly.
At the same time, a world seemingly bathed in golden light appeared before them.
The golden light was so dazzling and holy that it nearly illuminated the entire heavens and earth!
Everyone squinted, straining to see the end of the golden brilliance.
Then, they saw a Holy Tree, shining like gold throughout, towering at a million meters, with billions of branches spread wide!
At this moment, a shock that struck straight to the soul emerged in everyone’s heart!
"Is that the World Tree?"
"It’s so beautiful..."
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but murmur.
Everyone stood in place, unable to contain their amazement.
Despite seeing many species and architecture in this world.
But now.
In front of this sacred Golden Holy Tree.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel a heart-palpitating awe and fascination.
No matter what existence’s power, facing the World Tree, a pilgrim-like feeling would inevitably rise in their hearts.
At this moment, standing at the forefront, the Elf King was upright and proud.
His complexion gleamed under the light, as if plated with gold, appearing sacred and solemn.
Then, he led Han Xing and the others closer to the sacred Golden Tree.
"Brilliant morning star, tree of life~"
"You are the foundation of all, the cradle of life~"
"Ah~"
From time to time, beautiful singing could be heard around.
At the same time.
Ahead was a multitude of elves dressed in priests’ robes, standing with poise in mid-air, waiting for their arrival.
A rough count revealed at least tens of thousands of elves.
The leader was the Divine Maiden of the Elf Race, Elinora.
Even in priestly robes, Elinora’s beauty and impressive figure couldn’t be concealed.
Moreover, it added a sacred and solemn beauty to her.
As they approached.
Tens of thousands of elf priestesses bowed simultaneously.
The Elf King nodded and, without speaking, led Han Xing and the five others toward the Sky Island Continent where the World Tree was located.
The elf priestesses divided into two columns.
Like creating a corridor for pilgrims.
And as they drew closer, the surrounding singing grew louder.
More and more elves appeared.
When Han Xing and the others finally reached the continent where the sacred Golden Tree stood.
There were already hundreds of thousands of elves around them.
They were carefully selected from the entire Elf Kingdom.
Whether in appearance, figure, or temperament, all were impeccable.
However, Han Xing and the others were already uninterested in focusing on these things.
All their attention was on the massive trunk, with countless branches of the Golden Holy Tree before them.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt his body enveloped in a golden light.
And the aura within him rapidly grew.
System notifications appeared continuously,
[Due to receiving the World Tree’s Sacred Blessing, Life Value +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
[Due to receiving the World Tree’s Sacred Blessing, Life Value +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
Seeing the system notifications cascading,
Everyone was stunned.
Whoa!
[What is the Sacred Blessing?]
In just a few seconds, Han Xing saw his Life Value increase by at least 80,000 points and nearly 400 points of Divine Power!
Just by arriving near the World Tree, they triggered such an incredible blessing.
This is too terrifying!
Including the other team members, they received the same blessing as Han Xing.
At this moment, everyone swallowed hard.
Cheng Jianyong said in disbelief: "Wow... this blessing is too outrageous!"
"Continuing like this, just staying near the World Tree would make one invincible!"
As if seeing their astonishment.
The Elf King turned around and said with a smile: "Saint Master Han Xing, and several friends from the Human Race, have you felt the gift from the World Tree?"
Everyone nodded together.
The Elf King chuckled: "This is an opportunity that every creature that reaches Legendary Level enjoys by simply being near the World Tree."
"However, the effect of this gift will not last long."
"Once this golden aura is absorbed by you, it will disappear on its own.
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
As the Elf King said.
At this moment, the system notifications had already slowed down.
And vanished completely a few seconds later.
Nevertheless, it did not conceal the shock in their hearts.
Because they had collectively increased their Life Value by 200,000 points and Divine Power Value by 1,000 points!
This is truly quite frightening.
Even a Demigod-Level ’Life Tree Heart’ could only boost 50,000 points of Life Value and 500 points of Divine Power.
This blessing was even better than two Demigod-Level Life Tree Hearts!
Cheng Jianyong curiously asked at this moment: "Can every Legendary Powerhouse receive such a gift by approaching the World Tree?"
The Elf King shook his head regretfully and said: "It was like that a few thousand years ago."
"At that time, thanks to the blessing of the World Tree, many powerhouses were born in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"But since the World Tree was damaged, no blessings have appeared for many years."
"Even our elf tribe’s newly promoted Legends, when they come near the World Tree, do not receive the enhancement effect."
The Elf King paused, then continued:
"Later, as we learned, this Sacred Blessing consumes the World Tree’s Life Force."
"We have been extremely busy preventing the loss of the World Tree’s Life Force, and it’s also why we dare not let it casually bless."
"I see..." Realization dawned on everyone.
Then, Cheng Jianyong asked: "Um, then why did we receive the blessing effect?"
The Elf King smiled: "The World Tree possesses wisdom and self-awareness, its branches extending to countless worlds, reaching near-omniscience."
"It’s safe to say, throughout the Holy Spirit Realm or the Void Worlds, nothing escapes its knowledge."
"It might have anticipated that you are here to save it."
"So, this is the benevolence this Sacred Tree extends to you."
After listening to the Elf King’s explanation, everyone nodded in understanding.
"Your Majesty the Elf King, what should I do now?"
Han Xing asked: "Is it okay to simply take out the Spirit Wood?"
The Elf King shook his head upon hearing this, "Saint Master Han Xing, please wait a moment."
"Before assisting in repairing the World Tree’s damage, we need to conduct the Awakening Ritual of the World Tree’s Divine Power."
"After the ritual is complete, you can approach the World Tree."
Han Xing nodded and waited silently with his team.
Meanwhile.
As the Elf King made a gesture.
Another wave of loud and sacred singing echoed around.
Then, tens of thousands of young elf females each carried a small wooden bucket.
Like little bees, they lined up to pour the clear dew from the bucket onto the root of the World Tree.
Beside them, more elves were performing peculiar gestures.
The five watched all this with some novelty.
After about ten minutes.
The grand Awakening Ritual finally ended.
Everyone saw the crown of the massive, sky-covering Golden Holy Tree suddenly shake.

sentences.text: Everyone expressed their confusion.
After all, in their impression, the World Tree should be a huge Holy Tree.
But so far, none of them had seen even a hint of the World Tree.
Looking ahead, Han Xing suddenly said: "There’s a cloud layer ahead, it seems to be some kind of restriction."
Upon hearing this, everyone turned their gaze forward.
Indeed, there’s a dense cloud layer obscuring their view, making it impossible to see inside.
This seems to be a method unique to the Elf Race.
As they gradually approached this cloud layer.
The Elf King was already waiting in mid-air.
He looked at everyone and smiled.
"Ladies and gentlemen, are you ready to witness the honor of the Holy Tree?"
Seeing the Elf King so earnest, everyone solemnly nodded.
Their curiosity had been thoroughly piqued.
They were eager to know what this sacred Ancient Tree looked like.
The Elf King did not delay; he waved his hand directly.
The heavy cloud layer in front of them vanished instantly.
At the same time, a world seemingly bathed in golden light appeared before them.
The golden light was so dazzling and holy that it nearly illuminated the entire heavens and earth!
Everyone squinted, straining to see the end of the golden brilliance.
Then, they saw a Holy Tree, shining like gold throughout, towering at a million meters, with billions of branches spread wide!
At this moment, a shock that struck straight to the soul emerged in everyone’s heart!
"Is that the World Tree?"
"It’s so beautiful..."
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but murmur.
Everyone stood in place, unable to contain their amazement.
Despite seeing many species and architecture in this world.
But now.
In front of this sacred Golden Holy Tree.
Everyone couldn’t help but feel a heart-palpitating awe and fascination.
No matter what existence’s power, facing the World Tree, a pilgrim-like feeling would inevitably rise in their hearts.
At this moment, standing at the forefront, the Elf King was upright and proud.
His complexion gleamed under the light, as if plated with gold, appearing sacred and solemn.
Then, he led Han Xing and the others closer to the sacred Golden Tree.
"Brilliant morning star, tree of life~"
"You are the foundation of all, the cradle of life~"
"Ah~"
From time to time, beautiful singing could be heard around.
At the same time.
Ahead was a multitude of elves dressed in priests’ robes, standing with poise in mid-air, waiting for their arrival.
A rough count revealed at least tens of thousands of elves.
The leader was the Divine Maiden of the Elf Race, Elinora.
Even in priestly robes, Elinora’s beauty and impressive figure couldn’t be concealed.
Moreover, it added a sacred and solemn beauty to her.
As they approached.
Tens of thousands of elf priestesses bowed simultaneously.
The Elf King nodded and, without speaking, led Han Xing and the five others toward the Sky Island Continent where the World Tree was located.
The elf priestesses divided into two columns.
Like creating a corridor for pilgrims.
And as they drew closer, the surrounding singing grew louder.
More and more elves appeared.
When Han Xing and the others finally reached the continent where the sacred Golden Tree stood.
There were already hundreds of thousands of elves around them.
They were carefully selected from the entire Elf Kingdom.
Whether in appearance, figure, or temperament, all were impeccable.
However, Han Xing and the others were already uninterested in focusing on these things.
All their attention was on the massive trunk, with countless branches of the Golden Holy Tree before them.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt his body enveloped in a golden light.
And the aura within him rapidly grew.
System notifications appeared continuously,
[Due to receiving the World Tree’s Sacred Blessing, Life Value +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
[Due to receiving the World Tree’s Sacred Blessing, Life Value +20000, Divine Power Value +100...]
Seeing the system notifications cascading,
Everyone was stunned.
Whoa!
[What is the Sacred Blessing?]
In just a few seconds, Han Xing saw his Life Value increase by at least 80,000 points and nearly 400 points of Divine Power!
Just by arriving near the World Tree, they triggered such an incredible blessing.
This is too terrifying!
Including the other team members, they received the same blessing as Han Xing.
At this moment, everyone swallowed hard.
Cheng Jianyong said in disbelief: "Wow... this blessing is too outrageous!"
"Continuing like this, just staying near the World Tree would make one invincible!"
As if seeing their astonishment.
The Elf King turned around and said with a smile: "Saint Master Han Xing, and several friends from the Human Race, have you felt the gift from the World Tree?"
Everyone nodded together.
The Elf King chuckled: "This is an opportunity that every creature that reaches Legendary Level enjoys by simply being near the World Tree."
"However, the effect of this gift will not last long."
"Once this golden aura is absorbed by you, it will disappear on its own.
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded in realization.
As the Elf King said.
At this moment, the system notifications had already slowed down.
And vanished completely a few seconds later.
Nevertheless, it did not conceal the shock in their hearts.
Because they had collectively increased their Life Value by 200,000 points and Divine Power Value by 1,000 points!
This is truly quite frightening.
Even a Demigod-Level ’Life Tree Heart’ could only boost 50,000 points of Life Value and 500 points of Divine Power.
This blessing was even better than two Demigod-Level Life Tree Hearts!
Cheng Jianyong curiously asked at this moment: "Can every Legendary Powerhouse receive such a gift by approaching the World Tree?"
The Elf King shook his head regretfully and said: "It was like that a few thousand years ago."
"At that time, thanks to the blessing of the World Tree, many powerhouses were born in the Holy Spirit Realm."
"But since the World Tree was damaged, no blessings have appeared for many years."
"Even our elf tribe’s newly promoted Legends, when they come near the World Tree, do not receive the enhancement effect."
The Elf King paused, then continued:
"Later, as we learned, this Sacred Blessing consumes the World Tree’s Life Force."
"We have been extremely busy preventing the loss of the World Tree’s Life Force, and it’s also why we dare not let it casually bless."
"I see..." Realization dawned on everyone.
Then, Cheng Jianyong asked: "Um, then why did we receive the blessing effect?"
The Elf King smiled: "The World Tree possesses wisdom and self-awareness, its branches extending to countless worlds, reaching near-omniscience."
"It’s safe to say, throughout the Holy Spirit Realm or the Void Worlds, nothing escapes its knowledge."
"It might have anticipated that you are here to save it."
"So, this is the benevolence this Sacred Tree extends to you."
After listening to the Elf King’s explanation, everyone nodded in understanding.
"Your Majesty the Elf King, what should I do now?"
Han Xing asked: "Is it okay to simply take out the Spirit Wood?"
The Elf King shook his head upon hearing this, "Saint Master Han Xing, please wait a moment."
"Before assisting in repairing the World Tree’s damage, we need to conduct the Awakening Ritual of the World Tree’s Divine Power."
"After the ritual is complete, you can approach the World Tree."

Beside them, more elves were performing peculiar gestures.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 423: The Top Demigod’s Formidable Power
paragraphs: Golden-yellow leaves fell one by one.
It was as if a certain will had truly awakened.
The elves hurriedly gathered the fallen leaves.
Afraid they might drift into the endless void.
The Elf King looked at his team members and said, "Saint Master Han Xing, you can begin."
"Go and place the spirit wood at the root of the World Tree, it will absorb it by itself."
Han Xing nodded in understanding.
Then, he slowly walked towards the Golden Holy Tree.
At this moment, hundreds of thousands of eyes were fixed on Han Xing.
The elven maidens also wished to witness this historic moment.
When Han Xing was within a kilometer of the Holy Tree,
at that moment—
the Elf King’s face suddenly changed.
For he sensed an extremely evil aura suddenly erupting from all around.
Before everyone could react.
A multitude of hexagram arrays suddenly appeared in the sky!
These hexagram arrays emitted a blood-red glow.
The number was not less than a hundred!
Amidst them, the elven maidens were thrown into chaos.
Exclaiming, "Oh my god! It’s an Abyssal Teleportation Array!"
"They’ve actually pinpointed the location of our holy land!"
"It’s over... Is the holy land about to fall too?"
Not only the elves but even the Elf King’s face turned extremely grim.
Suppressing the shock in his heart, he ordered, "Nora, send the alert!"
"The holy land is entering level-1 alert status!"
"Other elves, defend the World Tree diligently!"
"Even at the cost of our lives, not a single trace of these demons must taint our holy land!"
With those words, the Elf King rushed out!
At the same time, Elinora understood the Elf King’s intentions.
A horn suddenly appeared in her hand.
The horn seemed to be carved from a certain kind of wood.
"Woo——"
After the horn was blown.
All the elves entered battle mode.
Simultaneously,
a massive number of demons emerged from those hundreds of Abyssal Teleportation Arrays!
Their faces bore maniacal smiles and demonic qi.
Injecting an evil aura into this golden holy land!
"Hahaha! Lord Demon God’s positioning was spot-on, this is indeed the elves’ holy land!"
"Brothers, look ahead, that’s the World Tree of the Holy Spirit Realm!"
"As long as we destroy it, the Abyss Realm can freely open teleportation arrays in the Elf Realm!"
"By then, the entire Holy Spirit Realm will belong to us!"
The demons murmured their frenzied words, then charged towards the direction of the World Tree.
And at that moment, a sacred white light suddenly struck!
It was the Elf King in a wrathful state.
The demons also sensed the terrifying aura from the Elf King.
Instead of feeling fear, they rushed towards him madly, shouting.
"Brothers, this is the Elf King!"
"As long as we hold him down, no more powerful entities will prevent us from destroying the World Tree!"
"For the Emperor, charge!"
The Elf King snorted coldly at this moment.
Upon reaching the battlefield, his body exuded white light, instantly expanding to cover thousands of kilometers!
"Buzz!"
After the terrifying wave of energy.
At least hundreds of thousands of demons nearby, along with that Abyssal Teleportation Array, vanished without a trace!
This included dozens of Legendary Level demons.
Yet they couldn’t even let out a scream before being directly vaporized by the Elf King!
At this moment, the powerful combat prowess of a top demigod was fully displayed.
After making this astonishing move, the Elf King seamlessly excised from the scene.
Reappearing to claim the lives of another hundred thousand demons at once!
Even those initial-tier demigod level demons, struggling to withstand the Elf King’s wide-range one-hit kill skills.
Would immediately be targeted by the Elf King.
Then, before it could react.
The Elf King opened his palm, and a white light burst forth!
"Boom!"
The white beam of light spanned thousands of kilometers instantaneously!
This initial tier demon’s upper body disappeared in midair.
The Elf King’s attack even exceeded that of the Sun Crown Stele-enhanced Spiritual Godslaying Cannon!
A fully-powered Elf King was terrifyingly formidable!
With his own power, he could guard the area around the World Tree flawlessly.
The team members were amazed at the spectacle.
They initially intended to go up and help, but upon seeing this, they realized it seemed unnecessary.
"Wow, this Elf King, truly a powerhouse on par with Hawthorne Glaser..."
"This is terrifying!"
"Even those demigod level demons are no match for him in a single move," Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but marvel.
The team members nodded in agreement.
The top demigods of the Holy Spirit Realm were genuinely terrifying.
Even more so than those flesh-god insects in the Ancient Ruins.
Even Han Xing could only contend with Hawthorne Glaser due to the defense towers.
Unless he played all his trump cards, there’s no chance against such a force.
Besides, it felt like if things continued, the Elf King could entirely eradicate the demons alone.
However, for the demons to locate the elven holy land, surely they didn’t come unprepared?
After a burst of red blood energy,
several hexagram teleportation arrays merged into one.
Simultaneously,
a demonic claw engulfed in hellfire slowly emerged from the teleportation array.
"Bang!"
"Crack!"
